			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Spark detonations reduce the cooldown of Ricochet Force.

description_trans.ko: 피닉스와 함께 플레이 시, 스파크 폭발이 도탄 포스(Ricochet Force)의 재사용 대기시간을 감소시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: フェニックスとチームアップ時、スパーク爆発が跳弾フォースのクールダウンを短縮する。

teamups.name: KINETIC KIN
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Release stored kinetic energy to enter an enhanced state for a duration. While active, Cyclops gains significantly increased movement speed and jump height.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, during the enhanced state, the attack speeds for both Optic Blast and Concussive Beam are increased.

description_trans.ko: 저장된 키네틱 에너지를 해방하여 일정 시간 강화 상태에 진입합니다. 강화 상태 동안 사이클롭스의 이동 속도와 점프 높이가 대폭 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 蓄積されたキネティックエネルギーを解放し、一定時間強化状態へ移行する。強化中、サイクロップスの移動速度とジャンプ力が大幅に上昇する。

teamups.name: KINETIC KIN
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Release stored kinetic energy to enter an enhanced state for a duration. While active, Cyclops gains significantly increased movement speed and jump height.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, during the enhanced state, the attack speeds for both Optic Blast and Concussive Beam are increased.

description_trans.ko: 갬빗과 함께 플레이 시, 강화 상태 동안 옵틱 블래스트와 충격 광선의 공격 속도(발사 속도)가 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: ガンビットとチームアップ時、強化状態中のオプティック・ブラストおよび衝撃ビームの攻撃速度が上昇する。

names.ja: デッドプール (ヴァンガード)

skills.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - VANGUARD
skills.description: Nobody lays a finger on my teammates! Anyone tries, and I'm firing these big boy bullets straight at their face!

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 15m, decreasing to 75% at 30m

upgrade.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - VANGUARD UPGRADED
upgrade.description: I rack up shots, then, BOOM! A mind-blowing bubble bomb for all the enemies. Teammate security: maximum

stats.Projectile Attack Interval: After every 5 beam bullets fired, the next shot fires 1 additional projectile

description_trans.ko: 총을 팍팍 쏘아 스택을 모은 뒤 쾅! 적들에게 초강력 버블 폭탄을 날려주지. 팀원 안전도 100% 보장!
description_trans.ja: 撃ちまくってスタックを溜めたらドカーン！敵全員に特大バブルボムをお見舞い。チームの安全確保完了！

description_trans.ko: 내 팀원한테 손가락 하나 까딱하기만 해봐! 그 못생긴 얼굴에 왕대포 총알을 정면으로 꽂아줄 테니까!
description_trans.ja: 俺のチームメイトに指一本触れさせねえぞ！手を出してみろ、特大の弾丸を顔面にぶち込んでやる！

skills.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - VANGUARD
skills.description: Protecting my team means my katanas go full savage. No mercy for the baddies!

stats.Attack Interval: First strike: 0.6s; second strike: 0.53s; third strike: 0.6s

upgrade.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - VANGUARD UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Relax, you've got Deadpool on your side! Swords out, baddies out. My stab hits crit, and a Bad Bunny hit makes the next swing a stabby special

stats.Attack Interval: First strike: 0.5s; second strike: 0.43s; third strike: 0.5s

description_trans.ko: 안심해, 너흰 데드풀님이 지켜주니까! 검 뽑고 악당 소탕 완료. 찌르기는 치명타가 터지고 Bad Bunny 연계 시 필살 찌르기가 발동해!
description_trans.ja: 安心しろ、デッドプール様がついてる！刀を抜いて悪党退治だ。突きはクリティカルになり、Bad Bunny命中後の斬撃は特製突き刺しになる！

description_trans.ko: 팀원을 지키기 위해서라면 내 카타나는 인정사정없지. 악당 놈들에게 자비란 없다!
description_trans.ja: チームを守るためなら俺のカタナは容赦しねえ。悪党どもに慈悲なんてねえぞ！

skills.name: MAGICAL UNICORN SHIELD!
skills.description: Plushie power! It stops every single attack those chumps throw, giving my team a safety bubble. It's cute AND bulletproof

upgrade.name: MAGICAL UNICORN SHIELD! - UPGRADED
upgrade.description: My ultra-cool, super shiny, extra huggable, and totally blinged-out plushy. Toss it ahead, and it lands as an invincible sphere of awesomeness! Blocking attacks and keeping my team safe inside our furry fortress

description_trans.ko: 초특급 울트라 반짝반짝 안고 싶은 내 슈퍼 인형 투척! 전방에 떨어져 무적의 방어 구체를 형성해 팀원들을 철통 보호해주지!
description_trans.ja: 超クールでピカピカ、抱き心地抜群の俺の特製ぬいぐるみ！投げると無敵の球体バリアを展開してチームを鉄壁ガード！

description_trans.ko: 인형의 힘을 봐라! 찌질이들의 공격을 몽땅 막아내서 우리 팀에게 무적 돔을 선물해주지. 귀엽고 방탄도 된다고!
description_trans.ja: ぬいぐるみのパワー炸裂！雑魚どもの攻撃を全部弾き返してセーフティバブルを展開。キュートで防弾仕様だ！

skills.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - VANGUARD
skills.description: Try getting to my teammates, I dare you! My dash slash knocks fools down, and if I hit, I get to do it again. Up to three times, baby!

stats.Special Effect: Refresh the cooldown if it hits an enemy for up to 2 times.

upgrade.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - VANGUARD UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Watch this pro bodyguard in action! I dash forward, nail the bad guy, and bounce in any direction I want. Oh, and I can do this two more times real quick!

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 10s to recharge.
stats.Special Effect: Refresh the cooldown if it hits an enemy for up to 2 times. Deadpool bounces as the ability hits an enemy.

description_trans.ko: 프로 보디가드의 실력을 보라고! 전방으로 돌진해 나쁜 놈을 후려치고 사방으로 튕겨 나갈 수 있지. 게다가 두 번 더 연속 사용 가능!
description_trans.ja: プロのボディーガードの腕前を見ろ！突進して悪党をぶん殴り、好きな方向へバウンド。さらにあと2回連続で使えるぜ！

description_trans.ko: 우리 팀한테 다가와 보시지! 돌진 베기로 멍청이들을 넘어뜨리고, 맞추면 최대 3번까지 연속 시전 가능하다고!
description_trans.ja: チームに近づけるもんならやってみろ！突進斬りでノックダウンさせ、命中すれば最大3回まで連続発動だぜベイビー！

skills.name: THE BAN HAMMER
skills.description: You! Yeah, you - the hyper one! Eyes off my friends. I sentence you to...whatever! Get ready to be taunted. I get bonus HP and healing, and if you whiff your abilities, you take damage, and I get even more HP!

upgrade.name: THE BAN HAMMER - UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Upgraded courtroom drama! Congrats, unlucky one! You're my pick; enjoy the taunt! I score bonus health and healing, and you take ongoing damage. If you miss an ability while court is in session, it's a double whammy. You get more pain, AND I get more extra HP! Thanks in advance!

description_trans.ko: 업그레이드된 법정 쇼 개막! 축하해 불운한 녀석아, 넌 내 도발 당첨자야! 난 추가 체력과 힐을 챙기고 넌 지속 피해를 받으며 스킬 빗맞히면 더 아플 거다!
description_trans.ja: 強化された法廷ドラマ開廷！お前が俺の挑発の標的だ！俺は追加HPと回復をゲットしてお前は持続ダメージ。スキルを外せば大ダメージとお前の負け！

description_trans.ko: 거기 너! 내 친구들한테서 눈 떼라! 널 도발 형벌에 처한다! 난 추가 체력과 치유를 얻고, 네가 스킬을 빗맞히면 피해를 입고 난 체력을 더 얻지!
description_trans.ja: おいお前！俺の仲間に手を出すな！挑発の刑を宣告する！俺は追加HPと回復を得て、お前がアビリティを外したらダメージを受け俺はさらにHP回復だ！

skills.name: THE BIG TEST
skills.description: Wake the #!&% up, hero! We've got a game to win! Speed and healing buffs for starters, bonus Hazardous Hijinks for me, and extra HP for me and my nearby friends. Hit enough baddies with the right abilities exactly as I ask, and you unlock mega speed and healing, plus reset my Healing Factor cooldown!. Team protection mode: activated!

stats.Ability Duration: The challenge lasts 12s. The buff lasts 6s after you complete it.

upgrade.name: THE BIG TEST - UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Hey, player! Warm-up's over, time for the main event! Speed, healing, dashes, for me, and bonus HP for all! Smash enough baddies with the skills I say, and you unlock super buffs (massive speed and healing), plus Healing Factor resets. For some time after, each hit means more HP for the crew and you. Don't mess this up!

stats.Ability Duration: The challenge lasts 12s. The buff lasts 8s after you complete it.

description_trans.ko: 야 플레이어! 몸풀기는 끝났어 본방 시작이야! 속도와 힐, 대시 버프에 모두에게 추가 체력까지! 정해진 스킬로 적들을 박살내면 슈퍼 버프와 무한 치유가 터진다!
description_trans.ja: おいプレイヤー！本番開始だ！スピード、回復、追加HPを全員に大盤振る舞い！指示通りのアビリティで敵を粉砕すればスーパー強化と自動治癒が発動するぜ！

description_trans.ko: 정신 차려 영웅들아! 스피드와 치유 버프 발동, 나와 팀원들에게 추가 체력 제공! 내 지시대로 적들을 때려잡으면 메가 버프와 함께 내 치유 쿨타임도 리셋된다!
description_trans.ja: 目を覚ませヒーロー共！スピードと回復バフを付与し、周囲の味方に追加HP！俺の指示通り敵をボコせば超加速＆超回復に治癒リセット解禁だ！

skills.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - VANGUARD
skills.description: Want to hurt my team? Good luck! I hit you with a taunt, mess up your vision, and burn your health nonstop! Best part: my swords and guns go full turbo for the duration. Blink and you'll miss it

stats.Special Effect: Disrupt enemies' vision in range and gain XP. Enemies can damage Deadpool to end the disruption. Increase left-click attack speed for the duration.
stats.Spell Field Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 6m radius and a height of 6m.

upgrade.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - VANGUARD UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Teammates, stay safe! Dummies, look here! It's showtime: I taunt, blind you, and hit warp speed with my swords and guns. Plus, my crew gets a damage reduction buff, so they're basically invincible. Dummies that stick around too long will even have their UI taped over!

stats.Special Effect: Disrupt enemies' vision in range and gain XP. Enemies can damage Deadpool to end the disruption. Increase left-click attack speed for the duration.
stats.Spell Field Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 6m radius and a height of 6m

description_trans.ko: 팀원들은 뒤로 빠져있어! 멍청이들아 날 봐라! 도발, 실명, 그리고 총칼 폭풍 난사! 팀원들에겐 피해 감소 버프를 줘서 거의 무적이고 적 화면엔 테이프까지 붙여주지!
description_trans.ja: 味方は隠れてろ！バカどもは俺を見ろ！挑発と目眩ましに超光速の乱れ撃ち！チームには被ダメ軽減を付与し、長居する奴のUIにはテープを貼って画面を隠してやる！

description_trans.ko: 우리 팀을 건드리겠다고? 어림없지! 도발 걸고 시야를 가려 피를 깎아주마! 지속 시간 동안 내 총칼은 풀터보 모드로 폭주한다!
description_trans.ja: 俺のチームを傷つけたいって？無理無理！挑発して視界を奪いHPをゴリゴリ削ってやる！その間俺の刀と銃はフルターボで超加速だぜ！

skills.name: UPGRADE!
skills.description: I'm here to smack baddies, get XP, and shield my friends! When my XP is full, I get to upgrade an ability! Bonus: Score the final hit and force your foe into a selfie—more XP for me! I'm invincible while striking my best duckface. No photobombs!

stats.Special Effect: Accumulate XP in battle. When maxed, choose an ability to upgrade for powerful boosts

description_trans.ko: 악당을 패서 경험치를 쌓고 친구들을 지킨다! 경험치가 다 차면 스킬을 업그레이드할 수 있어! 막타를 치면 적과 강제 셀카를 찍으며 추가 경험치 획득! 셀카 찍는 동안 난 무적이야!
description_trans.ja: 悪党を殴って経験値を稼ぎ仲間を守る！満タンになったらアビリティを強化だ！トドメを刺して強制自撮りすれば追加経験値獲得！撮影中は無敵だぜ！

skills.name: BUNNY BOUNCE
skills.description: Yup, I can double jump in midair! During The Big Test and its upgrade, I can also stomp heads and wall jump to reset its cooldown. Stomp enemies so hard they won't get near my team!

description_trans.ko: 그래, 나 공중 2단 점프할 수 있어! The Big Test 도중엔 적 대가리를 밟고 벽점프해서 쿨타임을 초기화하지! 아주 납작하게 밟아줄 테다!
description_trans.ja: そう、空中で2段ジャンプできるんだぜ！The Big Test中は敵の頭を踏みつけて壁ジャンプでクールダウンをリセット！踏み潰してチームに近づけさせねえ！

skills.name: HEALING FACTOR
skills.description: Out of combat? I'm healing up, staying battle-ready to protect my team. And if I'm about to croak? Surprise! I get a free pass, and my health zooms back up. Nice try, villains

stats.Special Effect: The healing factor kicks in after Deadpool has been out of combat for 5s. If Deadpool takes more than 200 damage within a two-second window, the healing factor activates and boosts the healing

description_trans.ko: 비전투 상태면 초고속으로 치유돼! 그리고 내가 죽을 것 같다고? 짠! 부활 찬스로 순식간에 체력이 꽉 차오르지. 수고했다 악당 녀석들아!
description_trans.ja: 非戦闘時は爆速自動回復！死にそうになってもサプライズで即座にHP大回復！残念だったな悪党ども！

skills.name: MAXIMUM FLAIR
skills.description: Listen up, eyes on the prize, don't wander off! Every time my abilities land on a bad guy, the style points shoot up a notch! When it's full, I can pop my ultimate! With me on the team, you're all staying alive and fabulous!

stats.Special Effect: The ultimate ability can be unleashed after reaching an S rating. The rating is cleared if Deadpool is defeated.

description_trans.ko: 주목! 한눈팔지 마! 스킬을 맞출 때마다 스타일 점수가 쭉쭉 차오른다! 가득 차면 궁극기를 빵 터뜨릴 수 있지. 내가 있는 한 너흰 다 살아남을 거야!
description_trans.ja: 注目！よそ見すんな！スキルを当てるたびにスタイルポイントが急上昇！満タンになれば必殺のアルティメット炸裂だ！俺がいれば全員無傷で華麗に生き残れるぜ！

skills.name: Comical Chaos
skills.description: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie with attitude. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range enjoy a plush-powered healing party!

description_trans.ko: 데드풀이 제프에게 반항기 넘치는 인형을 쥐여줍니다. 제프가 인형을 뱉으면 주변 적을 도발하고 시야를 가리며, 범위 내 아군에게 신나는 힐 파티를 열어줍니다!
description_trans.ja: デッドプールがジェフに生意気なぬいぐるみをプレゼント。ジェフが吐き出すと周囲の敵を挑発し視界を妨害、範囲内の味方には回復パーティーをお届け！

teamups.name: "HEL-YEAH, HONEY"
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

description_trans.ko: 명계(Hel)의 강화를 받아 데저트 이글이나 카타나 중 하나를 추가로 업그레이드할 수 있습니다. [헬-예 데저트 이글]: 탄환 관통 및 아군 유도 힐링 버블 생성 / [헬-예 카타나]: 언데드 에너지 3타 시 최대 체력 비례 고정 피해 폭발.
description_trans.ja: 冥界(Hel)の強化を受け、デザートイーグルかカタナのどちらかを追加アップグレード可能。【ヘル・イエー デザートイーグル】：弾丸貫通＆味方追尾回復バブル【ヘル・イエー カタナ】：アンデッドエネルギー注入＆3撃命中で最大体力確定ダメージ。

teamups.name: "HEL-YEAH, HONEY"
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

stats.Special Effect: Both Desert Eagle and Katana can be further upgraded

description_trans.ko: 헬라와 함께 플레이 시, 데저트 이글과 카타나를 '둘 다' 동시에 추가 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: ヘラとチームアップ時、デザートイーグルとカタナの『両方』を同時に追加アップグレードできるようになる。

teamups.name: GUMBO CHIMICHANGAS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, he scatters a ring of kinetically charged chimichangas that deal damage to enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

description_trans.ko: 키네틱 도약으로 뛰어올라 착지 시 폭발 치미창가 링을 방출하여 주변 적들에게 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: キネティック跳躍で跳び上がり、着地時に爆破チミチャンガを撒き散らして周囲の敵にダメージを与える。

teamups.name: GUMBO CHIMICHANGAS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, he scatters a ring of kinetically charged chimichangas that deal damage to enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

description_trans.ko: 갬빗과 함께 플레이 시, 착지 시 폭발 반경 내 적들을 기절(Stun)시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: ガンビットとチームアップ時、着地爆発範囲内の敵をスタン(Stun)させる。

names.ja: デッドプール (デュエリスト)

skills.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - DUELIST
skills.description: Bang! Bang! Unleash two hand cannons left and right, because one gun is never enough. Pew pew, baby!

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 18m, decreasing to 80% at 30m

upgrade.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Keep blasting till you trigger a BOOM. My thoughts literally explode onto the battlefield. Talk about mind-blowing firepower!

stats.Projectile Attack Interval: After every 5 beam bullets fired, the next shot fires 1 additional projectile

description_trans.ko: 쾅 터질 때까지 난사해라! 내 생각이 전장에 문자 그대로 폭발한다. 이 대단한 화력을 보라고!
description_trans.ja: ドカンと爆発するまで撃ちまくれ！俺の思考が戦場で文字通り大爆発するぜ！

description_trans.ko: 탕! 탕! 양손에 핸드캐넌을 들고 빵야빵야 쏴갈긴다! 총은 한 자루로는 부족하잖아, 베이비!
description_trans.ja: バン！バン！左右のハンドキャノンをぶっ放す！銃は1丁じゃ足りねえだろ、ベイビー！

skills.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - DUELIST
skills.description: Slicey, dicey, twice as nicey! Swing both swords at whoever gets too close. Sushi, anyone?

stats.Attack Interval: First strike: 0.6s; second strike: 0.53s; third strike: 0.6s

upgrade.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Now with extra chop! Stabs can go straight for the noggin. Heads up! Do a Bunny Hop and POW! Stabby Stabby action guaranteed! Run while you can!

stats.Attack Interval: First strike: 0.5s; second strike: 0.43s; third strike: 0.5s

description_trans.ko: 더 강력해진 난무! 머리통을 향해 정밀 찌르기 발동! Bunny Hop으로 도약 후 쾅! 필살 찌르기 액션 작렬! 도망칠 수 있을 때 튀어라!
description_trans.ja: さらに強烈な乱舞！頭部を狙った突きが炸裂！Bunny Hopからドカン！連続メッタ刺しアクション確定だ！今のうちに逃げな！

description_trans.ko: 썰고, 베고, 두 배로 신나게! 너무 가까이 온 녀석들에게 쌍칼을 휘둘러주마. 회 한 접시 드실 분?
description_trans.ja: 刻んで斬り裂いて2倍爽快！近づきすぎた奴に二刀流をお見舞い。寿司職人の出番だぜ！

skills.name: HEADSHOT! - DUELIST
skills.description: Ever seen someone throw their own face? Watch me KO a crowd, then catch my mug on the rebound!. Don't lose your head over it

stats.Casting: Single-cast projectile with delayed impact that also generates a spell field

upgrade.name: HEADSHOT! - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Juggle my noggin for extra throws! If you catch it thrice, it goes kaboom. Everyone gets a piece of my mind

stats.Spell Field Duration: First unleash: 1s; second unleash: 1s; third unleash: 2s

description_trans.ko: 내 머리통으로 저글링해서 연속 투척! 3번 잡으면 쾅 폭발하지. 내 정신 나간 생각 맛 좀 봐라!
description_trans.ja: 俺の頭でジャグリングして連続投擲！3回キャッチすれば大爆発だ。みんなに俺の頭脳をおすそ分け！

description_trans.ko: 자기 얼굴을 던지는 거 본 적 있어? 적 무리를 박살 내고 튕겨 나온 내 머리를 받아내는 걸 잘 보라고!
description_trans.ja: 自分の顔を投げ飛ばす奴を見たことあるか？敵をKOして跳ね返ってきた頭をキャッチ！頭を失くすなよ！

skills.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - DUELIST
skills.description: Blink, and you'll miss my deadly dash combo. Slash, dash, repeat! Hit someone? You get to go again! (Up to 2 more times. Don't get greedy.) Who says I can't multitask?

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 10s to recharge.
stats.Special Effect: Refresh the cooldown if it hits an enemy for up to 2 times.

upgrade.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Now with bouncy castle action! Slash, bounce, repeat. It's like the world's deadliest pinball!. Cooldowns? Never heard of 'em. Keep going as long as you hit stuff, just don't let me fall flat on my ass!

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 10s to recharge.
stats.Special Effect: Refresh the cooldown if it hits an enemy. Deadpool bounces as the ability hits an enemy.

description_trans.ko: 통통 튀는 핀볼 액션 개시! 베고, 튀어 오르고, 무한 반복! 적을 맞추기만 하면 쿨다운 따윈 잊어버려!
description_trans.ja: トランポリンアクション炸裂！斬って跳ねて無限ループ！世界で一番凶悪なピンボールだぜ！当て続ける限りクールダウンなんて知らねえ！

description_trans.ko: 눈 깜짝할 사이에 치명적인 대시 콤보를 먹여줍니다. 베고, 달리고, 반복! 적중하면 최대 2회까지 재사용 가능합니다.
description_trans.ja: 瞬き厳禁の猛烈ダッシュコンボ！斬って、走って、リピート！敵に当てれば最大2回まで再発動可能！

skills.name: SKILL ISSUE
skills.description: Let's play judge! Pick a dumb-dumb and slap a taunt. They miss an ability? Boom! Gavel drops, and I slap them with pain and snark

upgrade.name: SKILL ISSUE - UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Dumbpoochu, I choose you! Taunt time! Their HP melts away, and if they whiff an ability, they get bonus pain AND Vulnerability. Double whammy! Objection? Overruled!

stats.Vulnerability Ration From Ability Missed: 10% for each stack. Up to 4 stacks.

description_trans.ko: 넌 내 포켓몬 당첨이야! 도발 개시! 녀석의 피가 줄줄 녹아내리고, 스킬을 헛치면 추가 고통에 취약까지! 이의 제기? 기각이다!
description_trans.ja: お前に決めた！挑発タイムだ！HPをごっそり削ってスキルを外せば追加ダメージと脆弱を付与！異議あり？却下！

description_trans.ko: 판사 놀이 한번 해볼까! 멍청이 하나 골라서 도발을 날린다. 녀석이 스킬을 빗맞히면 판사봉을 쾅 내리치며 고통과 조롱을 선사해주지!
description_trans.ja: 裁判長ごっこを始めようぜ！バカを1人選んで挑発。そいつがスキルを外したらガベルを叩いて激痛と煽りをプレゼントだ！

skills.name: POP QUIZ!
skills.description: Hey, you! Yeah, you! Ready for a challenge? Free speed and healing just for trying. Nail enough hits with the right abilities and unlock the deluxe speed-heal package. It's an A+ in chaos!

stats.Ability Duration: The challenge lasts 12s. The buff lasts 6s after you complete it.

upgrade.name: POP QUIZ! - UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Don't just stand there, you blockhead! The challenge's still rolling. But don't worry, I'm not one of those money-hungry scam artists. The buffs are on the house, no price hike. Take on this challenge, and you'll get three freebies: a little Speed boost, Continuous Healing, and Damage Up. Hit enough baddies with the right abilities exactly as I ask, and you unlock the ultimate bundle (Super Speed, Super Healing, Damage Boost AND reset all your cooldowns (except Healing Factor; no cheating!). Now THAT'S love

stats.Ability Duration: The challenge lasts 12s. The buff lasts 8s after you complete it.

description_trans.ko: 멍하니 서 있지 마 돌머리야! 과제는 계속된다고. 속도 증가, 지속 치유, 공격력 증가 버프를 무료로 퍼준다! 내 지시대로 적들을 패면 슈퍼 스피드, 슈퍼 힐, 쿨다운 전체 초기화가 터진다!
description_trans.ja: 突っ立ってんじゃねえ石頭！チャレンジは続行中だ。スピード、持続回復、攻撃力アップを大盤振る舞い！指示通りに敵を殴れば超加速と超回復、全クールダウンリセット発動だぜ！

description_trans.ko: 거기 너! 도전 과제 할 준비 됐어? 참가만 해도 공짜 이동 속도와 힐 제공! 지시한 스킬을 팍팍 맞추면 초호화 스피드-힐링 패키지 오픈!
description_trans.ja: おいそこのお前！チャレンジの準備はいいか？挑戦するだけでスピードと回復を無料提供！スキルを命中させれば超豪華加速回復セット解禁だ！

skills.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - DUELIST
skills.description: True heroes taunt face-to-face! I roast nearby baddies, mess up their vision, and tank their hits like a boss. Try me!

stats.Special Effect: Disrupt enemies' vision in range and gain XP. Enemies can damage Deadpool to end the disruption.
stats.Spell Field Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 6m radius and a height of 6m

upgrade.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Check out the best trash talk in the Chronoverse! Keep taunting and melting their HP! I even block their screen, so they can't see squat. Plus, I tank hits like a champ. Enemies that stick around too long get the bottom of their screen taped up. By the end, they won't even find their health bar and whatnot. Good luck fighting what you can't see, suckers!

stats.Special Effect: Disrupt enemies' vision in range and gain XP. Enemies can damage Deadpool to end the disruption.
stats.Spell Field Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 6m radius and a height of 6m

description_trans.ko: 우주 최강의 트래시 토크를 보아라! 계속 도발하며 체력을 녹이고 화면까지 가려버리지! 오래 버티는 놈은 화면 밑에 테이프를 둘둘 감아 체력바도 안 보이게 만들어주마!
description_trans.ja: 全宇宙最高の毒舌を見せてやる！挑発し続けてHPを溶かし、画面まで塞いで何も見えなくしてやるぜ！居座る奴の画面下にテープを貼ってHPバーも見えなくしてやる！

description_trans.ko: 진정한 영웅은 면전에서 도발하는 법! 주변 악당들을 극딜하고 시야를 망가뜨리며 공격을 보스처럼 버텨내지. 덤벼봐!
description_trans.ja: 真のヒーローは面と向かって挑発するもんだ！周りの悪党を煽り倒して視界を奪い、攻撃を平気で耐えてやる。かかってこい！

skills.name: UPGRADE!
skills.description: I'm here to smack baddies, get XP, and shield my friends! When my XP is full, I get to upgrade an ability! Bonus: Score the final hit and force your foe into a selfie—more XP for me! I'm invincible while striking my best duckface. No photobombs!

stats.Special Effect: Accumulate XP in battle. When maxed, choose an ability to upgrade for powerful boosts.

description_trans.ko: 악당을 패서 경험치를 쌓고 친구들을 지킨다! 경험치가 다 차면 스킬을 업그레이드할 수 있어! 막타를 치면 적과 강제 셀카를 찍으며 추가 경험치 획득! 셀카 찍는 동안 난 무적이야!
description_trans.ja: 悪党を殴って経験値を稼ぎ仲間を守る！満タンになったらアビリティを強化だ！トドメを刺して強制自撮りすれば追加経験値獲得！撮影中は無敵だぜ！

skills.name: BUNNY HOP
skills.description: Hippity-hoppity, Deadpool's on your property! Watch me squeeze in a second jump midair! Hop on heads or kick off walls with Bunny Hop to refresh the cooldown, and if I land on someone? Free health for me, and a headache for them. Whee!

stats.Special Effect: Refresh the cooldown if it hits an enemy.

description_trans.ko: 깡충깡충 데드풀님이 나가신다! 공중에서 2단 점프 시전! 머리통을 밟거나 벽을 차서 쿨타임을 초기화하고 적 위에 착지하면 난 체력 회복, 쟨 두통 당첨!
description_trans.ja: ピョンピョン跳ねてデッドプール様のお通りだ！空中で2段ジャンプ！頭を踏むか壁を蹴ってリセット、敵の上に着地すれば俺は回復、相手は脳震盪だ！

skills.name: HEALING FACTOR
skills.description: Out of combat? I'm healing up, staying battle-ready to protect my team. And if I'm about to croak? Surprise! I get a free pass, and my health zooms back up. Nice try, villains

stats.Special Effect: The healing factor kicks in after Deadpool has been out of combat for 5s. If Deadpool takes more than 200 damage within a two-second window, the healing factor activates and boosts the healing

description_trans.ko: 비전투 상태면 초고속으로 치유돼! 그리고 내가 죽을 것 같다고? 짠! 부활 찬스로 순식간에 체력이 꽉 차오르지. 수고했다 악당 녀석들아!
description_trans.ja: 非戦闘時は爆速自動回復！死にそうになってもサプライズで即座にHP大回復！残念だったな悪党ども！

skills.name: MAXIMUM FLAIR
skills.description: Listen up, eyes on the prize, don't wander off! Every time my abilities land on a bad guy, the style points shoot up a notch! When it's full, I can pop my ultimate! With me on the team, you're all staying alive and fabulous!

stats.Special Effect: The ultimate ability can be unleashed after reaching an S rating. The rating is cleared if Deadpool is defeated.

description_trans.ko: 주목! 한눈팔지 마! 스킬을 맞출 때마다 스타일 점수가 쭉쭉 차오른다! 가득 차면 궁극기를 빵 터뜨릴 수 있지. 내가 있는 한 너흰 다 살아남을 거야!
description_trans.ja: 注目！よそ見すんな！スキルを当てるたびにスタイルポイントが急上昇！満タンになれば必殺のアルティメット炸裂だ！俺がいれば全員無傷で華麗に生き残れるぜ！

skills.name: Comical Chaos
skills.description: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie with attitude. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range enjoy a plush-powered healing party!

description_trans.ko: 데드풀이 제프에게 반항기 넘치는 인형을 쥐여줍니다. 제프가 인형을 뱉으면 주변 적을 도발하고 시야를 가리며, 범위 내 아군에게 신나는 힐 파티를 열어줍니다!
description_trans.ja: デッドプールがジェフに生意気なぬいぐるみをプレゼント。ジェフが吐き出すと周囲の敵を挑発し視界を妨害、範囲内の味方には回復パーティーをお届け！

teamups.name: "HEL-YEAH, HONEY"
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

description_trans.ko: 명계(Hel)의 강화를 받아 데저트 이글이나 카타나 중 하나를 추가로 업그레이드할 수 있습니다. [헬-예 데저트 이글]: 탄환 관통 및 아군 유도 힐링 버블 생성 / [헬-예 카타나]: 언데드 에너지 3타 시 최대 체력 비례 고정 피해 폭발.
description_trans.ja: 冥界(Hel)の強化を受け、デザートイーグルかカタナのどちらかを追加アップグレード可能。【ヘル・イエー デザートイーグル】：弾丸貫通＆味方追尾回復バブル【ヘル・イエー カタナ】：アンデッドエネルギー注入＆3撃命中で最大体力確定ダメージ。

teamups.name: "HEL-YEAH, HONEY"
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

stats.Special Effect: Both Desert Eagle and Katana can be further upgraded

description_trans.ko: 헬라와 함께 플레이 시, 데저트 이글과 카타나를 '둘 다' 동시에 추가 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: ヘラとチームアップ時、デザートイーグルとカタナの『両方』を同時に追加アップグレードできるようになる。

teamups.name: GUMBO CHIMICHANGAS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, he scatters a ring of kinetically charged chimichangas that deal damage to enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

description_trans.ko: 키네틱 도약으로 뛰어올라 착지 시 폭발 치미창가 링을 방출하여 주변 적들에게 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: キネティック跳躍で跳び上がり、着地時に爆破チミチャンガを撒き散らして周囲の敵にダメージを与える。

teamups.name: GUMBO CHIMICHANGAS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, he scatters a ring of kinetically charged chimichangas that deal damage to enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

description_trans.ko: 갬빗과 함께 플레이 시, 착지 시 폭발 반경 내 적들을 기절(Stun)시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: ガンビットとチームアップ時、着地爆発範囲内の敵をスタン(Stun)させる。

names.ja: デッドプール (ストラテジスト)

role_name.ja: ストラテジスト (サポート)

skills.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - STRATEGIST
skills.description: Nobody lays a finger on my teammates! Anyone tries, and I'm firing these big boy bullets straight at their face!

upgrade.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: I rack up shots, then, BOOM! A mind-blowing bubble bomb for all the enemies. Teammate security: maximum

stats.Projectile Attack Interval: After every 5 beam bullets fired, the next shot fires 1 additional projectile

description_trans.ko: 총을 팍팍 쏘아 스택을 모은 뒤 쾅! 적들에게 초강력 버블 폭탄을 날려주지. 팀원 안전도 100% 보장!
description_trans.ja: 撃ちまくってスタックを溜めたらドカーン！敵全員に特大バブルボムをお見舞い。チームの安全確保完了！

description_trans.ko: 내 팀원한테 손가락 하나 까딱하기만 해봐! 그 못생긴 얼굴에 왕대포 총알을 정면으로 꽂아줄 테니까!
description_trans.ja: 俺のチームメイトに指一本触れさせねえぞ！手を出してみろ、特大の弾丸を顔面にぶち込んでやる！

skills.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - STRATEGIST
skills.description: Protecting my team means my katanas go full savage. No mercy for the baddies!

stats.Attack Interval: First strike: 0.6s; second strike: 0.53s; third strike: 0.6s

upgrade.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Relax, you've got Deadpool on your side! Swords out, baddies out. My stab hits crit, and a Healing Hop hit makes the next swing a stabby special

stats.Attack Interval: First strike: 0.5s; second strike: 0.43s; third strike: 0.5s

description_trans.ko: 안심해, 너흰 데드풀님이 지켜주니까! 검 뽑고 악당 소탕 완료. 찌르기는 치명타가 터지고 Healing Hop 연계 시 필살 찌르기가 발동해!
description_trans.ja: 安心しろ、デッドプール様がついてる！刀を抜いて悪党退治だ。突きはクリティカルになり、Healing Hop命中後の斬撃は特製突き刺しになる！

description_trans.ko: 팀원을 지키기 위해서라면 내 카타나는 인정사정없지. 악당 놈들에게 자비란 없다!
description_trans.ja: チームを守るためなら俺のカタナは容赦しねえ。悪党どもに慈悲なんてねえぞ！

skills.name: BOUNCING BOBBLEHEAD - STRATEGIST
skills.description: Plushie power! It stops every single attack those chumps throw, giving my team a safety bubble. It's cute AND bulletproof

stats.Casting: Single-cast projectile with delayed impact that also generates a spell field

upgrade.name: BOUNCING BOBBLEHEAD - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: My ultra-cool, super shiny, extra huggable, and totally blinged-out plushy. Toss it ahead, and it lands as an invincible sphere of awesomeness! Blocking attacks and keeping my team safe inside our furry fortress

stats.Spell Field Duration: First unleash: 1s; second unleash: 1s; third unleash: 2s

description_trans.ko: 초특급 울트라 반짝반짝 안고 싶은 내 슈퍼 인형 투척! 전방에 떨어져 무적의 방어 구체를 형성해 팀원들을 철통 보호해주지!
description_trans.ja: 超クールでピカピカ、抱き心地抜群の俺の特製ぬいぐるみ！投げると無敵の球体バリアを展開してチームを鉄壁ガード！

description_trans.ko: 인형의 힘을 봐라! 찌질이들의 공격을 몽땅 막아내서 우리 팀에게 무적 돔을 선물해주지. 귀엽고 방탄도 된다고!
description_trans.ja: ぬいぐるみのパワー炸裂！雑魚どもの攻撃を全部弾き返してセーフティバブルを展開。キュートで防弾仕様だ！

skills.name: HEALING HIJINKS - STRATEGIST
skills.description: Try getting to my teammates, I dare you! My dash slash knocks fools down, and if I hit, I get to do it again. Up to three times, baby!

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 10s to recharge.

upgrade.name: HEALING HIJINKS - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Watch this pro bodyguard in action! I dash forward, nail the bad guy, and bounce in any direction I want. Oh, and I can do this two more times real quick!

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 10s to recharge.
stats.Special Effect: Refresh the cooldown if it hits an enemy for up to 2 times. Deadpool bounces as the ability hits an enemy.

description_trans.ko: 프로 보디가드의 실력을 보라고! 전방으로 돌진해 나쁜 놈을 후려치고 사방으로 튕겨 나갈 수 있지. 게다가 두 번 더 연속 사용 가능!
description_trans.ja: プロのボディーガードの腕前を見ろ！突進して悪党をぶん殴り、好きな方向へバウンド。さらにあと2回連続で使えるぜ！

description_trans.ko: 우리 팀한테 다가와 보시지! 돌진 베기로 멍청이들을 넘어뜨리고, 맞추면 최대 3번까지 연속 시전 가능하다고!
description_trans.ja: チームに近づけるもんならやってみろ！突進斬りでノックダウンさせ、命中すれば最大3回まで連続発動だぜベイビー！

skills.name: PWNAGE POUND
skills.description: You! Yeah, you - the hyper one! Eyes off my friends. I sentence you to...whatever! Get ready to be taunted. I get bonus HP and healing, and if you whiff your abilities, you take damage, and I get even more HP!

upgrade.name: PWNAGE POUND - UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Upgraded courtroom drama! Congrats, unlucky one! You're my pick; enjoy the taunt! I score bonus health and healing, and you take ongoing damage. If you miss an ability while court is in session, it's a double whammy. You get more pain, AND I get more extra HP! Thanks in advance!

description_trans.ko: 업그레이드된 법정 쇼 개막! 축하해 불운한 녀석아, 넌 내 도발 당첨자야! 난 추가 체력과 힐을 챙기고 넌 지속 피해를 받으며 스킬 빗맞히면 더 아플 거다!
description_trans.ja: 強化された法廷ドラマ開廷！お前が俺の挑発の標的だ！俺は追加HPと回復をゲットしてお前は持続ダメージ。スキルを外せば大ダメージとお前の負け！

description_trans.ko: 거기 너! 내 친구들한테서 눈 떼라! 널 도발 형벌에 처한다! 난 추가 체력과 치유를 얻고, 네가 스킬을 빗맞히면 피해를 입고 난 체력을 더 얻지!
description_trans.ja: おいお前！俺の仲間に手を出すな！挑発の刑を宣告する！俺は追加HPと回復を得て、お前がアビリティを外したらダメージを受け俺はさらにHP回復だ！

skills.name: FINAL EXAM
skills.description: Wake the #!&% up, hero! We've got a game to win! Speed and healing buffs for starters, bonus Healing Hijinks for me, and extra HP for me and my nearby friends. Hit enough baddies with the right abilities exactly as I ask, and you unlock mega speed and healing, plus reset my Healing Factor cooldown!. Team protection mode: activated!

stats.Ability Duration: The challenge lasts 12s. The buff lasts 6s after you complete it.

upgrade.name: FINAL EXAM - UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Hey, player! Warm-up's over, time for the main event! Speed, healing, dashes, for me, and bonus HP for all! Smash enough baddies with the skills I say, and you unlock super buffs(massive speed and healing), plus Healing Factor resets. For some time after, each hit means more HP for the crew and you. Don't mess this up!

stats.Ability Duration: The challenge lasts 12s. The buff lasts 8s after you complete it.
stats.Healing Amount: 80/s upon activation; 120/s after completing the challenge

description_trans.ko: 야 플레이어! 몸풀기는 끝났어 본방 시작이야! 속도와 힐, 대시 버프에 모두에게 추가 체력까지! 정해진 스킬로 적들을 박살내면 슈퍼 버프와 무한 치유가 터진다!
description_trans.ja: おいプレイヤー！本番開始だ！スピード、回復、追加HPを全員に大盤振る舞い！指示通りのアビリティで敵を粉砕すればスーパー強化と自動治癒が発動するぜ！

description_trans.ko: 정신 차려 영웅들아! 스피드와 치유 버프 발동, 나와 팀원들에게 추가 체력 제공! 내 지시대로 적들을 때려잡으면 메가 버프와 함께 내 치유 쿨타임도 리셋된다!
description_trans.ja: 目を覚ませヒーロー共！スピードと回復バフを付与し、周囲の味方に追加HP！俺の指示通り敵をボコせば超加速＆超回復に治癒リセット解禁だ！

skills.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - STRATEGIST
skills.description: Want to hurt my team? Good luck! I hit you with a taunt, mess up your vision, and burn your health nonstop! Best part: my swords and guns go full turbo for the duration. Blink and you'll miss it

stats.Special Effect: Disrupt enemies' vision in range and gain XP. Enemies can damage Deadpool to end the disruption.
stats.Spell Field Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 6m radius and a height of 6m

upgrade.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.description: Teammates, stay safe! Dummies, look here! It's showtime: I taunt, blind you, and hit warp speed with my swords and guns. Plus, my crew gets a damage reduction buff, so they're basically invincible. Dummies that stick around too long will even have their UI taped over!

stats.Special Effect: Disrupt enemies' vision in range and gain XP. Enemies can damage Deadpool to end the disruption.
stats.Spell Field Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 6m radius and a height of 6m.

description_trans.ko: 팀원들은 뒤로 빠져있어! 멍청이들아 날 봐라! 도발, 실명, 그리고 총칼 폭풍 난사! 팀원들에겐 피해 감소 버프를 줘서 거의 무적이고 적 화면엔 테이프까지 붙여주지!
description_trans.ja: 味方は隠れてろ！バカどもは俺を見ろ！挑発と目眩ましに超光速の乱れ撃ち！チームには被ダメ軽減を付与し、長居する奴のUIにはテープを貼って画面を隠してやる！

description_trans.ko: 우리 팀을 건드리겠다고? 어림없지! 도발 걸고 시야를 가려 피를 깎아주마! 지속 시간 동안 내 총칼은 풀터보 모드로 폭주한다!
description_trans.ja: 俺のチームを傷つけたいって？無理無理！挑発して視界を奪いHPをゴリゴリ削ってやる！その間俺の刀と銃はフルターボで超加速だぜ！

skills.name: UPGRADE!
skills.description: I'm here to smack baddies, get XP, and shield my friends! When my XP is full, I get to upgrade an ability! Bonus: Score the final hit and force your foe into a selfie—more XP for me! I'm invincible while striking my best duckface. No photobombs!

stats.Special Effect: Accumulate XP in battle. When maxed, choose an ability to upgrade for powerful boosts

description_trans.ko: 악당을 패서 경험치를 쌓고 친구들을 지킨다! 경험치가 다 차면 스킬을 업그레이드할 수 있어! 막타를 치면 적과 강제 셀카를 찍으며 추가 경험치 획득! 셀카 찍는 동안 난 무적이야!
description_trans.ja: 悪党を殴って経験値を稼ぎ仲間を守る！満タンになったらアビリティを強化だ！トドメを刺して強制自撮りすれば追加経験値獲得！撮影中は無敵だぜ！

skills.name: HEALING HOP
skills.description: Yup, I can double jump in midair! During The Big Test and its upgrade, I can also stomp heads and wall jump to reset its cooldown. Stomp enemies so hard they won't get near my team!

stats.Special Effect: Refresh the cooldown if it hits an enemy or an ally. Transform the next katana base attack to a Stab.

description_trans.ko: 그래, 나 공중 2단 점프할 수 있어! The Big Test 도중엔 적 대가리를 밟고 벽점프해서 쿨타임을 초기화하지! 아주 납작하게 밟아줄 테다!
description_trans.ja: そう、空中で2段ジャンプできるんだぜ！The Big Test中は敵の頭を踏みつけて壁ジャンプでクールダウンをリセット！踏み潰してチームに近づけさせねえ！

skills.name: HEALING FACTOR
skills.description: Out of combat? I'm healing up, staying battle-ready to protect my team. And if I'm about to croak? Surprise! I get a free pass, and my health zooms back up. Nice try, villains

stats.Special Effect: The healing factor kicks in after Deadpool has been out of combat for 5s. If Deadpool takes more than 200 damage within a two-second window, the healing factor activates and boosts the healing

description_trans.ko: 비전투 상태면 초고속으로 치유돼! 그리고 내가 죽을 것 같다고? 짠! 부활 찬스로 순식간에 체력이 꽉 차오르지. 수고했다 악당 녀석들아!
description_trans.ja: 非戦闘時は爆速自動回復！死にそうになってもサプライズで即座にHP大回復！残念だったな悪党ども！

skills.name: MAXIMUM FLAIR
skills.description: Listen up, eyes on the prize, don't wander off! Every time my abilities land on a bad guy, the style points shoot up a notch! When it's full, I can pop my ultimate! With me on the team, you're all staying alive and fabulous!

stats.Special Effect: The ultimate ability can be unleashed after reaching an S rating. The rating is cleared if Deadpool is defeated.

description_trans.ko: 주목! 한눈팔지 마! 스킬을 맞출 때마다 스타일 점수가 쭉쭉 차오른다! 가득 차면 궁극기를 빵 터뜨릴 수 있지. 내가 있는 한 너흰 다 살아남을 거야!
description_trans.ja: 注目！よそ見すんな！スキルを当てるたびにスタイルポイントが急上昇！満タンになれば必殺のアルティメット炸裂だ！俺がいれば全員無傷で華麗に生き残れるぜ！

skills.name: Comical Chaos
skills.description: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie with attitude. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range enjoy a plush-powered healing party!

description_trans.ko: 데드풀이 제프에게 반항기 넘치는 인형을 쥐여줍니다. 제프가 인형을 뱉으면 주변 적을 도발하고 시야를 가리며, 범위 내 아군에게 신나는 힐 파티를 열어줍니다!
description_trans.ja: デッドプールがジェフに生意気なぬいぐるみをプレゼント。ジェフが吐き出すと周囲の敵を挑発し視界を妨害、範囲内の味方には回復パーティーをお届け！

teamups.name: "HEL-YEAH, HONEY"
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

description_trans.ko: 명계(Hel)의 강화를 받아 데저트 이글이나 카타나 중 하나를 추가로 업그레이드할 수 있습니다. [헬-예 데저트 이글]: 탄환 관통 및 아군 유도 힐링 버블 생성 / [헬-예 카타나]: 언데드 에너지 3타 시 최대 체력 비례 고정 피해 폭발.
description_trans.ja: 冥界(Hel)の強化を受け、デザートイーグルかカタナのどちらかを追加アップグレード可能。【ヘル・イエー デザートイーグル】：弾丸貫通＆味方追尾回復バブル【ヘル・イエー カタナ】：アンデッドエネルギー注入＆3撃命中で最大体力確定ダメージ。

teamups.name: "HEL-YEAH, HONEY"
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

stats.Special Effect: Both Desert Eagle and Katana can be further upgraded

description_trans.ko: 헬라와 함께 플레이 시, 데저트 이글과 카타나를 '둘 다' 동시에 추가 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: ヘラとチームアップ時、デザートイーグルとカタナの『両方』を同時に追加アップグレードできるようになる。

teamups.name: GUMBO CHIMICHANGAS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, he scatters a ring of kinetically charged chimichangas that deal damage to enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

description_trans.ko: 키네틱 도약으로 뛰어올라 착지 시 폭발 치미창가 링을 방출하여 주변 적들에게 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: キネティック跳躍で跳び上がり、着地時に爆破チミチャンガを撒き散らして周囲の敵にダメージを与える。

teamups.name: GUMBO CHIMICHANGAS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, he scatters a ring of kinetically charged chimichangas that deal damage to enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

description_trans.ko: 갬빗과 함께 플레이 시, 착지 시 폭발 반경 내 적들을 기절(Stun)시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: ガンビットとチームアップ時、着地爆発範囲内の敵をスタン(Stun)させる。

skills.name: Primal Bite
skills.description: Bite forward. Applies a Bleed that deals continuous Percentage Damage

description_trans.ko: 전방을 강력하게 물어뜯습니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ力強く噛みつく。

skills.name: Impact Beam
skills.description: Unleash a devastating beam of energy that inflicts a Bleed and Slow.

description_trans.ko: 파괴적인 에너지 광선을 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 破壊的なエネルギービームを放つ。

skills.name: Devil-Beast Rampage
skills.description: Erupt in primal fury! Gain a massive Movement Speed Boost while unleashing earth-shattering stomps that Launch enemies and applies a Bleed. Thunderous roars also emit sonic waves that Slow enemies hit

description_trans.ko: 원시의 분노를 폭발시켜 이동 속도가 대폭 증가하며, 지면을 강타해 적을 띄우고 출혈을 겁니다. 포효 시 적을 감속시키는 음파를 방출합니다.
description_trans.ja: 原始の怒りを爆発させ大幅に加速し、地面を踏み鳴らして敵を打ち上げ出血を付与する。咆哮でスロウ音波を放つ。

skills.name: Savage Predation
skills.description: Dash and pounce on your prey with a vicious bite, applying a Bleed. If the target is already Bleeding, clamp down before hurling them away

description_trans.ko: 먹잇감을 향해 도약하여 사나운 물어뜯기로 출혈을 가합니다. 이미 출혈 중인 적은 붙잡아 멀리 내던집니다.
description_trans.ja: 獲物へ飛びかかって獰猛な噛みつきで出血を付与する。すでに出血中の敵は咥え込んで遠方へ投げ飛ばす。

skills.name: Buddy Barrier
skills.description: Activate the heart-shaped generator to expand a spherical shield that blocks incoming damage. Enemies caught within are Slowed

description_trans.ko: 하트 발생기를 작동시켜 구형 보호막을 펼칩니다. 내부의 적들은 감속됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ハート型ジェネレーターを作動させ球状シールドを展開する。内部の敵にスロウを付与する。

skills.name: Frenzied Feast
skills.description: Unleash a flurry of continuous bites, converting the damage dealt into Bonus Health. Deals extra damage against Bleeding targets

stats.Bonus Damage: First 4 hits: 8% Maximum Health each; 5th hit: 12% Maximum Health

description_trans.ko: 연속으로 물어뜯어 입힌 피해를 추가 체력으로 전환합니다. 출혈 중인 적에게 추가 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 怒涛の連続噛みつきを放ち、与ダメージを追加空力に変換する。出血中の敵には特効ダメージを与える。

skills.name: Prehistoric Plating
skills.description: Take reduced damage from headshots. Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects. Enemies and allies generate less Ultimate Ability Energy when damaging or healing him

description_trans.ko: 패시브: 헤드샷 피해가 감소하며 띄우기 및 넉백에 면역이 됩니다. 자신을 향한 공격이나 치유 시 상대의 궁극기 게이지 충전량이 감소합니다.
description_trans.ja: パッシブ: ヘッドショットダメージを軽減し、打ち上げやノックバックを無効化する。自身への攻撃・回復時のULT充電量を抑制する。

skills.name: Apex Advantage
skills.description: Gain Bonus Health when you inflict Bleeding upon an enemy

description_trans.ko: 패시브: 적에게 출혈을 부여할 때마다 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: パッシブ: 敵に出血を付与するたびに追加空力を獲得する。

skills.name: Prehistoric Partner
skills.description: The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher

description_trans.ko: 퍼니셔가 데빌 다이노소어에 탑승하여 화력을 퍼붓습니다. 탑승 중 공룡이 퍼니셔가 받는 피해의 일부를 대신 흡수합니다.
description_trans.ja: パニッシャーがデビル・ダイナソーに騎乗して射撃を行う。騎乗中、恐竜がパニッシャーの被ダメージの一部を肩代わりする。

teamups.name: PRIMAL PUNISHMENT
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Adds a new ability. Upon activation, Primal Bite is replaced. Devil Dinosaur gains 2 magnetic cannons that can be fired forward; the cannonballs detonate when hitting enemies or the environment.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the duo can request an interaction. Once accepted, The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, The Punisher gains Damage Reduction; Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher.

stats.Special Effect: The explosion applies a Bleed effect to targets

description_trans.ko: 원시 물기(Primal Bite)가 전방으로 발사 가능한 2문의 자기 대포로 교체됩니다. 발사된 포탄은 적이나 지형에 충돌 시 폭발합니다.
description_trans.ja: プライマル・バイトが前方へ発射可能な2門の磁気キャノンに変更される。砲弾は敵や地形に衝突すると爆破する。

teamups.name: PRIMAL PUNISHMENT
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Adds a new ability. Upon activation, Primal Bite is replaced. Devil Dinosaur gains 2 magnetic cannons that can be fired forward; the cannonballs detonate when hitting enemies or the environment.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the duo can request an interaction. Once accepted, The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, The Punisher gains Damage Reduction; Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher.

description_trans.ko: 더 퍼니셔와 함께 플레이 시, 상호 작용 수락을 통해 퍼니셔가 데빌 다이노소어 등에 탑승합니다. 탑승한 퍼니셔는 피해 감소 효과를 얻으며 무기 사용이 제한되고, 데빌 다이노소어가 퍼니셔가 받는 피해의 일부를 대신 흡수합니다.
description_trans.ja: パニッシャーとチームアップ時、相互合意によりパニッシャーが背中に搭乗する。搭乗中のパニッシャーは被ダメージ軽減を得て武装が一部制限され、デビル・ダイナソーがパニッシャーの被ダメージの一部を肩代わりする。

teamups.name: SURF & TURF

While riding, both gain some Damage Reduction and are swirled in therapeutic waters, receiving Continuous Healing. Jeff can only cast Joyful Splash, Aqua Burst, and Healing Bubble during this time.

partner_name.ja: ジェフ・ザ・ランド・シャーク

description_trans.ja: インパクトビームが前方の放水噴射に変更される。この水流は敵にダメージを与えつつ、触れた味方を回復する。

teamups.name: SURF & TURF
teamups.description:

partner_name.ja: ジェフ・ザ・ランド・シャーク

description_trans.ko: 제프 더 랜드 샤크와 함께 플레이 시, 제프가 데빌 다이노소어 머리 위에 탑승할 수 있습니다. 탑승 중 둘 다 피해 감소 효과를 얻고 치유의 물결에 휩싸여 지속 치유를 받습니다.
description_trans.ja: ジェフ・ザ・ランドシャークとチームアップ時、ジェフがデビル・ダイナソーの頭上に搭乗できる。搭乗中、双方が被ダメージ軽減を獲得し、癒やしの水流に包まれて持続回復を受ける。

names.ja: ドクター・ストレンジ

skills.name: Daggers of Denak
skills.description: Cast Daggers of Denak forward

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 80% at 20m
stats.Fire Rate: 6.25 rounds per second, with a 0.03-second interval between every two rounds

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 데낙의 단검(Daggers of Denak)을 연속 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へデナックの短剣(Daggers of Denak)を連続投擲する。

skills.name: Shield of the Seraphim
skills.description: Create a protective barrier against damage

description_trans.ko: 세라핌의 방패(Shield of the Seraphim)를 전개하여 전방의 모든 피해를 막아내는 거대 방벽을 형성합니다.
description_trans.ja: セラフィムの盾を展開し、前方のダメージを防ぐ巨大な防御バリアを形成する。

skills.name: Eye of Agamotto
skills.description: Separate nearby enemies' Souls from their bodies. Damage dealt to these Souls is transferred to their physical bodies

stats.Casting: Single-cast spell field that surrounds the caster

description_trans.ko: 아가모토의 눈(Eye of Agamotto)을 발동하여 주변 적들의 영혼을 육체에서 강제로 분리합니다. 영혼에 가해진 피해는 본체 육체로 100% 전이됩니다.
description_trans.ja: アガモットの瞳を発動し、周囲の敵の魂を肉体から強制分離する。分離した魂に与えたダメージは本体の肉体へ転移する。

skills.name: Cloak of Levitation
skills.description: Ascend and then enter a brief state of sustained flight

description_trans.ko: 레비테이션 망토를 이용해 수직 상승한 뒤 잠시 동안 자유로운 비행 상태에 돌입합니다.
description_trans.ja: 浮遊マントで垂直上昇し、短時間の持続飛行状態に入る。

skills.name: Maelstrom of Madness
skills.description: Release Dark Magic to deal damage to nearby enemies

description_trans.ko: 광기의 소용돌이(Maelstrom of Madness)를 방출하여 주변의 모든 적에게 암흑 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

skills.name: PSIONIC VORTEX
skills.description: Invisible Woman enhances Doctor Strange's Maelstrom of Madness with a psionic explosion. The explosion damages and pulls enemies toward Doctor Strange. Based on the explosion's damage, Doctor Strange and nearby allies gain Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 인비저블 우먼이 사이오닉 폭발로 닥터 스트레인지의 Maelstrom of Madness를 강화합니다. 폭발 시 적들에게 피해를 주고 닥터 스트레인지 쪽으로 끌어당기며, 입힌 피해에 비례해 닥터 스트레인지와 주변 아군이 추가 체력을 얻습니다.
description_trans.ja: インビジブル・ウーマンがサイキック爆発でドクター・ストレンジのMaelstrom of Madnessを強化する。爆発時に敵を引き寄せてダメージを与え、与ダメージに応じて自身と周囲の味方に追加空力を付与する。

skills.name: Pentagram of Farallah
skills.description: Open portals between two locations, enabling all units to travel through them

description_trans.ko: 파랄라의 펜타그램(Pentagram of Farallah)을 펼쳐 두 지점 사이에 차원 차원문을 열어 모든 아군과 투사체가 순간이동할 수 있게 합니다.
description_trans.ja: ファララのペンタグラムを展開し、2地点間にポータルを開いて全味方や弾丸の瞬間移動を可能にする。

skills.name: Price of Magic

description_trans.ko: 적 적중 시 암흑 마법 게이지가 축적됩니다. 게이지가 최대치에 도달하여 장시간 유지되면 마법의 대가로 치유 차단 저주에 걸립니다.
description_trans.ja: 敵へ命中ごとに暗黒魔法が蓄積する。最大状態が長く持続すると、代償として回復不能(アンチヒール)の呪いを受ける。

skills.name: Enchanted Enhancement
skills.description: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery, replacing Scarlet Witch's Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction

description_trans.ko: 닥터 스트레인지가 비전 마법의 정수를 공유하여, 스칼렛 위치의 Chthonian Burst를 Mystic Burst로 대체합니다. 공격 버튼을 유지하면 목표 방향으로 마법 미사일을 쉼 없이 고속 난사합니다.
description_trans.ja: ドクター・ストレンジが秘術の極意を共有し、スカーレット・ウィッチのChthonian BurstをMystic Burstへ強化する。長押しで目標方向へ魔法弾の猛烈な連続掃射を浴びせる。

teamups.name: GAMMA MAELSTROM

stats.Damage: Each point of Dark Magic deals 1.3 damage.

description_trans.ja: メイルストロム・オブ・マッドネスがガンマ・メイルストロムへと強化される。エネルギー充填速度が大幅に向上し、回復阻害ペナルティが削除される。

partner_name.ja: インビジブル・ウーマン

partner_name.ja: インビジブル・ウーマン

description_trans.ko: 인비저블 우먼과 함께 플레이 시, 사이오닉 소용돌이로 적에게 입힌 피해에 비례하여 닥터 스트레인지가 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: インビジブル・ウーマンとチームアップ時、サイオニック・ヴォルテックスが敵に与えたダメージに比例して、ドクター・ストレンジが追加体力を獲得する。

skills.name: JUSTICE JAB

skills.name: Sonic Pursuit

stats.Special Effect: Deflects projectiles from all directions while becoming invincible

description_trans.ja: 異議あり！(Objection!)が強化される。回転するビリークラブが全方向からの投擲物を跳ね返しつつ、範囲内の全敵にダメージを与える。攻撃の跳ね返しに成功すると怒り(Fury)が回復する。

description_trans.ko: 아이언 피스트와 함께 플레이 시, 스킬이 지속되는 동안 데어데블이 지속적으로 체력을 회복합니다.

description_trans.ja: デビル・チェーンを十字に振り回し、前方の敵にダメージを与えて減速効果(Slow)を付与する。

			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Widow, the damage radius is expanded, and landing hits recovers Fury.

description_trans.ko: 블랙 위도우와 함께 플레이 시, 공격 반경이 확장되며 적에게 적중 시 분노(Fury)를 회복합니다.
description_trans.ja: ブラック・ウィドウとチームアップ時、攻撃半径が拡大し、命中時に怒り(Fury)を回復する。

names.ja: エルサ・ブラッドストーン

skills.name: DOUBLE-BARREL BLASTER
skills.description: Fire your shotgun forward

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 70% at 30m
stats.Fire Rate: The firing interval between shots is 0.12s, with an interval of 0.8s between each round of shooting

description_trans.ko: 더블 배럴 산탄총을 전방으로 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: ダブルバレル・ショットガンを前方へ発射する。

skills.name: MONSTER-PIERCER
skills.description: Unleash your elephant gun forward. Bullets pierce enemies and deal high damage

description_trans.ko: 몬스터 피어서 대구경 엘리펀트 건을 발사합니다. 탄환이 적을 관통하며 치명적인 피해를 줍니다.
description_trans.ja: モンスターピアサー大口径銃を放つ。弾丸が敵を貫通し大ダメージを与える。

skills.name: LIVING BULLET
skills.description: Fire a Living Bullet round that splits upon impact, seeking nearby enemies and marking each with a Spectral Sigil. Hitting marked targets with Double-Barrel Blaster or Monster-Piercer grants Elsa a brief Speed boost. Living Bullets deal extra damage to shields and enemies with Bonus Health

stats.Special Effect 1: After hits an enemy, the projectile splits to several bullets to trace the enemies in range
stats.Special Effect 2: Projectile deals 40 extra damage to shields and enemies with bonus health

description_trans.ko: 살아있는 탄환을 발사하여 착탄 시 분열 유도되며 적에게 유령 인장을 남깁니다. 표식 적중 시 이동 속도가 증가하며 보호막과 추가 체력에 추가 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 生ける弾丸を放ち、着弾時に分裂して敵を追尾し印を刻む。印の敵への攻撃で加速し、シールドや追加空力に特効ダメージを与える。

skills.name: BLOODSTONE'S BOOMBOX BULLETS
skills.description: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range are healed! Elsa Bloodstone's Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. Elsa can recall the rounds to heal based on damage dealt

description_trans.ko: 데드풀과 제프, 엘사 블러드스톤의 연계 능력입니다. 엘사의 탄환이 데드풀의 수다로 적을 도발하고 감속시키며, 회수 시 체력을 회복합니다.
description_trans.ja: デッドプール、ジェフ、エルサの連携スキル。エルサの弾丸がデッドプールの挑発音声を放ち、スロウと持続ダメージを与え、弾丸回収時に体力を回復する。

skills.name: APEX PREDATOR
skills.description: Summon the Glartrox to charge forward. The Glartrox can be recalled to charge back toward Elsa. When colliding with terrain or upon return, it bites fiercely, dealing heavy damage

stats.Special Effect 1: Enemies seized by Glartrox cannot use their abilities until it stops moving
stats.Special Effect 2: Elsa can recall Glartrox at any time
stats.Special Effect 3: When the Glartrox collides with terrain, returns, or reaches its maximum dash duration, it bites fiercely, dealing massive damage. If Glartrox is defeated, the bite will not be triggered
stats.Glartrox Maximum Dash Duration: Maximum durations for dashing and returning are 3.5s each
stats.Special Effect: Glartrox cannot be critical hit. Drag 8 targets at most

description_trans.ko: 괴수 글라트록스를 소환하여 돌진시킵니다. 다시 불러들여 복귀 경로의 적들을 물어뜯게 할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: 怪獣グラートロックスを召喚して突進させる。呼び戻して再度突進させ、激しい噛みつきで大ダメージを与える。

skills.name: HELIX ADVANCE
skills.description: Dash forward. Your next Double-Barrel Blaster becomes Monster-Piercer

stats.Special Effect: In 6s after unleashing Helix Advance, the next Double-Barrel Blaster becomes Monster-Piercer
stats.Special Effect 2: Every unleash of Ruthless Pursuit and Helix Advance grants 25 bonus health. Max bonus health is 75

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 신속하게 대시합니다. 다음 더블 배럴 사격이 강력한 Monster-Piercer로 강화됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ素早くダッシュする。次の通常射撃が強力なMonster-Piercerへと強化される。

skills.name: RUTHLESS PURSUIT
skills.description: Dash forward, gaining Bonus Health and launching enemies hit. Follow up with a Double-Barrel Blaster shot that propels you backward and Slows enemies. Using either stage empowers your next Double-Barrel Blaster, transforming it into Monster-Piercer

stats.Special Effect 1: Launch up enemies hit, and activate the follow up in 5s
stats.Special Effect 2: Using either stage empowers your next Double-Barrel Blaster, transforming it into Monster-Piercer
stats.Bonus Health: Every unleash of Ruthless Pursuit and Helix Advance grants 25 bonus health. Max bonus health is 75

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 돌진하여 추가 체력을 얻고 적을 띄운 뒤, 후방 반동 사격으로 적을 감속시키며 다음 사격을 강화합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ突進して追加空力を獲得し敵を打ち上げ、反動射撃で敵を減速させつつ次の射撃を強化する。

skills.name: SMOKY SNARE
skills.description: Launch a trap containing the monster Diablo. Once deployed, it becomes Invisible and Invulnerable. When an enemy triggers it, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. Use to dash to the trapped enemy. Enemies can destroy Diablo to break free

stats.Special Effect 1: The trap becomes Invisible and Invulnerable after one-second deployment
stats.Special Effect 2: Defeat the summon to end the Immobolized state early
stats.Special Effect 3: Elsa can dash to the enemy who triggers the trap

description_trans.ko: 괴수 디아블로가 든 덫을 설치합니다. 투명 무적 상태로 잠복하다가 적이 밟으면 속박하고 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 怪獣ディアブロのトラップを投擲設置する。透明・無敵で潜伏し、敵が作動させると拘束してダメージを与える。

skills.name: INHERITED INSTINCT
skills.description: Dealing damage increases hunting Instinct. Defeating enemies caught by Smoky Snare grants additional Instinct. Higher Instinct reduces the cooldown of Helix Advance

stats.Special Effect 1: Instinct levels up when it reaches 100, up to 3 levels
stats.Special Effect 2: For each Instinct level gained, reduce the cooldown of Helix Advance by 2s

description_trans.ko: 피해를 입힐 때 사냥 본능이 상승하며, 본능이 높을수록 Helix Advance의 재사용 대기시간이 단축됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ダメージを与えると狩猟本能が上昇し、本能が高いほどHelix Advanceのクールダウンが短縮される。

teamups.name: PREHISTORIC TRAP
teamups.description:
Base Effect: After deploying the Smoky Snare trap, Diablo will monitor the area. If enemies approach, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. He also releases a lethal gas, causing continuous area damage.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Devil Dinosaur, Elsa can store and deploy two Smoky Snares.

description_trans.ko: 연막 덫(Smoky Snare)을 배치한 후 디아블로가 해당 구역을 감시합니다. 적이 접근하면 디아블로가 대상을 속박(Immobilize)하고 피해를 입히며, 치명적인 가스를 방출하여 지속적인 범위 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: スモーキースネアの罠を設置すると、ディアブロがそのエリアを監視する。敵が接近すると拘束(Immobilize)してダメージを与え、さらに致死性のガスを放出して持続範囲ダメージを与える。

teamups.name: PREHISTORIC TRAP
teamups.description:
Base Effect: After deploying the Smoky Snare trap, Diablo will monitor the area. If enemies approach, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. He also releases a lethal gas, causing continuous area damage.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Devil Dinosaur, Elsa can store and deploy two Smoky Snares.

stats.Special Effect: Up to 2 Smoky Snares can exist on the field simultaneously

description_trans.ko: 데빌 다이노소어와 함께 플레이 시, 엘사가 연막 덫을 최대 2개까지 충전 및 배치할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: デビル・ダイナソーとチームアップ時、エルサがスモーキースネアを最大2回までチャージ・設置できるようになる。

teamups.name: LOUDMOUTH MERCS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. After a timer, the bullet auto-recalls, healing Elsa based on the damage dealt while adding one extra gauge block to her Inherited Instinct passive cap.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, Deadpool breaks the fourth wall, significantly boosting Instinct acquisition rate.

description_trans.ko: 살아있는 탄환(Living Bullet)이 데드풀의 수다로 대상을 도발(Taunt)하는 특수 탄환으로 교체되며, 주변 적들에게 둔화(Slow)와 지속 피해를 입힙니다. 일정 시간 후 탄환이 자동으로 회수되며 입힌 피해에 비례해 엘사를 치유하고, 엘사의 타고난 본능(Inherited Instinct) 패시브 최대 게이지를 1칸 확장합니다.
description_trans.ja: リヴィング・バレットがデッドプールの軽口でターゲットを挑発(Taunt)する特殊弾に変化し、周囲の敵を減速させ持続ダメージを与える。一定時間後に弾丸が自動回収され、与ダメージに応じてエルサを回復し、パッシブ『受け継がれし本能』の最大ゲージを1本増加させる。

teamups.name: LOUDMOUTH MERCS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. After a timer, the bullet auto-recalls, healing Elsa based on the damage dealt while adding one extra gauge block to her Inherited Instinct passive cap.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, Deadpool breaks the fourth wall, significantly boosting Instinct acquisition rate.

description_trans.ko: 데드풀과 함께 플레이 시, 데드풀이 제4의 벽을 깨부수며 본능(Instinct) 게이지 획득 속도가 대폭 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: デッドプールとチームアップ時、デッドプールが第四の壁を破り、本能(Instinct)ゲージの獲得速度が大幅に上昇する。

skills.name: TELEPATHIC PULSE
skills.description: Fire a psionic beam to deal damage; the longer the beam hits, the higher the damage

stats.Damage: Damage increases with energy: 0 - 70/s, 99 - 110/s, full energy - 140/s
stats.Special Effect: Energy gain: Hero hit: 12/s; Sentience hit: 18/s; Common summons hit: 5/s; Shield hit: 6/s. Falloff begins 4s after not hitting an enemy, at a rate of 30/s

description_trans.ko: 사이오닉 광선을 발사합니다. 광선을 오래 적중시킬수록 피해량이 지속적으로 상승합니다.
description_trans.ja: サイキックビームを照射する。照射時間が持続するほど与ダメージが上昇する。

skills.name: FACETED FURY
skills.description: In Diamond Form, deliver a crushing double-fisted strike to enemies

stats.Damage: First & second hit: 50; third hit: 70; fourth hit: 80

description_trans.ko: 다이아몬드 폼에서 양 주먹으로 적을 분쇄하는 강타를 내리꽂습니다.
description_trans.ja: ダイヤモンド形態で両拳による粉砕打撃を叩き込む。

skills.name: MIND'S AEGIS
skills.description: Create a levitating barrier at the designated location

description_trans.ko: 목표 위치에 부유하는 정신의 방벽(Mind's Aegis)을 생성하여 피해를 차단합니다.
description_trans.ja: 指定位置に浮遊バリアを展開し、敵の攻撃を防ぐ。

skills.name: CRYSTAL KICK
skills.description: In Diamond Form, unleash a flying kick forward and knock back enemies; extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall

stats.Damage: Hit damage: 40; damage increases to 90 when the target is knocked into walls
stats.Special Effect: Maximum knockback distance: 10m

description_trans.ko: 다이아몬드 폼에서 전방으로 날아차기를 가해 적을 밀쳐내며, 적이 벽에 충돌하면 추가 벽쿵 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: ダイヤモンド形態で前方へ飛び蹴りを放ち敵をノックバックする。壁に衝突させると追加ダメージを与える。

skills.name: PSIONIC SEDUCTION
skills.description: Project a forward psychic assault that stuns foes and prevents them from unleashing their Ultimate Abilities; if the effect lingers, it gradually commandeers their mind, forcing them to move toward Emma Frost

stats.Range: Cone shape spell field, angle range: 80°, length: 30m
stats.Damage: Basic damage 80/s; distance falloff: falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 70% at 30m; angle falloff: falloff begins at 7° from the center of view, decreasing to 80% at 20°
stats.Special Effect: When exposed to the ability, enemies accumulate 10 stacks per second, and the stacks decrease by 10 stacks per second when they leave the exposure. At 15 stacks, a control effect is triggered. Each enemy can only be controlled once per ultimate activation. Gain 25% Damage Reduction during the ability.

description_trans.ko: 정신 공격을 전방으로 투사하여 적을 기절시키고 궁극기 사용을 봉쇄하며, 지속 시 정신을 조종해 엠마 프로스트 쪽으로 걸어오게 만듭니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方に精神波を放ち、敵をスタンさせULTを封殺する。持続すると精神を支配し、エマの元へ歩み寄らせる。

skills.name: DIAMOND FORM
skills.description: Activate Diamond Form to transform your attack style while gaining Damage Reduction and becoming Unstoppable

stats.Special Effect: 25% Damage Reduction in Diamond form

description_trans.ko: 다이아몬드 폼을 발동하여 전투 스타일을 근접으로 바꾸고, 피해 감소와 함께 저지 불가(Unstoppable) 상태가 됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ダイヤモンド形態を起動して近接格闘へと切り替え、被ダメージ軽減と阻止不能(アンストッパブル)を得る。

skills.name: PSYCHIC SPEAR
skills.description: Seize control of an enemy's sentience—damage dealt to the sentience cascades to the physical form and can be pierced by Telepathic Pulse. When the sentience shatters, it unleashes extra damage on its owner

stats.Damage: Deal 5 damage per direct hit. When the sentience shatters, it deals damage to the target, which is equal to 25% of the target's maximum health
stats.Special Effect: When the distance between the target and its sentience is more than 15m, their linkage can be broken

description_trans.ko: 적의 지각체를 분리 장악합니다. 지각체에 가해진 피해는 본체로 전이되며, 파괴 시 본체에 추가 폭발 피해를 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 敵の知覚体を掌握する。知覚体へのダメージは本体へ転移し、破壊時に本体へ追加爆発ダメージを与える。

skills.name: CARBON CRUSH
skills.description: In Diamond Form, lunge forward to grab an enemy, then execute a back slam to inflict damage

stats.Special Effect: Control effect duration: 1.6s

description_trans.ko: 다이아몬드 폼에서 전방으로 돌진하여 적을 붙잡은 뒤 뒤로 내리찍어 강력한 피해를 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: ダイヤモンド形態で突進して敵を掴み、後方へ叩きつけて大ダメージを与える。

skills.name: ICED OUT DIAMOND
skills.description: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Iron Fist and Emma Frost. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recovery, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi. Emma Frost can project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. She can also enhance her diamond form, condensing frost into an Absolute Zero Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement

stats.Spell Field Range: A fan-shaped spell field with a radius of 12m, a height of 3m, and an angle of 60°

description_trans.ko: 루나 스노우의 한기를 받아 전방으로 얼음 에너지를 방출해 감속시키고, 절대영도 다이아몬드 방벽을 전개해 적의 공격과 이동을 완벽히 차단합니다.
description_trans.ja: ルナ・スノーの冷気を得て氷のエネルギーを放ちスロウを付与、絶対零度のダイヤモンド障壁で敵の攻撃と移動を完全に遮断する。

teamups.name: SPIRIT BREAKER
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Deals damage to the summoned Soul Crystal, which can be converted into Bonus Healthfor yourself.
			Enhanced Effect: When Emma Frost teams up with Mantis, shattering the Soul Crystalgrants a one-time Bonus Healthand reduces the cooldown of Mind Control.

description_trans.ko: 소환된 영혼 수정(Soul Crystal)에 피해를 입히면, 해당 피해를 자신의 추가 체력으로 전환합니다.
description_trans.ja: 召喚されたソウル・クリスタルにダメージを与えることで、自身への追加体力へと変換できる。

teamups.name: SPIRIT BREAKER
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Deals damage to the summoned Soul Crystal, which can be converted into Bonus Healthfor yourself.
			Enhanced Effect: When Emma Frost teams up with Mantis, shattering the Soul Crystalgrants a one-time Bonus Healthand reduces the cooldown of Mind Control.

description_trans.ko: 맨티스와 함께 플레이 시, 영혼 수정을 파괴하면 1회성 추가 체력을 즉시 획득하고 정신 지배(Mind Control)의 재사용 대기시간이 감소합니다.
description_trans.ja: マンティスとチームアップ時、ソウル・クリスタルを粉砕すると即座に一度限りの追加体力を獲得し、マインドコントロールのクールダウンが短縮される。

teamups.name: ICED OUT DIAMOND
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Emma Frost releases winter energy forward, dealing damage and Slowto enemies. She can also enhance her diamond form, condensing frost in front of her to form Zero Diamondthat blocks enemy attacks and movement.
			Enhanced Effect: When Emma Frost teams up with Luna Snow, after activating Diamond Form, all ability damage applies Slow, and Soul Wavealso applies Slow.

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 겨울 에너지를 방출하여 적들에게 피해와 둔화(Slow)를 부여합니다. 또한 다이아몬드 형태를 강화하여 전방에 냉기를 응축해 적의 공격과 이동을 차단하는 제로 다이아몬드(Zero Diamond)를 형성할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ冷気エネルギーを放ち、敵にダメージと減速(Slow)を与える。さらにダイヤモンド形態を強化し、前方に霜を凝縮させて敵の攻撃や移動を遮断するゼロ・ダイヤモンドを形成できる。

teamups.name: ICED OUT DIAMOND
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Emma Frost releases winter energy forward, dealing damage and Slowto enemies. She can also enhance her diamond form, condensing frost in front of her to form Zero Diamondthat blocks enemy attacks and movement.
			Enhanced Effect: When Emma Frost teams up with Luna Snow, after activating Diamond Form, all ability damage applies Slow, and Soul Wavealso applies Slow.

stats.Telepathic Pulse Added Slow Effect: Scales with energy, up to 10% at 100 energy

description_trans.ko: 루나 스노우와 함께 플레이 시, 다이아몬드 형태 활성화 후 모든 스킬 피해에 둔화(Slow)가 적용되며 영혼 파동(Soul Wave)에도 둔화가 적용됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ルナ・スノーとチームアップ時、ダイヤモンド形態発動後、すべてのスキルダメージに減速(Slow)が付与され、ソウル・ウェーブにも減速効果が付与される。

skills.name: Vine Strike
skills.description: Launch vines to attack enemies

description_trans.ko: 덩굴을 뻗어 전방의 적들을 타격합니다.
description_trans.ja: 蔦を伸ばして前方の敵を攻撃する。

skills.name: Spore Bomb
skills.description: Throw an explosive Spore Bomb that splits into multiple small explosive spores

stats.Casting: Single-cast projectile with a downward delay that creates a spell field upon impact
stats.Range: Spore Bomb generates a spell field with a 5m spherical radius, while small explosive spores create a spell field with a 1.5m spherical radius
stats.Damage: The projectile itself deals no damage, while Spore Bomb deals 55 damage and explosive spores deal 10 damage
stats.Special Effect: Spore Bomb explodes into 6 explosive spores

description_trans.ko: 폭발성 포자 폭탄을 던져 여러 개의 작은 분열 포자 폭탄으로 폭발시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: 爆発性胞子ボムを投擲し、複数の小型爆発胞子に分裂させる。

skills.name: Strangling Prison
skills.description: Fire a massive vine cluster that pulls nearby enemies to its center and Imprisons them

stats.Casting: Single-cast projectile with a downward delay that creates a spell field upon impact
stats.Damage: The projectile deals 10 damage, while the spell field deals 70 damage. While imprisoning enemies, it deals 20 damage every 0.5s
stats.Special Effect: Imprison enemies for 3.5s

description_trans.ko: 거대한 덩굴 뭉치를 발사하여 주변 적들을 중심으로 끌어당기고 감금합니다.
description_trans.ja: 巨大な蔦の塊を発射し、周囲の敵を中心へと引き寄せて拘束する。

skills.name: Thornlash Wall
skills.description: Target a location and grow a Thornlash Wall. When Awakened, it strikes nearby enemies attacked by Groot and his allies

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 6s to recharge
stats.Special Effect: Thornlash Wall deals 60 damage every 0.5s

description_trans.ko: 목표 위치에 가시나무 벽(Thornlash Wall)을 생성합니다. 벽이 각성하면 그루트와 아군이 공격하는 주변 적을 가시로 함께 공격합니다.
description_trans.ja: 目標地点に茨の壁を展開する。覚醒時、グルートや味方が攻撃した周囲の敵を追撃する。

skills.name: Ironwood Wall
skills.description: Target a location and grow an Ironwood Wall. When the wall is Awakened, damage dealt by Groot and nearby allies grants Groot Bonus Health. Groot gains Unstoppable while near Ironwood Walls

stats.Special Effect: Ironwood Wall heals 50 Bonus Health per second, up to 250 Bonus Health; gain Unstoppable status when within 15m of Awakened Ironwood Walls

description_trans.ko: 목표 위치에 단단한 아이언우드 벽(Ironwood Wall)을 생성합니다. 벽이 각성하면 그루트와 주변 아군이 입힌 피해에 비례해 그루트가 추가 체력을 얻으며, 벽 근처에서 저지 불가 상태가 됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 目標地点に硬質なアイアンウッドの壁を展開する。覚醒時、グルートや味方の与ダメージに応じてグルートが追加空力を獲得し、壁の近くで阻止不能状態となる。

skills.name: Wild Wall
skills.description: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Flower Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost

description_trans.ko: 맨티스가 생명 에너지로 그루트의 나무 벽과 로키의 룬스톤을 강화합니다. 그루트는 꽃나무 벽(Flower Wall)을 추가로 생성할 수 있으며, Flora Colossus 상태일 때 주변 아군의 체력을 무작위로 회복시키고 받는 피해를 감소시킵니다. 로키의 룬스톤은 치유 영역 내 아군의 공격력을 강화합니다.
description_trans.ja: マンティスが生命エネルギーでグルートの木の壁とロキのルーンストーンを強化する。グルートは花の壁を追加展開可能になり、Flora Colossus状態時に周囲の味方を回復して被ダメージを軽減する。ロキのルーンストーンは再生領域内の味方の攻撃力を上昇させる。

skills.name: Furious Flora
skills.description: Perform a combo with his arms, and the third strike will slightly Launch Up the hit enemy airborne

stats.Range: The first two strikes can reach 3m, while the third strike can reach 4m

description_trans.ko: 양팔로 연속 콤보를 가하며, 3타 공격 시 적중당한 적을 공중으로 살짝 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 両腕で連続コンボを繰り出し、3打目で命中した敵をわずかに打ち上げる。

skills.name: Flora Colossus
skills.description: Wooden walls near Groot will Awaken, activating an extra effect. Right-click while building a wooden wall to continue building additional walls

stats.Casting: Persistent spell field that surrounds the caster
stats.Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 24m radius and a height of 40m

description_trans.ko: 그루트 주변의 나무 벽들이 각성하여 추가 특수 효과를 발휘합니다. 나무 벽을 설치하는 도중 우클릭하여 추가 벽을 연속으로 설치할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: グルート周囲の木の壁が覚醒し、追加効果が発動する。木の壁設置中に右クリックで追加の壁を連続設置できる。

teamups.name: WILD WALL
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Summon a Wild Wall that provides Continuous Healing and Bonus Health to allies within its range.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, the Wild Wall evolves after providing a certain amount of healing, increasing its healing

description_trans.ko: 범위 내 아군에게 지속 치유와 추가 체력을 제공하는 야생의 벽(Wild Wall)을 소환합니다.
description_trans.ja: 範囲内の味方に持続回復と追加体力を提供するワイルド・ウォールを召喚する。

teamups.name: WILD WALL
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Summon a Wild Wall that provides Continuous Healing and Bonus Health to allies within its range.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, the Wild Wall evolves after providing a certain amount of healing, increasing its healing

description_trans.ko: 맨티스와 함께 플레이 시, 야생의 벽이 일정량의 치유를 제공한 후 진화하여 치유량이 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: マンティスとチームアップ時、ワイルド・ウォールが一定量の回復を提供した後に進化し、回復量が増加する。

teamups.name: BUBBLE BUDDIES
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Retreat inside a Bubble Shield to enter an Invincible state, granting self-targeted Continuous Healing.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, the healing effect inside the bubble is enhanced, and any excess healing converts into Bonus Health.

partner_name.ja: ジェフ・ザ・ランド・シャーク

description_trans.ko: 거품 보호막(Bubble Shield) 안으로 물러나 무적 상태가 되며 자신에게 지속 치유를 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: バブルシールドの中に退避して無敵状態となり、自身へ持続回復を付与する。

teamups.name: BUBBLE BUDDIES
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Retreat inside a Bubble Shield to enter an Invincible state, granting self-targeted Continuous Healing.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, the healing effect inside the bubble is enhanced, and any excess healing converts into Bonus Health.

partner_name.ja: ジェフ・ザ・ランド・シャーク

description_trans.ko: 제프 더 랜드 샤크와 함께 플레이 시, 거품 내부의 치유 효과가 강화되고 초과 치유량이 추가 체력으로 전환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ジェフ・ザ・ランドシャークとチームアップ時、バブル内部の回復効果が強化され、超過回復分が追加体力へと変換される。

role_name.ja: ストラテジスト (サポート)

skills.name: Kinetic Cards
skills.description: Launch three kinetic-charged cards in an arc ahead. Each card detonates on impact, creating a single-target explosion that damages enemies and heals allies

stats.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory

description_trans.ko: 에너지가 충전된 카드 3장을 호형으로 던집니다. 카드가 적중 시 폭발하여 적에게 피해를 주고 아군을 치유합니다.
description_trans.ja: エネルギーを込めたカード3枚を扇状に投擲する。命中時に爆発し、敵にダメージを与え味方を回復する。

skills.name: Bayou Bash
skills.description: Channel kinetic energy into the bo staff, then slam it into the ground after a sweeping strike, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and heals allies

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 8s to recharge

description_trans.ko: 봉에 에너지를 불어넣어 전방을 후려친 뒤 지면을 내리찍어 충격파를 일으키며 적에게 피해를 주고 아군을 치유합니다.
description_trans.ja: 棍棒にエネルギーを注ぎ、薙ぎ払ってから地面へ叩きつけて衝撃波を放ち、敵を攻撃し味方を回復する。

skills.name: Ragin' Royal Flush
skills.description: Lock onto an ally within sight and unleash multiple Aces that heal and Purify. Both enter the Kinetic Transfer state, granting increased Movement Speed and Jump Boost, while enhancing attacks with additional single-target explosive damage and providing the ally with Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration

stats.Range: Cone shape spell field, angle range: 110°, length: 40m
stats.Special Effect: Gambit and the targeted ally receive the Purify and Jump Boost effect.

description_trans.ko: 아군을 지정해 에이스 카드를 발사하여 정화하고 치유합니다. 두 영웅 모두 운동 전이 상태가 되어 속도와 점프력이 상승하고 공격에 폭발 피해가 추가되며 아군의 궁극기 충전 속도가 가속됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 味方をロックオンしてエースカードを放ち回復・浄化する。両者が運動伝達状態となり、移動力上昇と攻撃への爆発ダメージ追加、味方のULT充電加速を得る。

skills.name: Cajun Charge
skills.description: Side-step forward with bo staff in hand, dashing a short distance

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 12.5s to recharge.

description_trans.ko: 봉을 쥐고 측면으로 발을 디디며 전방으로 짧고 날렵하게 돌진합니다.
description_trans.ja: 棍棒を構えて素早くステップし、前方へ短距離ダッシュする。

skills.name: Healing Hearts
skills.description: Conjure a Heart card by consuming one stack of  Sleight of Hand to Heal and switch to the Healing Hearts deck

stats.Cooldown: 4 charges, with each charge taking 8s to recharge.
stats.Self Healing: Heal 30 health per second within duration
stats.Special Effect: Within the duration, consume one stack of Sleight of Hand to use Bridge Boost and Purifying Pick-Up.

description_trans.ko: 손재주 스택을 소모해 하트 카드를 뽑아 치유하고 힐링 하트 덱으로 전환합니다.
description_trans.ja: 手品スタックを消費してハートのカードを引き当て、回復を行いつつHealing Heartsデッキへと切り替える。

skills.name: Breaking Spades
skills.description: Conjure a Spade card by consuming one stack of  Sleight of Hand to gain Damage Boost and switch to the Breaking Spades deck

stats.Cooldown: 4 charges, with each charge taking 8s to recharge
stats.Special Effect: Within the duration, consume one stack of Sleight of Hand to use Explosive Trick and Bidding Barrage

description_trans.ko: 손재주 스택을 소모해 스페이드 카드를 뽑아 공격력을 높이고 브레이킹 스페이드 덱으로 전환합니다.
description_trans.ja: 手品スタックを消費してスペードのカードを引き当て、攻撃力を高めつつBreaking Spadesデッキへと切り替える。

skills.name: ACE OF ACES
skills.description: Gambit charges Magneto's greatsword with kinetic energy. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking enemies. The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay

description_trans.ko: 마그네토의 대검에 운동 에너지를 주입하여 에이스 대검으로 강화합니다. 적 타격 시 폭발하며 잔류 에너지가 2차 폭발 피해를 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: マグニートーの大剣に運動エネルギーを注入して強化する。命中時に爆発し、残余エネルギーが2次ダメージを与える。

teamups.name: FAVORABLE ODDS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Throw two magnetic playing cards forward. Upon hitting the environment or a character, the two cards magnetically repel and unfurl, spinning in place for a duration. They heal allies they hit, while damaging and Launchingenemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, after the duration ends, the magnetic poles of the two cards reverse. They violently slam back together and explode, providing an extra burst of healing to allies and damage to enemies.

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 두 장의 자기 카드를 던집니다. 지형이나 영웅에게 충돌 시 두 카드가 자력으로 반발하며 펼쳐져 제자리에서 일정 시간 회전합니다. 카드는 닿은 아군을 치유하고 적에게는 피해를 입히며 공중으로 띄워 올립니다(Launch).
description_trans.ja: 前方へ2枚の磁気トランプを投擲する。地形や敵味方に当たると2枚のカードが磁力で反発して展開し、一定時間その場で高速回転する。接触した味方を回復し、敵にはダメージを与えて打ち上げる(Launch)。

teamups.name: FAVORABLE ODDS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Throw two magnetic playing cards forward. Upon hitting the environment or a character, the two cards magnetically repel and unfurl, spinning in place for a duration. They heal allies they hit, while damaging and Launchingenemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, after the duration ends, the magnetic poles of the two cards reverse. They violently slam back together and explode, providing an extra burst of healing to allies and damage to enemies.

description_trans.ko: 매그니토와 함께 플레이 시, 지속 시간이 끝난 후 두 카드의 자극이 역전됩니다. 두 카드가 격렬하게 다시 충돌하며 폭발하여 아군에게 추가 폭발 치유를, 적에게 추가 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: マグニートーとチームアップ時、効果時間終了後に2枚のカードの磁極が反転する。激しく引き合って激突・爆発し、味方に追加の瞬間回復を、敵に追加ダメージを与える。

teamups.name: SPARKLING STAFF
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Twirl your firework-energy enhanced bo staff. The radiating firework sparks provide healing to nearby allies. Concurrently, the staff deals damage to close-range enemies, and the rapid spinning blocks incoming damage from most projectiles.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, both Bayou Bashand Big Easy Impactgain an additional Continuous Healingaura.

description_trans.ko: 폭죽 에너지가 깃든 봉을 회전시킵니다. 방출되는 폭죽 불꽃이 주변 아군을 치유합니다. 동시에 근거리 적에게 피해를 입히며 봉의 빠른 회전이 대부분의 적 투사체를 막아냅니다.
description_trans.ja: 花火エネルギーを宿した棒を回転させる。放射される花火スパークが周囲の味方を回復する。同時に近距離の敵にダメージを与え、高速回転により大半の敵投擲物をブロックする。

teamups.name: SPARKLING STAFF
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Twirl your firework-energy enhanced bo staff. The radiating firework sparks provide healing to nearby allies. Concurrently, the staff deals damage to close-range enemies, and the rapid spinning blocks incoming damage from most projectiles.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, both Bayou Bashand Big Easy Impactgain an additional Continuous Healingaura.

description_trans.ko: 쥬빌리와 함께 플레이 시, 바이유 배쉬(Bayou Bash)와 빅 이지 임팩트(Big Easy Impact) 사용 시 추가 지속 치유 오라가 부여됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ジュビリーとチームアップ時、バイユー・バッシュおよびビッグイージー・インパクト発動時に追加の持続回復オーラを獲得する。
