skills.description: While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to card spring and fire a full deck forward. Cards bounce between allies on impact, granting Health and a Healing Boost

stats.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory.
stats.Special Effect: The projectile automatically tracks allies and will bounce between allies on impact. Bridge Boost bounces on a single target are set to a maximum of 2

description_trans.ko: 힐링 하트 덱 활성화 중 덱 전체를 전방으로 발사합니다. 카드가 아군 사이를 튕겨 다니며 체력을 회복시키고 치유 증폭을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヒーリングハート中、全カードを前方へ一斉射出する。カードが味方間を跳弾し、体力回復と回復力上昇を付与する。

skills.name: Bidding Barrage
skills.description: While Breaking Spades deck is active, trigger Raise Empowerment to scattering cards in an arc in all directions. Explosions damage enemies and Launch them up

stats.Casting: Projectile that generates a spell field upon impact
stats.Special Effect: Launch enemies up on hit, which can take effect only once.

description_trans.ko: 브레이킹 스페이드 덱 활성화 중 전방향으로 카드를 흩뿌립니다. 카드가 폭발하며 적들을 띄우고 피해를 줍니다.
description_trans.ja: ブレイキングスペード中、全方位へカードを拡散放射する。爆発が敵にダメージを与え打ち上げる。

skills.name: Purifying Pick-Up
skills.description: While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Raise Empowerment to launch a cluster of cards in an arc ahead. Explosions heal nearby allies and Purify them

stats.Casting: Projectile that generates a spell field upon impact.
stats.Special Effect: The spell field applies Purify to allies upon impact. This can take effect on allies a maximum of 2 times and on himself once.

description_trans.ko: 힐링 하트 덱 활성화 중 전방으로 카드 뭉치를 투척합니다. 폭발 시 주변 아군을 치유하고 모든 약화 효과를 정화합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヒーリングハート中、前方へカード束を投擲する。爆発で周囲の味方を回復し浄化する。

skills.name: Explosive Trick
skills.description: While Breaking Spades deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to fire a full set of cards forward. Cards explode on impact, dealing damage while inflicting Reduced Healing

stats.Casting: Projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

description_trans.ko: 브레이킹 스페이드 덱 활성화 중 전방으로 카드 세트를 발사합니다. 폭발 시 적에게 피해를 주고 치유 감소 효과를 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ブレイキングスペード中、前方へカード一式を発射する。爆発で敵にダメージを与え回復阻害を付与する。

skills.name: All-Black
skills.description: Unleash up to a 4-strike rapid combo with All-Black the Necrosword

stats.Damage: 40 for the 1st/3rd hits, 60 for the 2nd/4th hits
stats.Attack Interval: 0.4s for the 1st/3rd hits, 0.6s for the 2nd/4th hits

description_trans.ko: 올블랙 네크로소드로 최대 4타의 연속 베기 콤보를 펼칩니다.
description_trans.ja: オールブラック・ネクロソードで最大4連続の斬撃コンボを繰り出す。

skills.name: Necro-Power
skills.description: Charge and launch a symbiote mass forward. Hitting an enemy Slows and teleports nearby Black Berserkers to them, or spawns a new one. Arriving Berserkers unleash a two-strike melee attack to Launch Up nearby enemies before reverting to ranged mode

description_trans.ko: 심비오트 덩어리를 충전하여 전방으로 발사합니다. 적에게 명중 시 둔화를 부여하고 주변의 블랙 버서커를 해당 위치로 순간이동시키거나 새로 소환합니다. 도착한 버서커는 2회 연속 근접 공격으로 주변 적을 띄운 뒤 원거리 모드로 전환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: シンビオートの塊をチャージして前方へ発射する。敵に命中するとスロウを付与し、周囲のブラック・バーサーカーをその位置へテレポートさせるか、新たに召喚する。到着したバーサーカーは2連撃の近接攻撃で周囲の敵を打ち上げた後、遠距離モードに戻る。

skills.name: Twilight of the Gods
skills.description: Unseal All-Black's true power, transforming it into the Annihilablade. Upon activation, an expanding Necroverse is formed, instantly spawning a Black Berserker next to all enemies caught inside. While active, every slash of the Annihilablade deals devastating damage. The Necroverse moves with Gorr; Berserkers within the field will not expire and remain locked in a perpetual Frenzied State

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 8m, decreasing to 80% at 10m

description_trans.ko: 올블랙의 진정한 힘을 해방하여 파멸도(Annihilablade)로 변형합니다. 시전 시 팽창하는 네크로버스가 형성되며 내부의 모든 적 옆에 블랙 버서커가 즉시 소환됩니다. 활성화 동안 파멸도의 모든 베기가 치명적인 피해를 입힙니다. 네크로버스는 고르를 따라 이동하며, 영역 내 버서커는 지속시간이 만료되지 않고 영구 광폭 상태를 유지합니다.
description_trans.ja: オールブラックの真の力を解放し、アナイアブレードへと変形させる。発動時に拡大するネクロバースが展開され、内部の全敵の隣にブラック・バーサーカーが即座に召喚される。有効中、アナイアブレードの斬撃は壊滅的なダメージを与える。ネクロバースはゴアと共に移動し、領域内のバーサーカーは消滅せず永続的な狂乱状態を維持する。

skills.name: Living Abyss
skills.description: Surge forward as an Invincible symbiote mass, leaving a Black Berserker behind and driving all active Berserkers into a Frenzied State. Upon landing, manifest a Necroverse that continuously damages trapped enemies, converting them into Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 무적 상태의 심비오트 덩어리가 되어 전방으로 돌진하며, 지나간 자리에 블랙 버서커를 남기고 모든 버서커를 광폭 상태로 만듭니다. 착지 시 네크로버스를 형성해 갇힌 적들에게 지속 피해를 입히고 추가 체력으로 흡수합니다.
description_trans.ja: 無敵状態のシンビオート塊となって前方へ突進し、通過地点にブラック・バーサーカーを残して全バーサーカーを狂乱状態にする。着地時にネクロバースを展開し、閉じ込めた敵へ持続ダメージを与えて追加体力へと変換する。

skills.name: Black Berserker
skills.description: Lob a symbiote mass that spawns a Black Berserker on landing to immediately shoot the nearest enemy. If summoned beside an enemy via Necro-Power, it unleashes a two-strike melee attack instead

description_trans.ko: 심비오트 덩어리를 투척하여 착탄 위치에 블랙 버서커를 소환합니다. 버서커는 즉시 가장 가까운 적을 사격하며, 네크로-파워를 통해 적 옆에 소환될 경우 2회 연속 근접 공격을 대신 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: シンビオート塊を投擲し、着弾地点にブラック・バーサーカーを召喚して最も近い敵を即座に射撃する。ネクロ・パワーで敵の隣に召喚された場合は、代わりに2連続近接攻撃を繰り出す。

skills.name: Shadow Harvest
skills.description: Warp to a selected Black Berserker, sacrificing it for Bonus Health equal to half its Health and triggering a symbiote explosion. Briefly unlocks Shadow Scythe: fire a piercing shockwave forward. All-Black then becomes a scythe for a set duration or 4 slashes

stats.Bonus Health: 50% of the Black Berserker's remaining Health, up to 50; shares the Bonus Health cap with Berserker Swarm

description_trans.ko: 선택한 블랙 버서커에게 순간이동하여 희생시키며, 버서커 체력의 절반에 해당하는 추가 체력을 얻고 심비오트 폭발을 일으킵니다. 잠시 그림자 낫(Shadow Scythe)이 해금되어 전방으로 관통 충격파를 발사하며, 올블랙이 일정 시간 또는 4회 공격 동안 대낫 형태로 변형됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 選択したブラック・バーサーカーの位置へワープして生贄にし、その体力の半分に相当する追加体力を獲得してシンビオート爆発を起こす。一時的にシャドウサイスが解放され、前方へ貫通衝撃波を発射する。その後オールブラックは一定時間または4回の斬撃まで大鎌形態へと変化する。

skills.name: Berserker Swarm
skills.description: Black Berserker damage grants Gorr Bonus Health. Defeating an enemy instantly spawns a Black Berserker at their location

stats.Summon Damage/Health Conversion: 100%, up to 50; shares the Bonus Health cap with Shadow Harvest

description_trans.ko: 블랙 버서커가 적에게 피해를 입히면 고르가 추가 체력을 획득합니다. 적을 처치하면 처치된 위치에 즉시 블랙 버서커가 소환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ブラック・バーサーカーがダメージを与えるとゴアが追加体力を獲得する。敵を撃破すると、その位置に即座にブラック・バーサーカーが召喚される。

teamups.name: Ragnarök
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to morph the All-Black into a scythe and execute a sweeping strike, damaging and briefly Grounding nearby enemies. The weapon stays in scythe form for a short duration.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, the scythe's attack range is expanded. Each hit scatters symbiote fragments, granting Bonus Health to Gorr and nearby allies

description_trans.ko: 올블랙을 대낫으로 변형해 회전 베기를 가하여 주변 적에게 피해를 입히고 잠시 착지(Grounded) 상태로 만드는 새 능력을 얻습니다. 무기는 잠시 동안 대낫 형태를 유지합니다.
description_trans.ja: オールブラックを大鎌に変形させて薙ぎ払いを放ち、周囲の敵にダメージを与えて短時間接地(飛行不可)にする新アビリティを獲得する。武器は短時間大鎌の形態を維持する。

teamups.name: Ragnarök
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to morph the All-Black into a scythe and execute a sweeping strike, damaging and briefly Grounding nearby enemies. The weapon stays in scythe form for a short duration.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, the scythe's attack range is expanded. Each hit scatters symbiote fragments, granting Bonus Health to Gorr and nearby allies

description_trans.ko: 헬라와 함께 플레이 시, 대낫의 공격 범위가 확장됩니다. 적을 맞출 때마다 심비오트 파편이 흩어져 고르와 주변 아군에게 추가 체력을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヘラとチームアップ時、大鎌の攻撃範囲が拡大する。命中ごとにシンビオートの破片が散らばり、ゴアと周囲の味方に追加体力を付与する。

teamups.name: Hive Mind
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to fire a Symbiote Claw forward, dealing piercing damage to enemies in its path. Upon reaching max distance, it retracts, Launching caught enemies toward Gorr.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Black Berserkers receive a slight Damage Boost and apply a Slow effect to enemies they strike

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 심비오트 클로(Symbiote Claw)를 발사하여 경로 상의 적에게 관통 피해를 입히는 새 능력을 얻습니다. 최대 사거리에 도달하면 회수되며 잡힌 적들을 고르 쪽으로 끌어당겨 띄웁니다(Launch).
description_trans.ja: 前方へシンビオート・クローを発射し、直線上の敵に貫通ダメージを与える新アビリティを獲得する。最大距離に達すると巻き戻り、捕らえた敵をゴアの元へ引き寄せ打ち上げる(Launch)。

teamups.name: Hive Mind
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to fire a Symbiote Claw forward, dealing piercing damage to enemies in its path. Upon reaching max distance, it retracts, Launching caught enemies toward Gorr.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Black Berserkers receive a slight Damage Boost and apply a Slow effect to enemies they strike

description_trans.ko: 베놈과 함께 플레이 시, 블랙 버서커(Black Berserker)들이 약간의 공격력 증가를 얻고 공격한 적에게 둔화(Slow) 효과를 적용합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヴェノムとチームアップ時、ブラック・バーサーカーの与ダメージがわずかに上昇し、攻撃した敵に減速効果(Slow)を付与する。

skills.name: Piercing Arrow
skills.description: Shoot a powerful arrow

stats.Casting: Charged projectile with an arced trajectory
stats.Projectile Speed: 130 - 195 m/s (Maximum speed is achieved after 0.9s of charging)
stats.Damage: 28 - 70 (Maximum damage is achieved after 0.9s of charging)

description_trans.ko: 강력한 화살을 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 強力な矢を放つ。

skills.name: Blast Arrow
skills.description: Shoot three explosive arrows

stats.Casting: Arced projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

description_trans.ko: 폭발성 화살 3발을 부채꼴로 일제 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 3本の爆発矢を一斉に放つ。

skills.name: Hunter's Sight
skills.description: Capture Afterimages of enemies in his view. Damage dealt to an Afterimage is transferred to the corresponding enemy

stats.Special Mechanic: While Hunter's Sight is active, bow draw speed is increased

description_trans.ko: 시야 내 적들의 잔상을 포착합니다. 잔상에 가해진 모든 피해는 해당 적 본체에 그대로 전이됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 視界内の敵の残像を捉える。残像に与えたダメージは対応する敵本体へとそのまま転送される。

skills.name: Crescent Slash
skills.description: Unsheathe a katana and slash forward, launching up enemies hit

description_trans.ko: 카타나를 뽑아 전방을 베어 넘기며 적중한 적들을 공중에 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 刀を抜いて前方を一閃し、命中した敵をノックアップさせる。

skills.name: MOONLIT SLASH
skills.description: Cloak & Dagger inject light and dark energy into Hawkeye's katana. When Hawkeye uses Crescent Slash, enemies hit are launched back, and a blade wave filled with light and energy sweeps forward. This wave passes through both allies and enemies: it heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability

description_trans.ko: 클록 앤 대거가 호크아이의 카타나에 빛과 어둠의 에너지를 주입합니다. 호크아이가 Crescent Slash 사용 시 검기가 아군을 치유하고 적에게 피해 및 취약을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: クローク＆ダガーがホークアイの刀に光と闇のエネルギーを注入する。ホークアイがCrescent Slash使用時に剣気が味方を回復し敵にダメージと脆弱を付与する。

skills.name: Hypersonic Arrow
skills.description: Shoot a Hypersonic Arrow, dealing two instances of damage to enemies in its path and inflicting them with Slow. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes

stats.Casting: Straight-line projectile that is accompanied by a spell field

description_trans.ko: 초음속 화살을 발사하여 경로 상의 적들에게 2회 피해를 입히고 감속시킵니다. 비행 중인 영웅을 격추할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: 極超音速の矢を放ち、軌道上の敵に2回ダメージを与えて鈍足を付与する。飛行中のヒーローを撃墜可能。

skills.name: Skyward Leap
skills.description: Perform a double jump in the direction of movement

description_trans.ko: 이동 방향으로 공중 2단 점프를 수행합니다.
description_trans.ja: 移動方向へ空中2段ジャンプを行う。

skills.name: Ronin Slash
skills.description: Swing a wakizashi to strike frontal enemies, deflecting all incoming projectiles

stats.Special Effect: This ability cannot block explosions or effects created by projectiles on hit

description_trans.ko: 와키자시를 휘둘러 전방의 적을 베고 날아오는 모든 투사체를 반사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 脇差を振るって前方の敵を攻撃し、飛来するすべての投射物を跳ね返す。

skills.name: Archer's Focus
skills.description: Aim at an enemy to improve focus, enhancing the damage inflicted by Piercing Arrow

stats.Bonus Damage: 0 - 90 (Maximum damage is achieved after 0.9s of aiming)
stats.Special Mechanic: Apply bonus damage to the base damage of Piercing Arrow

description_trans.ko: 적을 조준하여 집중도를 높이고 Piercing Arrow의 피해량을 강화합니다.
description_trans.ja: 敵に照準を合わせて集中力を高め、Piercing Arrowの与ダメージを強化する。

teamups.name: SENBONZAKURA STRIKE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Upgrade Blast Arrow to Psionic Arrow. While drawn, Hawkeye can continuously bank extra Psionic Arrows. Releasing the bowstring rapidly fires all accumulated arrows forward in sequence.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the nocking speed for each Psionic Arrow is significantly quickened, and they explode upon hitting enemies or the environment.

description_trans.ko: 폭발 화살(Blast Arrow)이 사이오닉 화살(Psionic Arrow)로 업그레이드됩니다. 활을 당기는 동안 호크아이는 추가 사이오닉 화살을 연속으로 축적할 수 있습니다. 시위를 놓으면 축적된 모든 화살이 전방으로 차례대로 연속 발사됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ブラストアローがサイオニック・アローへとアップグレードされる。弓を引いている間、ホークアイは追加のサイオニック・アローを連続で蓄積できる。弦を離すと蓄積された全矢が前方に順番に連続発射される。

teamups.name: SENBONZAKURA STRIKE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Upgrade Blast Arrow to Psionic Arrow. While drawn, Hawkeye can continuously bank extra Psionic Arrows. Releasing the bowstring rapidly fires all accumulated arrows forward in sequence.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the nocking speed for each Psionic Arrow is significantly quickened, and they explode upon hitting enemies or the environment.

description_trans.ko: 사일록과 함께 플레이 시, 각 사이오닉 화살을 메기는 장전 속도가 비약적으로 빨라지며 화살이 적이나 지형에 충돌 시 폭발합니다.
description_trans.ja: サイロックとチームアップ時、各サイオニック・アローを番える速度が大幅に高速化し、矢が敵や地形に命中した際に爆発する。

teamups.name: MOONLIT SLASH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Upgrade Crescent Slash to Moonlit Slash, projecting a radiant slash outward. It heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, Moonlit Slash can be chained into a three-hit combo, firing off three consecutive sweeping light blades.

description_trans.ko: 초승달 베기(Crescent Slash)가 달빛 베기(Moonlit Slash)로 업그레이드되어 전방으로 빛나는 검기를 방출합니다. 검기는 아군을 치유하고 치유 효과를 증폭시키며, 적에게는 피해를 입히고 취약(Vulnerability)을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: クレセント・スラッシュがムーンリット・スラッシュへとアップグレードされ、前方へ輝く斬撃を射出する。光刃は味方を回復し回復量を増幅させ、敵にはダメージと脆弱(Vulnerability)を付与する。

teamups.name: MOONLIT SLASH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Upgrade Crescent Slash to Moonlit Slash, projecting a radiant slash outward. It heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, Moonlit Slash can be chained into a three-hit combo, firing off three consecutive sweeping light blades.

description_trans.ko: 클록 & 대거와 함께 플레이 시, 달빛 베기를 3연속 콤보로 연계하여 3개의 연속적인 빛의 칼날을 휘둘러 방출할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: クローク＆ダガーとチームアップ時、ムーンリット・スラッシュを3連コンボへと連携可能になり、3連続の薙ぎ払い光刃を放つことができる。

skills.name: Nightsword Thorn
skills.description: Throw Nightsword thorns

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 18m, decreasing to 75% at 35m

description_trans.ko: 나이트소드 가시를 전방으로 투척해 적을 관통합니다.
description_trans.ja: ナイトソードの棘を前方へ投擲して敵を貫く。

skills.name: Piercing Night
skills.description: Fire multiple Nightsword thorns that detonate after a delay

stats.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact
stats.Special Effect: Projectiles stick to enemies on hit

description_trans.ko: 다수의 나이트소드 가시를 일제히 발사하여 잠시 후 연쇄 폭발을 일으킵니다.
description_trans.ja: 複数のナイトソードの棘を一斉に放ち、短時間後に連鎖爆発を引き起こす。

skills.name: Goddess of Death
skills.description: Soar into the sky and unleash Nastrond Crows from each hand at will

stats.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

description_trans.ko: 하늘 높이 날아올라 양손에서 나스트론드 까마귀 투사체를 자유롭게 난사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 上空へ飛翔し、両手からナストロンドのカラス弾を自由自在に乱射する。

skills.name: Astral Flock
skills.description: Transform into a Nastrond Crow to glide forth, press again to undo the transformation. Gain Bonus Health when the transformation ends

stats.Special Effect: Shapeshift into a Nastrond Crow and gain invincibility

description_trans.ko: 나스트론드 까마귀로 변신하여 전방으로 비행합니다. 재입력 시 변신을 해제하며 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: カラスに変身して前方へ滑空飛行する。再発動で変身を解除し、終了時に追加空力を獲得する。

skills.name: Soul Drainer
skills.description: Project an explosive Hel sphere to Stun nearby enemies.

stats.Casting: Arced projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

description_trans.ko: 헬의 폭발 구체를 투척하여 착탄 범위 내의 모든 적을 기절(Stun)시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: ヘル・スフィアを投擲し、着弾範囲内の全敵をスタン状態にする。

skills.name: Hel Tendrils
skills.description: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela.  Hela's Hel Tendrils unleash a symbiotic Hel Sphere. Upon hit, it pulls nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, slowing enemies that try to escape.

stats.Slow Effect: Slow the enemies by 20% at the center, increasing to 40% at 2.5m from the center.

description_trans.ko: 베놈이 제프와 헬라에게 심비오트를 공유합니다. 헬라의 Hel Tendrils가 착탄 시 주변 적을 중심부로 강하게 끌어당겨 결속하고 탈출하려는 적을 감속시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: ヴェノムがジェフとヘラにシンビオートを共有する。ヘラのHel Tendrilsが着弾時に周囲の敵を激しく引き寄せて拘束し、脱出しようとする敵にスロウを付与する。

skills.name: Hel's Descent
skills.description: Hold Space to fall slowly

description_trans.ko: 스페이스 키를 길게 눌러 천천히 활강 강하합니다.
description_trans.ja: スペース長押しでゆっくりと滑空降下する。

skills.name: Nastrond Crowstorm
skills.description: Defeating an enemy will generate a Nastrond Crow, exploding after a duration

description_trans.ko: 적 처치 시 그 자리에 나스트론드 까마귀가 생성되어 잠시 후 폭발하며 주변 적에게 피해를 줍니다.
description_trans.ja: 敵撃破時、その場にナストロンドのカラスが生成され、短時間後に爆発して周囲にダメージを与える。

skills.name: DEATH KNELL
skills.description: Hela channels energy of the undead to empower Namor. When Namor strikes with his trident, a spectral water column erupts at the target area, slowing enemies hit. Whenever Hela or Namor assist in a KO, an invulnerable Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position, automatically attacking the nearest foe for a short time before vanishing

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 50% at 40m

description_trans.ko: 헬라가 불사의 힘으로 나모르를 강화합니다. 삼지창 타격 시 유령 수수가 솟구쳐 적을 감속시키며, 처치 관여 시 쓰러진 자리에 무적의 언데드 몬스트로가 소환되어 적을 공격합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヘラが不死の力でネイモアを強化する。三叉槍命中時に水柱が噴出してスロウを付与し、撃破関与時に無敵のアンデッド・モンストロが召喚されて敵を攻撃する。

teamups.name: Hel Tendrils
teamups.description: Base Effect: Replace Soul Drainer with Hel Tendrils. Upon hit, tendrils pull nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, Slowingenemies that try to escape. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Piercing Night fires a dense volley of symbiote-infused Nightsword Thorns. Each direct Nightsword Thorn hit restores a portion of Hela's Health

description_trans.ko: 영혼 흡수기(Soul Drainer)가 명계의 덩굴(Hel Tendrils)로 교체됩니다. 적중 시 덩굴이 착탄 지점으로 주변 적들을 끌어당겨 서로 연결하며, 도망치려는 적에게 둔화(Slow)를 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ソウルドレイナーが冥界の触手(Hel Tendrils)へと変更される。命中時、触手が周囲の敵を着弾点へ引き寄せて互いに繋ぎ止め、脱出しようとする敵に減速(Slow)を与える。

teamups.name: Hel Tendrils
teamups.description: Base Effect: Replace Soul Drainer with Hel Tendrils. Upon hit, tendrils pull nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, Slowingenemies that try to escape. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Piercing Night fires a dense volley of symbiote-infused Nightsword Thorns. Each direct Nightsword Thorn hit restores a portion of Hela's Health

description_trans.ko: 베놈과 함께 플레이 시, 어둠의 꿰뚫기(Piercing Night)가 심비오트가 주입된 밤의 검 가시 다발을 발사합니다. 가시가 직접 적중할 때마다 헬라의 체력이 일정량 회복됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ヴェノムとチームアップ時、ピアスナイトがシンビオートの宿る夜の剣の棘束を発射する。棘が直撃するたびにヘラの体力が一定量回復する。

teamups.name: DEEP WRATH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Whenever Hela participates in a KO, an Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position. While an Undead Monstro is present, casting Piercing Night will command the Monstro to spit a Nightsword Thorn at the nearest enemy.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Namor, each attack during Goddess of Death spawns an Undead Monstro at the point of impact.

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 50% at 40m

description_trans.ko: 헬라가 처치(KO)에 기여할 때마다 쓰러진 적의 위치에 언데드 몬스트로(Undead Monstro)가 소환됩니다. 언데드 몬스트로가 존재하는 동안 어둠의 꿰뚫기(Piercing Night)를 시전하면 몬스트로가 가장 가까운 적에게 밤의 검 가시를 뱉어내도록 명령합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヘラがキル(KO)に関与するたび、倒れた敵の位置にアンデッド・モンストロが召喚される。アンデッド・モンストロが存在する間、ピアスナイトを発動するとモンストロが最も近い敵へ夜の剣の棘を吐き出すよう命令する。

teamups.name: DEEP WRATH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Whenever Hela participates in a KO, an Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position. While an Undead Monstro is present, casting Piercing Night will command the Monstro to spit a Nightsword Thorn at the nearest enemy.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Namor, each attack during Goddess of Death spawns an Undead Monstro at the point of impact.

stats.Special Effect: Each attack during Goddess of Death spawns an Undead Monstro at the point of impact.

description_trans.ko: 네이머와 함께 플레이 시, 죽음의 여신(Goddess of Death) 지속 시간 동안 공격할 때마다 충돌 지점에 언데드 몬스트로가 소환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ネイモアとチームアップ時、死の女神(Goddess of Death)の発動中に攻撃を行うたび、着弾地点にアンデッド・モンストロが召喚される。

skills.name: Heavy Blow
skills.description: Swing fists forward to punch enemies

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 주먹을 휘둘러 적을 공격합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方に向かって拳を振るい、敵を攻撃する。

skills.name: Gamma Burst
skills.description: Emit gamma-ray bursts to inflict damage. Reduce Indestructible Guard cooldown upon hit

stats.Casting: Single-cast projectile that can pierce through enemies
stats.Cooldown: Basic Cooldown 2s, with a charge of 6s per use.
stats.Special Effect: Each direct hit reduces Indestructible Guard cooldown by 1s

description_trans.ko: 감마선 폭발을 방출해 적에게 피해를 줍니다. 적중 시 Indestructible Guard의 쿨다운이 감소합니다.
description_trans.ja: ガンマ線バーストを放ちダメージを与える。命中時にIndestructible Guardのクールダウンが短縮される。

skills.name: HULK SMASH!
skills.description: Unleash stored gamma energy, transforming from Hero Hulk into Monster Hulk for a limited time period

stats.Special Effect: The caster is immobilized during the transformation process and gains Invincibility

description_trans.ko: 축적된 감마 에너지를 폭발시켜 일정 시간 동안 Hero Hulk에서 Monster Hulk로 변신합니다.
description_trans.ja: 蓄積されたガンマエネルギーを解放し、一定時間Hero HulkからMonster Hulkへと変身する。

skills.name: Indestructible Guard
skills.description: Generate gamma shields for Hero Hulk and nearby allies, absorbing and converting damage into energy for HULK SMASH

stats.Casting: Single-cast spell field that surrounds the caster
stats.Special Effect: When the caster's shield takes damage, 130% of the damage is converted into gamma energy. When an ally's shield takes damage, 10% of the damage is converted into gamma energy

description_trans.ko: Hero Hulk과 주변 아군에게 감마 쉴드를 생성하여 피해를 흡수하고 HULK SMASH 게이지로 전환합니다.
description_trans.ja: Hero Hulkと周囲の味方にガンマシールドを付与し、ダメージを吸収してHULK SMASHのエネルギーに変換する。

skills.name: Radioactive Lockdown
skills.description: Emit gamma energy to irradiate enemies and render them immobilize and immune to all ability effects. Using Heavy Blow or Gamma Burst will prematurely remove this status

stats.Special Effect: Heavy Blow and Gamma Burst can detect and damage irradiated enemies, and prematurely remove the status

description_trans.ko: 감마 에너지를 방출해 적들을 피폭시켜 이동 불가 및 모든 스킬 면역 상태로 가둡니다. Heavy Blow 또는 Gamma Burst로 타격하면 조기 해제됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ガンマエネルギーを放ち敵を被曝させ、移動不能かつ全アビリティ効果無効状態にする。Heavy BlowまたはGamma Burstで攻撃すると早期解除される。

skills.name: Gamma Fastball
skills.description: Wolverine, Hulk can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, Hulk can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forward

description_trans.ko: 울버린과 헐크가 상호작용할 수 있습니다. 양측이 동의하면 헐크가 울버린을 들어 올려 전방으로 강력하게 내던집니다.
description_trans.ja: ウルヴァリンとハルクが相互作用可能になる。双方が合意するとハルクがウルヴァリンを持ち上げ、前方へ勢いよく投げ飛ばす。

skills.name: Incredible Leap
skills.description: HOLD Space to perform a charged leap that allows Hero Hulk to Knock a flying enemy to the ground

stats.Special Effect: Press Space during the Incredible Leap to cling to the wall you encounter

description_trans.ko: Space를 길게 눌러 충전 도약을 수행하며, Hero Hulk가 비행 중인 적을 지면으로 내리꽂을 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: Space長押しでチャージジャンプを行い、Hero Hulkが飛行中の敵を地面に叩き落とす。

skills.name: Gamma Boost
skills.description: Hulk charges Iron Man and Namor with gamma radiation. When Iron Man uses Armor Overdrive, he will initiate a gamma upgrade. When Namor receives the radiation, he will summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage

stats.Team-Up Bonus: Hero Hulk and Monster Hulk gain 100 Max Health

description_trans.ko: 헐크가 아이언맨과 네이머에게 감마선을 충전합니다. 아이언맨이 Armor Overdrive 사용 시 감마 업그레이드가 발동하며, 네이머는 추가 Gamma Monstro를 소환해 지속 감마선을 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: ハルクがアイアンマンとネイモアにガンマ放射線を注入する。アイアンマンはArmor Overdrive時にガンマ強化が発動し、ネイモアは追加のGamma Monstroを召喚して持続照射を行う。

teamups.name: SAVAGE SLAM
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Leap high and smash the ground, dealing damage to enemies and reducing the cooldowns of other abilities based on remaining Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, the ground slam additionally applies Vulnerability to enemies hit.

partner_name.ja: キャプテン・アメリカ

description_trans.ko: 높이 도약하여 지면을 강타해 적들에게 피해를 입히고, 남은 체력에 비례하여 다른 스킬들의 재사용 대기시간을 감소시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: 高く跳躍して地面を叩きつけ、敵にダメージを与えつつ、自身の残り体力に応じて他のアビリティのクールダウンを短縮する。

teamups.name: SAVAGE SLAM
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Leap high and smash the ground, dealing damage to enemies and reducing the cooldowns of other abilities based on remaining Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, the ground slam additionally applies Vulnerability to enemies hit.

partner_name.ja: キャプテン・アメリカ

description_trans.ko: 캡틴 아메리카와 함께 플레이 시, 지면 강타가 적중당한 적들에게 추가로 취약(Vulnerability)을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: キャプテン・アメリカとチームアップ時、地面叩きつけが命中した敵に追加で脆弱(Vulnerability)を付与する。

teamups.name: GAMMA FASTBALL
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Enter a Furious state upon activation, gaining Speed Boost and Attack Speed for a duration. Also unlocks the Dances With Werewolves ability, granting Unstoppable for a period when Health drops to a certain threshold.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Wolverine, unlocks the Fastball Special. Upon mutual confirmation, Hulk hurls Wolverine forward

description_trans.ko: 스킬 활성화 시 분노(Furious) 상태에 진입하여 일정 시간 동안 이동 속도 및 공격 속도가 증가합니다. 또한 늑대인간과의 춤(Dances With Werewolves) 스킬이 해금되어 체력이 특정 수치 이하로 떨어지면 일정 시간 저지 불가(Unstoppable) 상태가 됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 発動時に激怒状態となり、一定時間移動速度と攻撃速度が上昇する。さらに『狼男とのダンス』アビリティが解放され、体力が一定値を下回ると一定時間阻止不能(Unstoppable)を獲得する。

teamups.name: GAMMA FASTBALL
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Enter a Furious state upon activation, gaining Speed Boost and Attack Speed for a duration. Also unlocks the Dances With Werewolves ability, granting Unstoppable for a period when Health drops to a certain threshold.

description_trans.ko: 울버린과 함께 플레이 시, 패스트볼 스페셜(Fastball Special)이 해금됩니다. 상호 동의 시 헐크가 울버린을 전방으로 힘껏 내던집니다.
description_trans.ja: ウルヴァリンとチームアップ時、ファストボール・スペシャルが解放される。相互合意により、ハルクがウルヴァリンを前方へ力任せに投げ飛ばす。

skills.name: Gamma Fastball
skills.description: Wolverine, Hulk can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, Hulk can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forward

description_trans.ko: 울버린과 헐크가 상호작용할 수 있습니다. 양측이 동의하면 헐크가 울버린을 들어 올려 전방으로 강력하게 내던집니다.
description_trans.ja: ウルヴァリンとハルクが相互作用可能になる。双方が合意するとハルクがウルヴァリンを持ち上げ、前方へ勢いよく投げ飛ばす。

skills.name: Incredible Leap
skills.description: HOLD Space to perform a charged leap that allows Hero Hulk to Knock a flying enemy to the ground

stats.Special Effect: Press Space during the Incredible Leap to cling to the wall you encounter

description_trans.ko: Space를 길게 눌러 충전 도약을 수행하며, Hero Hulk가 비행 중인 적을 지면으로 내리꽂을 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: Space長押しでチャージジャンプを行い、Hero Hulkが飛行中の敵を地面に叩き落とす。

skills.name: Gamma Boost
skills.description: Hulk charges Iron Man and Namor with gamma radiation. When Iron Man uses Armor Overdrive, he will initiate a gamma upgrade. When Namor receives the radiation, he will summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage

stats.Team-Up Bonus: Hero Hulk and Monster Hulk gain 100 Max Health

description_trans.ko: 헐크가 아이언맨과 네이머에게 감마선을 충전합니다. 아이언맨이 Armor Overdrive 사용 시 감마 업그레이드가 발동하며, 네이머는 추가 Gamma Monstro를 소환해 지속 감마선을 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: ハルクがアイアンマンとネイモアにガンマ放射線を注入する。アイアンマンはArmor Overdrive時にガンマ強化が発動し、ネイモアは追加のGamma Monstroを召喚して持続照射を行う。

skills.name: Heavy Blow
skills.description: Swing fists forward to punch and launch up enemies

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 주먹을 휘둘러 적을 공격하고 공중에 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方に向かって拳を振るい、敵を攻撃してノックアップさせる。

skills.name: Gamma Burst
skills.description: Emit gamma-ray bursts to inflict damage

stats.Casting: Single-cast projectile that can pierce through enemies

description_trans.ko: 감마선 폭발을 방출해 적에게 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: ガンマ線バーストを放ち敵にダメージを与える。

skills.name: World Breaker
skills.description: Grab and smash the enemy in front

stats.Special Effect: While performing the smash, Hulk gains a 30% Damage Reduction

description_trans.ko: 전방의 적을 붙잡아 지면에 메칩니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方の敵を掴んで地面に叩きつける。

skills.name: Radioactive Lockdown
skills.description: Emit gamma energy to irradiate enemies and render them immobilize and immune to all ability effects. Using Heavy Blow or Gamma Burst will prematurely remove this status

stats.Special Effect: Heavy Blow and Gamma Burst can detect and damage irradiated enemies, and prematurely remove the status

skills.description: HOLD Space to perform a charged leap that allows Monster Hulk to Knock a flying enemy to the ground

stats.Special Effect: Press Space during the Incredible Leap to cling to the wall you encounter

When Namor receives the radiation, he will summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage

stats.Team-Up Bonus: Hero Hulk and Monster Hulk gain 100 Max Health

description_trans.ko: 헐크가 아이언맨과 네이머에게 감마선을 충전합니다. 아이언맨이 Armor Overdrive 사용 시 감마 업그레이드가 발동하며, 네이머는 추가 Gamma Monstro를 소환해 지속 감마선을 발사합니다.

skills.name: Fire Cluster
skills.description: Launch forward a splittable fireball

stats.Charge Speed: Instantly recover all Fire Cluster energy after not using Fire Cluster for 1s
stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 15m, decreasing to 60% at 20m.

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 분열하는 화염구를 발사하여 범위 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ分裂する火炎弾を発射し、範囲ダメージを与える。

skills.name: Blazing Blast
skills.description: Launch a fireball to create a Flame Field at the targeted area

stats.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spherical spell field upon impact.

description_trans.ko: 목표 지점에 화염구를 발사하여 지속적으로 불타는 화염 지대(Flame Field)를 생성합니다.
description_trans.ja: 目標地点へ火炎弾を放ち、持続的に燃焼する火炎エリアを生成する。

skills.name: Supernova
skills.description: Explode with cosmic fire to deal damage to enemies within range. Upon skill activation, all Flame Fields will transform into Flame Tornadoes, dealing extra damage

stats.Flame Tornado Range: 3m spherical radius; 8m high capsule-shaped spell field.

description_trans.ko: 우주 화염으로 대폭발을 일으켜 주변 적에게 막대한 피해를 입힙니다. 시전 시 전장의 모든 화염 지대가 거대한 화염 토네이도로 변형되어 추가 피해를 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 宇宙の炎で大爆発を起こし、範囲内の敵に甚大なダメージを与える。発動時、全火炎エリアが巨大な炎の竜巻へと変貌し追撃ダメージを与える。

skills.name: Plasma Body
skills.description: Enter a state of accelerated ascent

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 8s to recharge

description_trans.ko: 플라즈마 화염 상태에 돌입하여 공중으로 신속하게 급상승 비행합니다.
description_trans.ja: プラズマ炎状態に入り、上空へ素早く急上昇飛行する。

skills.name: Pyro-Prison
skills.description: Form a fire wall between Fire Fields to burn enemies

description_trans.ko: 화염 지대들 사이에 불타는 화염 장벽을 형성하여 통과하는 적들을 불태웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 火炎エリア間に燃え盛る火炎壁を形成し、通過する敵を焼き尽くす。

skills.name: Flaming Meteor
skills.description: Dive towards the ground, dealing damage to enemies and detonating any Flame Fields hit

description_trans.ko: 지면을 향해 불타는 유성처럼 급강하하여 적들에게 피해를 입히고 충돌한 화염 지대를 폭발시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: 燃え盛る隕石のように地面へ急降下突撃し、敵にダメージを与えて接触した火炎エリアを起爆する。

skills.name: Storm Siblings
skills.description: The Invisible Woman taps into her powers, channeling Psionic Might to fortify the entire Fantastic Four team, granting damage resistance. Once activated, they can continually generate Bonus Health, making up for lost Health

description_trans.ko: 인비저블 우먼이 사이오닉 힘을 방출하여 판타스틱 4 팀원 전체를 강화하고 받는 피해 감소 효과를 부여합니다. 활성화 중에는 지속적으로 추가 체력을 생성하여 잃은 체력을 보충합니다.
description_trans.ja: インビジブル・ウーマンがサイキックの力でファンタスティック4全員を強化し、被ダメージ軽減を付与する。発動中は持続的に追加空力を生成し、損失した体力を補填する。

skills.name: Two In One
skills.description: Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage, launching enemies, and creating a zone that disables mobility abilities

stats.Damage: Launch-up spell field causes 30 damage; mobility abilities disabling spell field causes 15 damage per second
stats.Launch Up Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 8m and a height of 1m
stats.Mobility Abilities Disabling Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 8m and a height of 8m

description_trans.ko: 휴먼 토치가 씽을 공중으로 들어 올려 지면으로 내리찍어 범위 피해와 띄우기, 이동기 차단 구역을 형성합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヒューマン・トーチがザ・シングを空中に持ち上げて叩きつけ、範囲ダメージと打ち上げ、移動アビリティ使用不可エリアを展開する。

skills.name: Pyrokinetic Energy
skills.description: Human Torch stores Pyrokinetic Energy in Spider-Man's suit, enabling him to unleash an Inferno Blast that sprays a fiery web while performing a backflip to create distance. The flames damage enemies and apply a Burn-Tracer. Detonating these Burn-Tracers inflicts Damage Over Time

description_trans.ko: 휴먼 토치가 스파이더맨의 슈트에 발화 에너지를 주입하여 인페르노 블래스트를 발동할 수 있게 합니다. 화염 웹을 살포해 적에게 피해를 주고 번 트레이서를 부착하며, 폭발 시 강력한 지속 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: ヒューマン・トーチがスパイダーマンのスーツに発火エネルギーを充填し、インフェルノ・ブラストを解放可能にする。火炎ウェブを散布して敵にダメージと燃焼標識を与え、起爆時に強力な持続ダメージを与える。

teamups.name: FIERY SPARKS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Passively detect enemies in the immediate vicinity and launch tracking Sparks to chip away their health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, successfully landing a Firework Spark on an enemy grants Human Torch Bonus Health.

description_trans.ko: 근처에 있는 적을 지속적으로 탐지하고 유도 불꽃(Sparks)을 발사하여 적의 체력을 갉아먹습니다.
description_trans.ja: 至近距離の敵を自動探知し、追尾スパークを放って敵の体力を削り取る。

teamups.name: FIERY SPARKS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Passively detect enemies in the immediate vicinity and launch tracking Sparks to chip away their health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, successfully landing a Firework Spark on an enemy grants Human Torch Bonus Health.

description_trans.ko: 쥬빌리와 함께 플레이 시, 폭죽 불꽃(Firework Spark)을 적에게 맞추면 휴먼 토치가 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: ジュビリーとチームアップ時、花火スパークを敵に命中させるとヒューマン・トーチが追加体力を獲得する。

teamups.name: STORMING IGNITION
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Unleash a storm-driven blaze of fire forward, generating a persistent Fire Vortex upon impact that continuously damages and pulls in enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, her Omega Hurricane ignites into a Burning Hurricane if it crosses a Flame Tornado. Furthermore, any Omega Hurricane, Jeff-Nado, or Flame Tornado that sweeps across a Flame Field left by Human Torch will instantly generate a new Flame Tornado.

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 폭풍을 머금은 거대한 화염을 방출하여, 충돌 지점에 적들을 지속적으로 끌어당기며 피해를 입히는 불꽃 소용돌이(Fire Vortex)를 생성합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ嵐の如き業火を放ち、着弾地点に敵を持続的に引き寄せてダメージを与える火炎の渦(Fire Vortex)を生成する。

teamups.name: STORMING IGNITION
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Unleash a storm-driven blaze of fire forward, generating a persistent Fire Vortex upon impact that continuously damages and pulls in enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, her Omega Hurricane ignites into a Burning Hurricane if it crosses a Flame Tornado. Furthermore, any Omega Hurricane, Jeff-Nado, or Flame Tornado that sweeps across a Flame Field left by Human Torch will instantly generate a new Flame Tornado.

stats.Burning Hurricane Damage: 75 damage per hit, 2 hits per second

description_trans.ko: 스톰과 함께 플레이 시, 스톰의 오메가 허리케인이 화염 토네이도를 통과하면 불타는 허리케인으로 점화됩니다. 또한 오메가 허리케인, 제프-네이도, 또는 화염 토네이도가 휴먼 토치가 남긴 화염 지대를 휩쓸고 지나가면 즉시 새로운 화염 토네이도가 생성됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ストームとチームアップ時、ストームのオメガハリケーンが火炎竜巻を通過すると燃えるハリケーンへと引火する。さらに、オメガハリケーン、ジェフ・ネード、または火炎竜巻がヒューマン・トーチの残した火炎地帯を通過すると、即座に新たな火炎竜巻が生成される。

skills.name: Jeet Kune Do
skills.description: Strike the targeted enemy with Jeet Kune Do, reducing the cooldown of Block and Strike with every hit

stats.Damage: The first four strikes each deal 38 damage, while the fifth strike deals 60 damage
stats.Attack Interval: The first four strikes have an interval of 0.45s between them, while the fifth strike has a 0.67s interval from the fourth strike

description_trans.ko: 절권도 연타로 적을 타격하며, 적중 시마다 Block and Strike의 재사용 대기시간이 감소합니다.
description_trans.ja: ジークンドーの連打で敵を攻撃し、命中ごとにBlock and Strikeのクールダウンを短縮する。

skills.name: Yat Jee Chung Kuen
skills.description: Dash forward to pursue the targeted enemy and unleash a flurry of attacks

stats.Damage: 8 base damage + 3.1% of the enemy's Max Health per strike

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 돌진하여 대상을 추격한 뒤 일자충권의 전광석화 같은 난타를 쏟아붓습니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ突進してターゲットを追撃し、日字衝拳の猛烈な連続打撃を叩き込む。

skills.name: Dragon's Defense
skills.description: Assume a defensive stance with a boost of Chi to block incoming attacks and gain Damage Reduction, then strike back with Yat Jee Chung Kuen

description_trans.ko: 기의 힘으로 방어 자세를 취해 적의 공격을 막아내고 피해 감소를 얻은 뒤, 즉시 일자충권으로 반격합니다.
description_trans.ja: 気の力で防御の構えを取り、攻撃を防いで被ダメージ軽減を得た後、即座に日字衝拳で反撃する。

skills.name: Living Chi
skills.description: Become living Chi to boost his speed, damage, and attack range, delivering stronger punches while reducing the cooldown of Dragon's Defense

description_trans.ko: 살아있는 기 그 자체가 되어 이동 속도, 공격력, 사거리가 대폭 증가하고 더욱 강력한 타격을 퍼부으며 Dragon's Defense의 재사용 대기시간을 줄입니다.
description_trans.ja: 生ける気そのものとなって移動速度、攻撃力、攻撃範囲が大幅に上昇し、より強力な拳を繰り出しながらDragon's Defenseのクールダウンを短縮する。

skills.name: K'un-Lun Kick
skills.description: Dash forward, delivering a flying kick when hitting an enemy or reaching full range, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Damage increases with lower enemy health

stats.Second Flying Kick Damage: 35 - 70 (Maximum damage is achieved when the target is at 50% Health)

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 비상 돌진하여 곤륜 날아차기를 가합니다. 적의 잃은 체력에 비례하여 더 치명적인 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ疾走してクン・ルンの飛び蹴りを放ち、敵の減少体力に応じてダメージが増加する。

skills.name: Harmony Recovery
skills.description: Cross legs and channel Chi, slowly gaining Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 가부좌를 틀고 기를 운기조식하여 지속적으로 추가 체력을 회복합니다.
description_trans.ja: 胡座を組んで気を巡らせ、持続的に追加空力を回復する。

skills.name: Lunar Chi
skills.description: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Hawkeye and Iron Fist. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recovery, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi

stats.Special Effect: Excess healing converts to Bonus Health.
stats.Healing Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 10m radius and a height of 10m.

description_trans.ko: 루나 스노우가 아이언 피스트에게 한기의 기운을 전수합니다. 아이언 피스트가 Harmony Recovery를 시전할 때 달의 기운(Lunar Chi)으로 주변 아군까지 함께 치유합니다.
description_trans.ja: ルナ・スノーがアイアン・フィストに冷気の気を伝授する。Harmony Recovery使用時に月の気で周囲の味方まで同時に回復する。

skills.name: Crane Leap
skills.description: Perform up to three consecutive jumps while airborne

stats.Cooldown: 3 charges, with each charge taking 1s to recharge

description_trans.ko: 학의 도약으로 공중에서 최대 3회 연속 점프를 수행할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: 鶴の跳躍により、空中で最大3連続のジャンプを繰り出すことができる。

skills.name: Wall Runner
skills.description: Run horizontally along the walls

description_trans.ko: 벽면을 박차고 수평으로 자유롭게 질주합니다.
description_trans.ja: 壁面を蹴って水平方向に自在に疾走する。

skills.name: Chi Absorption
skills.description: Assists in taking down enemies allow him to absorb their Chi and gain Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 적 처치 및 처치 지원 시 적의 기를 흡수하여 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: 敵撃破およびキルアシスト時に敵の気を吸収し、追加空力を獲得する。

teamups.name: IRON & STONE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Unleash a powerful uppercut to Launch Up enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up The Thing, unleashing the uppercut can be chained directly into a sweeping leg sweep for a follow-up attack.

description_trans.ko: 강력한 어퍼컷을 날려 적들을 공중으로 띄워 올립니다(Launch Up).
description_trans.ja: 強力なアッパーカットを放ち、敵を上空へ打ち上げる(Launch Up)。

teamups.name: IRON & STONE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Unleash a powerful uppercut to Launch Up enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up The Thing, unleashing the uppercut can be chained directly into a sweeping leg sweep for a follow-up attack.

description_trans.ja: 地中深く潜り込んでから急浮上し、範囲内の敵味方を丸呑みにしてHide and Seek状態で移動後に前方へ吐き出す。

skills.name: Hide and Seek
skills.description: Dive into the scene with only his dorsal fin exposed, granting himself a Movement Boost. Jeff can heal while submerged and gains the wall-crawl ability

stats.Special Effect: During the dive, gain Unstoppable, healing over time, and a Movement Boost, while Jeff's hitbox is reduced

description_trans.ko: 등지느러미만 드러낸 채 잠수하여 이동 속도가 빨라지며, 잠수 중 자가 치유 및 벽타기가 가능해집니다.
description_trans.ja: 背ビレだけを出して潜水し移動速度が上昇する。潜水中に自己回復を行い、壁を這い登る能力を得る。

skills.name: Healing Bubble
skills.description: Spit a bubble that heals the ally who collects it, granting them Healing Boost and Movement Boost while also launching up nearby enemies

stats.Special Effect: Touching the bubble will immediately activate its effect
stats.Cooldown: 3 charges, with each charge taking 6s to recharge

description_trans.ko: 방울을 뱉어 이를 획득한 아군을 치유하고 치유 증폭과 이동 속도를 높이며 주변 적들을 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 泡を吐き出し、獲得した味方を回復して回復強化と移動速度上昇を与え、周囲の敵を打ち上げる。

skills.name: Jeff's Cuddle Buddy
skills.description: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction

stats.Spell Field Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 6m radius and a height of 6m.

description_trans.ko: 제프와 로켓 라쿤이 그루트의 어깨에 탑승하여 받는 피해 감소 효과를 얻습니다.
description_trans.ja: ジェフとロケット・ラクーンがグルートの肩に乗ることができ、被ダメージ軽減効果を獲得する。

skills.name: GUARDIAN OF THE DEEP
skills.description: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela. Jeff's Guardian of the Deep links with nearby allies, providing continuous healing. When the effect ends, it releases a powerful healing burst, converting any excess into Bonus Health.

stats.Bonus Health Falloff: Falloff begins at 3s and decreases by 30/s

description_trans.ko: 베놈이 제프와 헬라에게 심비오트를 공유합니다. 제프의 Guardian of the Deep이 주변 아군을 연결해 지속 치유를 제공하고 폭발 치유 초과분을 추가 체력으로 전환합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヴェノムがジェフとヘラにシンビオートを分配する。ジェフのGuardian of the Deepが周囲の味方をリンクして持続回復を行い、終了時の超過回復を追加HPに変換する。

skills.name: IT'S JEFF-NADO!
skills.description: When Storm activates Omega Hurricane and Jeff the Land Shark's It's Jeff is ready, they can unleash a powerful Team-Up Ability. During this period, Storm's Omega Hurricane merges with Jeff to form a Jeff-nado

stats.Select Range: 60m radius, 90° fan-shaped area in front of Jeff
stats.Swallow Range: 10m spherical radius spell field centered around Storm

description_trans.ko: 스톰의 Omega Hurricane과 제프의 It's Jeff가 준비되면 합체 스킬을 발동할 수 있습니다. 스톰의 허리케인과 제프가 융합되어 거대한 제프네이도를 형성합니다.
description_trans.ja: ストームのOmega HurricaneとジェフのIt's Jeffが使用可能な時、強力な連携アビリティを発動できる。ストームの竜巻にジェフが融合してJeff-nadoを形成する。

skills.name: New Friends
skills.description: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction

description_trans.ko: 제프와 로켓 라쿤이 그루트의 어깨에 탑승하여 받는 피해 감소 효과를 얻습니다.
description_trans.ja: ジェフとロケット・ラクーンがグルートの肩に乗ることができ、被ダメージ軽減効果を獲得する。

skills.name: Oblivious Cuteness
skills.description: Reduce damage taken from critical hits

description_trans.ko: 치명타 피격 시 받는 피해가 감소합니다.
description_trans.ja: クリティカル攻撃から受ける被ダメージを軽減する。

teamups.name: GUARDIAN OF THE DEEP
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Shoot out healing tendrils; linked allies receive Continuous Healing, and excess healing is converted into Bonus Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, symbiote tendrils can also lash out at nearby enemies within range, inflicting continuous damage.

description_trans.ko: 치유 덩굴을 쏘아내어 연결된 아군에게 지속 치유를 제공하며, 초과된 치유량은 추가 체력으로 전환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 回復の触手を放ち、繋がれた味方に持続回復を提供し、超過回復分を追加体力へと変換する。

teamups.name: GUARDIAN OF THE DEEP
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Shoot out healing tendrils; linked allies receive Continuous Healing, and excess healing is converted into Bonus Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, symbiote tendrils can also lash out at nearby enemies within range, inflicting continuous damage.

description_trans.ko: 베놈과 함께 플레이 시, 사거리 내 근처 적들에게 심비오트 덩굴을 휘둘러 지속적인 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: ヴェノムとチームアップ時、射程内の周囲の敵にシンビオートの触手を伸ばし、継続ダメージを与えることができる。

teamups.name: MR. POOL'S INTERDIMENSIONAL TOY BOX
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to spit out a Deadpool Plushie. The plushie continuously Taunts nearby enemies while spraying a healing mist onto surrounding allies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, the Deadpool Plushie asserts a much stronger Taunt while concurrently damaging enemies caught in its radius.

description_trans.ko: 데드풀 인형을 뱉어내는 새 능력을 얻습니다. 이 인형은 주변 적들을 지속적으로 도발(Taunt)하며 주변 아군들에게 치유 안개를 뿜어냅니다.
description_trans.ja: デッドプールぬいぐるみを吐き出す新アビリティを獲得する。ぬいぐるみは周囲の敵を持続的に挑発(Taunt)し、周囲の味方へ回復の霧を散布する。

teamups.name: MR. POOL'S INTERDIMENSIONAL TOY BOX
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to spit out a Deadpool Plushie. The plushie continuously Taunts nearby enemies while spraying a healing mist onto surrounding allies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, the Deadpool Plushie asserts a much stronger Taunt while concurrently damaging enemies caught in its radius.

description_trans.ko: 데드풀과 함께 플레이 시, 데드풀 인형이 훨씬 더 강력한 도발을 가하며 반경 내에 잡힌 적들에게 지속 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: デッドプールとチームアップ時、デッドプールぬいぐるみがさらに強力な挑発効果を発揮し、範囲内の敵にダメージを同時に与える。

role_name.ja: ストラテジスト (サポート)

skills.name: Energy Plasmoids
skills.description: Fire lumikinetic explosive light blasts forward to heal friends and damage foes. Triggering a Sparkle Mark briefly boosts Attack Speed and enables firing without consuming energy

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 70% at 30m

description_trans.ko: 빛의 에너지 플라스모이드를 발사하여 아군을 치유하고 적에게 피해를 줍니다. 표식 폭발 시 공격 속도가 증가하고 무소모 사격이 가능합니다.
description_trans.ja: 発光エネルギー弾を放ち、味方を回復し敵を攻撃する。標識発動で攻撃速度が上昇し無消費射撃が可能になる。

skills.name: Blooming Ball
skills.description: Launch a tracking orb of vampiric energy that damages enemies and heals allies in its radius. Striking the orb or hitting targets near it charges it up, increasing both its size and healing power. Press F to manually recall it.

stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 12s to recharge.
stats.Orb Maximum Duration: 6 seconds; when reaching its max charge for the first time, duration is increased by 6 seconds
stats.Range: 4m radius, increasing linearly with energy; up to 8m at max energy
stats.Healing: 35/sec, increasing linearly with energy; up to 50/sec at max energy
stats.Returned Energy on Recall: 0; increases linearly with energy, reaching max when the orb's remaining duration is greater than 6 seconds, restoring 1 charge

description_trans.ko: 흡혈 에너지 구체를 발사하여 아군을 치유하고 적을 공격합니다. 타격하여 에너지를 모으면 크기와 치유력이 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 吸血エネルギー球を放ち味方を回復し敵を攻撃する。エネルギーを溜めると大きさと回復力が増加する。

skills.name: Firework Finale
skills.description: Charge up and unleash a massive ring of outward-flying firework clusters, Knocking Back nearby enemies. These clusters then orbit you, creating a field that damages enemies and heals allies. Expanding the cluster radius outward will Launch Up struck enemies

stats.Spell Field Range: Inner circle radius 6m; Outer circle radius 10m

description_trans.ko: 거대한 불꽃놀이 링을 방출하여 적을 밀쳐내고, 주위를 공전하는 불꽃 지대를 형성해 적에게 피해를 주고 아군을 치유합니다.
description_trans.ja: 巨大な花火の輪を放射して敵をノックバックし、周囲を旋回する花火エリアで敵にダメージを与え味方を回復する。

skills.name: Sparking Sprint
skills.description: Wrap yourself in vampiric energy to gain a Speed Boost. While active, jump height and Attack Speed are increased, and Energy Blasts can be fired at no cost

description_trans.ko: 흡혈 에너지로 몸을 감싸 속도와 점프력, 공격 속도를 높이고 무소모 사격을 활성화합니다.
description_trans.ja: 吸血エネルギーを纏って移動速度と跳躍力、攻撃速度を高め、無消費射撃を行う。

skills.name: Dazzling Detonation
skills.description: Detonate a firework energy orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area and applying a Blind effect. The energy can also be transferred to an ally, granting them healing and a Speed Boost

stats.Spell Field Range: Matches current range of selected orb

description_trans.ko: 불꽃 에너지 구체를 폭발시켜 적에게 피해와 실명을 주고, 아군에게 전이시켜 치유와 가속을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 花火エネルギー球を起爆して敵にダメージとブラインドを与え、味方に付与して回復と加速を与える。

skills.name: Sparkle Mark
skills.description: Hitting targets with Dazzling Detonation and  Firework Finale applies a Sparkle Mark. Energy Plasmoids can detonate marks, granting allies a Healing Boost and Bonus Health, while dealing burst damage to enemies

description_trans.ko: 스킬 적중 시 불꽃 표식을 부착합니다. 기본 사격으로 표식을 폭발시키면 아군에게 치유 증폭과 추가 체력을 주고 적에게 폭발 피해를 줍니다.
description_trans.ja: スキル命中時に花火マークを付着させる。通常射撃でマークを起爆すると味方に回復強化と追加HPを与え敵に爆発ダメージを与える。

teamups.name: HELLFIRE SPARKS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: When Attack Speed is enhanced, Energy Plasmoids transform into a hitscan attack that grants self-healing on hit and is capable of dealing critical hits.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the Void Magic Mark is never cleared, allowing her to indefinitely sustain the hitscan attack form.

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff starts at 10m, down to 70% at 30m

description_trans.ko: 공격 속도가 강화되면 에너지 플라스모이드(Energy Plasmoids)가 히트스캔 방식으로 전환되어 치명타를 입힐 수 있으며, 적중 시 자신을 치유합니다.
description_trans.ja: 攻撃速度が強化されると、エナジー・プラズモイドが即着のヒートスキャン攻撃へと変化し、クリティカルヒット可能かつ命中時に自己回復するようになる。

teamups.name: HELLFIRE SPARKS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: When Attack Speed is enhanced, Energy Plasmoids transform into a hitscan attack that grants self-healing on hit and is capable of dealing critical hits.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the Void Magic Mark is never cleared, allowing her to indefinitely sustain the hitscan attack form.

stats.Special Effect: The Void Magic mark is never cleared

description_trans.ko: 더 후드와 함께 플레이 시, 공허 마법 표식(Void Magic Mark)이 사라지지 않아 히트스캔 공격 형태를 무한히 유지할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: ザ・フッドとチームアップ時、ヴォイド・マジックマークが消失しなくなり、ヒートスキャン攻撃形態を永続的に維持できるようになる。

teamups.name: VAMPIRIC KIN
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Deploy a Vampiric Field. Allies standing within the field gain Life Steal when attacking enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, allies inside the field receive an additional Continuous Healing effect.

description_trans.ko: 흡혈 영역(Vampiric Field)을 전개합니다. 영역 안에 서 있는 아군들은 적을 공격할 때 생명력 흡수(Life Steal) 효과를 얻습니다.
description_trans.ja: 吸血領域(Vampiric Field)を展開する。領域内に立つ味方は、敵を攻撃した際に生命力吸収(Life Steal)効果を獲得する。

teamups.name: VAMPIRIC KIN
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Deploy a Vampiric Field. Allies standing within the field gain Life Steal when attacking enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, allies inside the field receive an additional Continuous Healing effect.

description_trans.ko: 블레이드와 함께 플레이 시, 영역 내의 아군들이 추가 지속 치유 효과를 받습니다.
description_trans.ja: ブレイドとチームアップ時、領域内の味方が追加の持続回復効果を受ける。

role_name.ja: ストラテジスト (サポート)

skills.name: Mystical Missile
skills.description: Fire Mystical Missiles to heal allies or deal damage to enemies. Direct hits on allies provide extra healing

stats.Casting: Single-cast projectile with delayed impact that also generates a spell field
stats.Damage: The projectile deals no damage, while the spell field inflicts 25 damage per cast
stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 0.5m, decreasing to 80% at 2.5m

description_trans.ko: 신비한 마법 미사일을 발사해 아군을 치유하거나 적에게 피해를 줍니다. 아군 직격 시 추가 치유를 제공합니다.
description_trans.ja: 魔力ミサイルを放ち味方を回復するか敵にダメージを与える。味方に直撃させると追加回復が発生する。

skills.name: Deception
skills.description: Become Invisible and conjure an Illusion to deceive enemies

stats.Special Effect: Loki leaves an illusion in his place and becomes invisible while continuously healing himself. This invisibility has no time limit, but any actions other than casting Devious Exchange, reloading, or casting Doppelganger will render him visible
stats.Healing Amount: Health regenerates at a rate of 30 Health per second while invisible

description_trans.ko: 자신은 투명화 은신 상태가 되며 적을 속이는 환영 분신을 생성합니다.
description_trans.ja: 不可視状態となり、敵を欺く幻影の分身をその場に生成する。

skills.name: God of Mischief
skills.description: Shapeshift into a targeted ally or enemy hero and use all their abilities except any of their Team-Up Abilities

stats.Special Effect: After transforming, Loki's Ultimate ability will be fully charged. Casting a transformation-type Ultimate ability will extend the duration of God of Mischief until the transformation ability ends

description_trans.ko: 목표 아군이나 적 영웅으로 변신하여 해당 영웅의 팀업 스킬을 제외한 모든 능력을 복제 사용합니다.
description_trans.ja: 指定した味方または敵ヒーローに変身し、連携アビリティを除くすべての能力を使用可能になる。

skills.name: Regeneration Domain
skills.description: Use Rune Stones to create a magical field that provides allies Healing and converts incoming damage into further healing

stats.Casting: Release a spell field at the location of Loki and the Illusion
stats.Special Effect: The spell field is sustained by Rune Stones. It will disappear if the Rune Stone is destroyed or if its maximum duration is reached. Allies within the field will receive healing over time, and any damage taken will be converted into healing based on the amount of damage taken
stats.Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 5m and a height of 2m

description_trans.ko: 룬스톤으로 마법 결계를 생성하여 아군을 치유하고 들어오는 피해를 추가 치유량으로 전환합니다.
description_trans.ja: ルーンストーンで魔法陣を展開し、味方を回復すると同時に受けるダメージを追加回復へと変換する。

skills.name: Deific Blessing
skills.description: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Flower Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost

stats.Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 6.5m and a height of 2m.

description_trans.ko: 맨티스가 생명 에너지로 그루트의 나무 벽과 로키의 룬스톤을 강화합니다. 그루트는 꽃나무 벽(Flower Wall)을 추가로 생성할 수 있으며, Flora Colossus 상태일 때 주변 아군의 체력을 무작위로 회복시키고 받는 피해를 감소시킵니다. 로키의 룬스톤은 치유 영역 내 아군의 공격력을 강화합니다.
description_trans.ja: マンティスが生命エネルギーでグルートの木の壁とロキのルーンストーンを強化する。グルートは花の壁を追加展開可能になり、Flora Colossus状態時に周囲の味方を回復して被ダメージを軽減する。ロキのルーンストーンは再生領域内の味方の攻撃力を上昇させる。

skills.name: Doppelganger
skills.description: Project an Illusion that can cast some of Loki's abilities

stats.Special Effect: Project an Illusion at a selected location
stats.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 12s to recharge

description_trans.ko: 로키의 일부 스킬을 똑같이 따라 시전하는 환영 분신을 투사합니다.
description_trans.ja: ロキのアビリティを一部模倣して詠唱する幻影の分身を前方に投影する。

skills.name: Devious Exchange
skills.description: Swap with the selected Illusion

description_trans.ko: 선택한 환영 분신과 즉시 위치를 맞바꿉니다.
description_trans.ja: 選択した幻影の分身と即座に位置を入れ替える。

skills.name: Backstab
skills.description: Pull out a dagger to stab enemies, dealing extra damage when attacking an enemy from behind

description_trans.ko: 단검을 뽑아 적을 찌르며, 적의 등 뒤에서 공격할 경우 치명적인 추가 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 短剣を抜いて敵を刺し、敵の背後から攻撃した際に大ダメージを与える。

teamups.name: VILLAIN'S ILLUSION
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to target fallen heroes (friend or foe), letting Loki assume their form for a set time (cannot cast their Ultimate Ability).
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, Loki's transformation lasts slightly longer. Furthermore, taking lethal damage while transformed or in his Ultimate Ability state will merely revert him back to Loki with a sliver of Health, preventing a KO.

description_trans.ko: 쓰러진 영웅(아군 또는 적군)을 대상으로 지정하여 일정 시간 동안 대상의 형태로 변신하는 새 능력을 얻습니다 (궁극기는 시전 불가).
description_trans.ja: 倒れたヒーロー(味方または敵)を対象に指定し、一定時間その姿に変身する新アビリティを獲得する(アルティメットアビリティは使用不可)。

teamups.name: VILLAIN'S ILLUSION
teamups.description:

description_trans.ja: ステッピング・ディスクを通って移動方向へ瞬間移動する。テレポート中は無敵状態となる。

description_trans.ja: ドクター・ストレンジの秘術により、マジックは2体の敵を拘束するサイトラックの鎖を展開可能になる。互いの距離が離れるほど、より強力なスロウ効果が付与される。

skills.name: Eldritch Whirl
skills.description: Spin while swinging the Soulsword after exiting a Stepping Disc

stats.Damage: Deals 3 hits at intervals of 0.25s, each dealing 45 damage
stats.Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 12m and a height of 5m

description_trans.ko: 스테핑 디스크를 통과한 직후 소울소드를 크게 휘두르며 회전 베기 공격을 가합니다.

skills.name: Magik Slash

stats.Casting: A cuboid spell field in melee range

description_trans.ko: 스테핑 디스크를 빠져나온 후 림보의 악마를 소환하여 전방 적들을 덮치게 합니다.
description_trans.ja: ステッピング・ディスク通過後、リンボの悪魔を召喚して前方の敵を襲わせる。

skills.name: Iron Volley
skills.description: Fire a volley of magnetic orbs forward. The range of the resulting explosion increases based on distance flown

stats.Casting: Single-cast projectile with delayed impact that also generates a spell field
stats.Range: Initially, it produces a spell field with a 1m spherical radius; when the projectile reaches maximum distance, the explosion radius expands to a spell field with a 3m spherical radius
stats.Damage: Projectile Damage: 40. The spell field deals 40 damage at its center, reducing to 50% within a 3m radius from the center

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 자기장 구체들을 일제히 발사합니다. 구체의 비행거리가 멀어질수록 착탄 폭발 범위가 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ磁気オーブの連射を放つ。オーブの飛行距離に応じて着弾時の爆発範囲が拡大する。

skills.name: Mag-Cannon
skills.description: Convert the iron rings on Magneto's back into a Mag-Cannon and launch a metallic mass forward. Higher stacks of rings increase damage, and full stacks knock back enemies

stats.Damage: Iron Rings' first charge deals 40 damage, the second charge deals 65 damage, and the third charge deals 90 damage
stats.Cooldown: No cooldown, but the ability can only be activated when the Iron Ring has at least one charge
stats.Special Effect: When fully charged, the Iron Ring has a 6m knockback distance

description_trans.ko: 등 뒤의 철 고리를 자기장 캐논(Mag-Cannon)으로 변환해 금속 탄환을 발사합니다. 고리 중첩 수에 따라 피해량이 증가하며, 최대 중첩 시 적을 밀쳐냅니다.
description_trans.ja: 背中の鉄の輪をマグ・キャノンに変形させ、金属塊を前方へ発射する。輪のスタック数に応じてダメージが上昇し、最大スタック時は敵をノックバックする。

skills.name: Meteor M
skills.description: Draw in all materials around to forge an iron meteor that deals massive damage upon impact. Absorbing enemy projectiles can enhance the meteor's power, yet overloading will cause it to self-destruct

stats.Casting: Create a persistent spell field that launches a projectile upon completion, which generates another spell field on impact
stats.Explosion Range: Initially, the ability has a spherical range with a radius of 5m. After charging for 4s, it expands to an 8m radius
stats.Damage: The projectile deals no damage. The base damage at the center of the spell field starts at 100 and increases to 350 when fully charged. Each point of Energy adds an extra 3 points of damage to the spell field, with damage reducing to 50% at a distance of 6m from the center
stats.Special Effect: For each point of projectile damage absorbed, the power increases by 0.125, with a maximum absorption of 800 projectile damage

description_trans.ko: 주변의 모든 금속 물질을 끌어모아 거대한 철제 운석을 형성해 막대한 착탄 피해를 가합니다. 적 투사체를 흡수하여 위력을 극대화할 수 있으나, 과부하 시 자폭합니다.
description_trans.ja: 周囲の全物質を引き寄せて巨大な鉄の隕石を形成し、着弾時に壊滅的なダメージを与える。敵の弾丸を吸収して威力を高められるが、過負荷になると自爆する。

skills.name: Metallic Curtain
skills.description: Change the magnetic field around to form a metallic curtain, blocking all incoming projectiles

description_trans.ko: 주변 자기장을 왜곡시켜 금속 장막(Metallic Curtain)을 형성하고 전방에서 날아오는 모든 투사체를 차단합니다.
description_trans.ja: 周囲の磁場を変化させて金属のカーテンを展開し、飛来するすべての敵弾を遮断する。

stats.Special Effect: The shield grants one charge of Iron Ring for every 100 damage it absorbs

description_trans.ko: 지정한 아군 주변에 금속 보호막을 생성합니다. 보호막이 흡수한 피해는 마그네토 등 뒤의 철 고리로 변환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 指定した味方の周囲に金属シールドを展開する。吸収したダメージはマグニートーの背中の輪へと変換される。

skills.name: Iron Bulwark

stats.Special Effect: The shield grants one charge of Iron Ring for every 100 damage it absorbs

description_trans.ko: 자신 주변에 금속 보호막을 생성합니다. 보호막이 흡수한 피해는 마그네토 등 뒤의 철 고리로 변환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 自身の周囲に金属シールドを展開する。吸収したダメージは背中の輪へと変換される。

skills.name: ROYAL BLADE
skills.description: Gambit charges Magneto's greatsword with kinetic energy. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking enemies. The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay

description_trans.ko: 마그네토의 대검에 운동 에너지를 주입하여 에이스 대검으로 강화합니다. 적 타격 시 폭발하며 잔류 에너지가 2차 폭발 피해를 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: マグニートーの大剣に運動エネルギーを注入して強化する。命中時に爆発し、残余エネルギーが2次ダメージを与える。

skills.name: Magnetic Descent

description_trans.ko: 스페이스 키를 길게 눌러 천천히 활강 강하합니다.
description_trans.ja: スペース長押しでゆっくりと滑空降下する。

partner_name.ja: スカーレット・ウィッチ

partner_name.ja: スカーレット・ウィッチ

description_trans.ko: 스칼렛 위치와 함께 플레이 시, 마그네틱 캐논이 차징형 스킬로 바뀝니다. 차징 시 패시브 에너지를 소모하며, 소모된 에너지 세그먼트마다 적에게 피해를 입히는 혼돈의 대검을 발사합니다.

description_trans.ja: 敵の視点から見てマグニートーの動きやスキル発動を完全に模倣する磁気投影体を投射する。

			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, the magnetic projection receives a massive Health bump and will persist indefinitely unless destroyed or manually recalled.

description_trans.ko: 엠마 프로스트와 함께 플레이 시, 자기 투영체의 체력이 대폭 증가하며 파괴되거나 직접 회수하지 않는 한 영구적으로 유지됩니다.
description_trans.ja: エマ・フロストとチームアップ時、磁気投影体の体力が大幅に上昇し、破壊されるか手動で解除しない限り永続する。

skills.name: Spore Slumber

stats.Special Effect: A Mantis illusions will manifest beside the sedated heroes. Allies can attack this illusion to awaken the affected hero

skills.name: Allied Inspiration
skills.description: Consume Life Orbs to grant allies a Damage Boost

description_trans.ko: Life Orb를 소모하여 아군에게 공격력 증가 버프를 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: Life Orbを消費して味方に攻撃力アップバフを付与する。

skills.name: Natural Anger
skills.description: Consume Life Orbs to grant herself a Damage Boost

stats.Duration: 8s (the duration cannot stack; repeatedly casting will only refresh the duration)

description_trans.ko: Life Orb를 소모하여 자신의 공격력을 강화합니다.
description_trans.ja: Life Orbを消費して自身の攻撃力を強化する。

skills.name: Nature's Favor

stats.Special Effect: Consume Life Orbs to receive Healing Over Time

description_trans.ko: 비전투 시 이동 속도가 증가하며 Life Orb 소모 시 지속 자가 치유를 얻습니다.
description_trans.ja: 非負傷時に移動速度が上昇し、Life Orb消費時に自身のHPを持続回復する。

skills.name: Heavenly Guardian
skills.description: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Flower Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost

description_trans.ko: 맨티스가 생명 에너지로 그루트의 나무 벽과 로키의 룬스톤을 강화합니다. 그루트는 꽃나무 벽(Flower Wall)을 추가로 생성할 수 있으며, Flora Colossus 상태일 때 주변 아군의 체력을 무작위로 회복시키고 받는 피해를 감소시킵니다. 로키의 룬스톤은 치유 영역 내 아군의 공격력을 강화합니다.
description_trans.ja: マンティスが生命エネルギーでグルートの木の壁とロキのルーンストーンを強化する。グルートは花の壁を追加展開可能になり、Flora Colossus状態時に周囲の味方を回復して被ダメージを軽減する。ロキのルーンストーンは再生領域内の味方の攻撃力を上昇させる。

teamups.name: STAR BLOSSOM
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Recasting Healing Flower on a teammate with the effect enhances and spreads the healing aura.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, using Healing Flower on any teammate instantly triggers the enhanced Spell Field and healing effect.

stats.Special effect: When Star-Lord is selected as her Team-Up partner, enhance the healing output of Healing Flower from 10 + 2.5% of target's max Health/s to 15 + 3% of target's max Health/s

description_trans.ko: 치유의 꽃(Healing Flower) 효과를 받고 있는 아군에게 스킬을 재시전하면 치유 오라가 강화되고 확산됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ヒーリングフラワーの効果を受けている味方に再発動すると、回復オーラが強化され拡散する。

teamups.name: STAR BLOSSOM
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Recasting Healing Flower on a teammate with the effect enhances and spreads the healing aura.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, using Healing Flower on any teammate instantly triggers the enhanced Spell Field and healing effect.

stats.Special Effect: Casting Healing Flower on any ally enhances and spreads the healing effect
stats.Special effect: When Star-Lord is selected as her Team-Up partner, enhance the healing output of Healing Flower from 10 + 2.5% of target's max Health/s to 15 + 3% of target's max Health/s

description_trans.ko: 스타로드와 함께 플레이 시, 어떤 아군에게든 치유의 꽃을 사용하면 즉시 강화된 주문 지대와 치유 효과가 즉각 발동합니다.

teamups.name: VITALITY PACT

Base Effect: Upon defeat, Mantis can freely move as a soul, healing nearby allies, and reforge her body at a chosen spot. After using Natural Anger, the effect of Nature's Favor is enhanced, increasing the amount of healing provided.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, her soul state can forge Soul Bond with nearby teammates, granting Healing Over Timeand distributing damage taken across the bond.

partner_name.ja: アダム・ウォーロック
