description_trans.ko: 로그의 모든 공격이 운동 에너지 폭발을 일으켜 주변 적에게 피해를 주고 주변 아군을 치유합니다.
description_trans.ja: ローグの全攻撃が運動爆発を引き起こし、周囲の敵にダメージを与え周囲の味方を回復する。

teamups.name: MR. & MRS. X
teamups.description:
Base Effect: After activation, every attack triggers a kinetic explosion, dealing area damage to surrounding enemies while simultaneously healing nearby allies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Rogue remains permanently locked in the "Hearts as One" state.

description_trans.ko: 스킬 활성화 후 모든 공격이 키네틱 폭발을 일으켜 주변 적들에게 범위 피해를 주는 동시에 근처 아군을 치유합니다.
description_trans.ja: 発動後、すべての攻撃がキネティック爆発を引き起こし、周囲の敵に範囲ダメージを与えつつ近隣の味方を回復する。

teamups.name: MR. & MRS. X
teamups.description:
Base Effect: After activation, every attack triggers a kinetic explosion, dealing area damage to surrounding enemies while simultaneously healing nearby allies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Rogue remains permanently locked in the "Hearts as One" state.

stats.Special Effect: Permanently maintains the Hearts as One state

description_trans.ko: 갬빗과 함께 플레이 시, 로그가 '일심동체(Hearts as One)' 상태를 영구적으로 유지합니다.
description_trans.ja: ガンビットとチームアップ時、ローグが『一心同体(Hearts as One)』状態を永続的に維持する。

teamups.name: EXPLOSIVE ENTANGLEMENT
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Defensive Stance is fortified. Activating the ability expands a magnetic field, drastically boosting the Damage Reduction ratio of Defensive Stance. Furthermore, all damage absorbed by the field is converted directly into damage for Southern Brawl.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, Southern Brawl Knocks back enemies. Extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall.

description_trans.ko: 방어 자세(Defensive Stance)가 강화됩니다. 스킬 활성화 시 자기장을 전개하여 방어 자세의 피해 감소 비율을 대폭 증가시킵니다. 또한 자기장이 흡수한 모든 피해는 서던 브롤(Southern Brawl)의 공격력으로 직접 전환됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 防御スタンスが強化される。発動時に磁場を展開し、防御スタンスの被ダメージ軽減率を大幅に強化する。さらに磁場が吸収したすべてのダメージがサザン・ブロウルの攻撃力へと直接変換される。

teamups.name: EXPLOSIVE ENTANGLEMENT
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Defensive Stance is fortified. Activating the ability expands a magnetic field, drastically boosting the Damage Reduction ratio of Defensive Stance. Furthermore, all damage absorbed by the field is converted directly into damage for Southern Brawl.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, Southern Brawl Knocks back enemies. Extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall.

description_trans.ko: 매그니토와 함께 플레이 시, 서던 브롤이 적들을 밀쳐냅니다(Knock back). 적이 벽에 충돌하면 추가 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: マグニートーとチームアップ時、サザン・ブロウルが敵をノックバックさせる。壁に衝突した場合は追加ダメージを与える。

names.ja: スカーレット・ウィッチ

skills.name: Chaos Control
skills.description: Unleash Chaos Magic on enemies to deal damage and restore Chaos Energy. Concurrently damages any enemies within range bearing a Chaos Magic mark

stats.Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 3m and a height of 20m
stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 90% at 20m
stats.Special Effect 1: Attack the nearest enemy within range
stats.Special Effect 2: Hitting with Chaos Control charges Chthonian Burst

description_trans.ko: 혼돈 마법을 방출하여 적에게 피해를 입히고 Chaos Energy를 회복합니다. 동시에 범위 내 혼돈 마법 표식이 있는 모든 적에게 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: カオスマジックを放って敵にダメージを与え、Chaos Energyを回復する。同時に範囲内のカオスマジックのマークが付与されたすべての敵にもダメージを与える。

skills.name: Chthonian Burst
skills.description: Consume Chaos Energy to fire explosive magic missiles, damaging enemies

stats.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

description_trans.ko: Chaos Energy를 소모하여 폭발성 마법 미사일을 난사해 적들에게 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: Chaos Energyを消費して爆発マジックミサイルを連射し、敵にダメージを与える。

skills.name: Sorcery Surge
skills.description: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery, replacing Scarlet Witch's Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction

stats.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact
stats.Special Mechanic: Chaos Control can released during the Sorcery Surge

description_trans.ko: 닥터 스트레인지가 비전 마법의 정수를 공유하여, 스칼렛 위치의 Chthonian Burst를 Mystic Burst로 대체합니다. 공격 버튼을 유지하면 목표 방향으로 마법 미사일을 쉼 없이 고속 난사합니다.
description_trans.ja: ドクター・ストレンジが秘術の極意を共有し、スカーレット・ウィッチのChthonian BurstをMystic Burstへ強化する。長押しで目標方向へ魔法弾の猛烈な連続掃射を浴びせる。

skills.name: Reality Erasure
skills.description: Engage in free-flight while gaining Bonus Health and charging energy. While flying, continuously pull in nearby enemies and inflict Chaos Marks, dealing gradually increasing damage over time. Then, unleash the charged energy to deal massive area damage. Small chance to be immune to incoming damage from enemies within the ultimate's attack range

stats.Slow Rate: Begin to slow down by 1.5s, with the effect gradually increasing to -25% by 3.5s
stats.Special Effect: During this period, Scarlet Witch enters a Free-flight state, pulls in nearby enemies (within 15m radius) during cast charge. Max pull speed up to 3m/s

description_trans.ko: 자유 비행하며 추가 체력을 얻고 에너지를 충전합니다. 비행 중에는 주변 적들을 지속적으로 끌어당겨 혼돈 표식을 부여하고 점차 증가하는 지속 피해를 입힙니다. 그 후 충전된 에너지를 폭발시켜 막대한 범위 피해를 입힙니다. 궁극기 공격 범위 내의 적들로부터 받는 피해에 면역이 될 확률이 약간 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: 自由飛行しながら追加体力を獲得しエネルギーをチャージする。飛行中は周囲の敵を引き寄せてカオスマークを付与し時間経過とともに増加する持続ダメージを与える。その後チャージしたエネルギーを解放して壊滅的な大範囲ダメージを与える。ULTの攻撃範囲内にいる敵から受けるダメージを無効化する確率がわずかにある。

skills.name: Mystic Projection
skills.description: Enter the Phased state for free-flight. Press again to exit early

stats.Special Effect: During this period, Scarlet Witch enters the Projection state, can be healed by teammates

description_trans.ko: 위상 변위 상태에 진입하여 자유롭게 비행합니다. 다시 누르면 조기 종료됩니다.
description_trans.ja: フェーズ状態に入って自由に飛行する。再入力で早期終了する。

skills.name: Dark Seal
skills.description: Land a hit on a target or the scene, or press {Ability1} again to generate a Force Field. The initial explosion Stuns enemies within range, while continuing to apply a Slow effect for the remaining duration. Continuously inflicts Chaos Marks on enemies within range

stats.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

description_trans.ko: 대상이나 지형에 적중하거나 {Ability1} 키를 다시 눌러 결계를 형성합니다. 초기 폭발은 범위 내 적들을 기절시키며, 남은 지속 시간 동안 감속 효과를 지속적으로 적용합니다. 범위 내 적들에게 지속적으로 혼돈 표식을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 標的や地形に命中させるか、{Ability1}キーをもう一度押して結界を生成する。初期爆発で範囲内の敵をスタンさせ、残りの持続時間中はスロウ効果を与え続ける。範囲内の敵にカオスマークを継続的に付与する。

skills.name: SCARLET HEX
skills.description: Unleash a shockwave of Chaos Magic forward, dealing damage and applying a Chaos Magic mark to enemies

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 혼돈 마법의 충격파를 방출하여 적에게 피해를 입히고 혼돈 마법 표식을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へカオスマジックの衝撃波を放ち、敵にダメージを与えてカオスマジックのマークを付与する。

skills.name: Telekinesis
skills.description: Hold Space to fall slowly

description_trans.ko: 스페이스 키를 길게 눌러 천천히 활강 강하합니다.
description_trans.ja: スペース長押しでゆっくりと滑空降下する。

skills.name: CHAOS MARK
skills.description: While the mark is active, using Chaos Control deals damage to marked enemies. Dealing damage to enemies with a Chaos Mark grants Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 표식이 활성화되어 있는 동안 Chaos Control을 사용하면 표식이 남겨진 적들에게 피해를 입힙니다. 혼돈 표식을 가진 적에게 피해를 입히면 추가 체력을 얻습니다.
description_trans.ja: マークが有効な間、Chaos Controlを使用するとマークされた敵にダメージを与える。カオスマークを持つ敵にダメージを与えると追加体力を獲得する。

teamups.name: SORCERERS SUPREME
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Chthonian Burst is replaced with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, Scarlet Witch's maximum total Chaos Energy pool increases, and Chaos Control generates energy much faster when attacking.

partner_name.ja: ドクター・ストレンジ

description_trans.ko: 스킬 활성화 시 크토니안 버스트가 미스틱 버스트로 교체됩니다. 공격 버튼을 길게 누르면 목표 방향으로 마법 미사일을 맹렬하고 빠르게 연속 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 発動時にクトニアン・バーストがミスティック・バーストへと変化する。攻撃ボタンを長押しすることで、目標方向へ魔術ミサイルの猛烈な連射を浴びせる。

teamups.name: SORCERERS SUPREME
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Chthonian Burst is replaced with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, Scarlet Witch's maximum total Chaos Energy pool increases, and Chaos Control generates energy much faster when attacking.

partner_name.ja: ドクター・ストレンジ

description_trans.ko: 닥터 스트레인지와 함께 플레이 시, 스칼렛 위치의 최대 카오스 에너지 보유량이 증가하며 혼돈 제어(Chaos Control)로 적 공격 시 에너지가 훨씬 빠르게 충전됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ドクター・ストレンジとチームアップ時、スカーレット・ウィッチの最大カオスエネルギー量が増加し、カオス・コントロールでの攻撃時にエネルギーが大幅に早く蓄積される。

teamups.name: HEX FIREWORKS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Infuse firework energy into the Dark Seal forcefield, turning it into a Plasmoid Seal, allowing for a secondary blast. After expanding the Plasmoid Seal, pressing the {Ability1} key again while it persists will detonate the fireworks, dealing damage and inflicting Vulnerability.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, Scarlet Witch receives constant healing from the firework energy while using Mystic Projection.

description_trans.ko: 어둠의 인장(Dark Seal) 역장에 폭죽 에너지를 주입하여 플라스모이드 인장으로 변환시켜 2차 폭발을 일으킬 수 있게 합니다. 플라스모이드 인장을 전개한 후 지속 시간 동안 스킬 키를 다시 누르면 폭죽이 기폭되어 피해를 입히고 취약(Vulnerability)을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ダークシールの力場に花火エネルギーを注入してプラズモイド・シールへと変異させ、2次起爆を可能にする。力場展開中に再度スキルキーを押すと花火が炸裂し、ダメージと脆弱(Vulnerability)を付与する。

teamups.name: HEX FIREWORKS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Infuse firework energy into the Dark Seal forcefield, turning it into a Plasmoid Seal, allowing for a secondary blast. After expanding the Plasmoid Seal, pressing the {Ability1} key again while it persists will detonate the fireworks, dealing damage and inflicting Vulnerability.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, Scarlet Witch receives constant healing from the firework energy while using Mystic Projection.

description_trans.ko: 쥬빌리와 함께 플레이 시, 신비한 투영(Mystic Projection)을 사용하는 동안 폭죽 에너지로부터 지속 치유를 받습니다.
description_trans.ja: ジュビリーとチームアップ時、ミスティック・プロジェクション使用中に花火エネルギーによる持続回復を受け続ける。

skills.name: Spider-Power
skills.description: Swing fists forward to strike, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer

stats.Special Mechanic: The default attack is a punch, but after landing two consecutive punches, the next attack will be a flying kick

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 주먹을 휘둘러 타격하며, Spider-Tracer가 부착된 적에게 추가 피해를 줍니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ拳を振るって打撃を与え、Spider-Tracerが付着した敵に追加ダメージを与える。

skills.name: Web-Cluster
skills.description: Shoot a Web-Cluster that deals damage and attaches a Spider-Tracer to the hit enemy

stats.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory
stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 50% at 40m

description_trans.ko: 웹 클러스터를 발사하여 피해를 입히고 적중한 적에게 Spider-Tracer를 부착합니다.
description_trans.ja: ウェブクラスターを発射してダメージを与え、命中した敵にSpider-Tracerを付着させる。

skills.name: Spectacular Spin
skills.description: Launch Web-Clusters all around to damage and Stun enemies

stats.Special Effect: Striking an enemy applies a stacking Slow effect, and after reaching a certain number of stacks, the enemy will be Stunned

description_trans.ko: 사방으로 거미줄 뭉치를 난사하여 적들에게 피해를 입히고 기절시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: 全方位にウェブクラスターを乱射し、敵にダメージを与えてスタンさせる。

skills.name: Web-Swing
skills.description: Shoot a strand of webbing to swing.

description_trans.ko: 거미줄을 발사하여 공중 웹 스윙을 펼칩니다.
description_trans.ja: ウェブを発射して空中スイングを行う。

skills.name: Get Over Here!
skills.description: Shoot webbing to reel in the hit enemy. If the enemy is tagged with a Spider-Tracer, Spider-Man will get pulled to them instead

stats.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory
stats.Special Mechanic: Attack enemies marked with a Spider-Tracer, pulling Spider-Man towards them and performing a flying kick

description_trans.ko: 거미줄을 발사해 적중한 적을 끌어당깁니다. Spider-Tracer가 부착된 적이라면 스파이더맨이 적에게로 날아갑니다.
description_trans.ja: ウェブを発射して命中した敵を引き寄せる。敵にSpider-Tracerが付着している場合、スパイダーマンが敵の元へ急接近する。

skills.name: Amazing Combo
skills.description: Launch an enemy upward, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer

description_trans.ko: 적을 공중으로 띄워 올리며, Spider-Tracer가 부착된 적에게 추가 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 敵を上空へ打ち上げ、Spider-Tracerが付着した敵に追加ダメージを与える。

skills.name: Inferno Blast
skills.description: Human Torch stores Pyrokinetic Energy in Spider-Man's suit, enabling him to unleash an Inferno Blast that sprays a fiery web while performing a backflip to create distance. The flames damage enemies and apply a Burn-Tracer. Detonating these Burn-Tracers inflicts Damage Over Time

description_trans.ko: 휴먼 토치가 스파이더맨의 슈트에 발화 에너지를 주입하여 인페르노 블래스트를 발동할 수 있게 합니다. 화염 웹을 살포해 적에게 피해를 주고 번 트레이서를 부착하며, 폭발 시 강력한 지속 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: ヒューマン・トーチがスパイダーマンのスーツに発火エネルギーを充填し、インフェルノ・ブラストを解放可能にする。火炎ウェブを散布して敵にダメージと燃焼標識を与え、起爆時に強力な持続ダメージを与える。

skills.name: Sticky Spider-Bomb
skills.description: Cyber-Spiders Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging a Web-Cluster shot and granting Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 페니 파커가 스파이더맨에게 점착 폭탄을 제공합니다! 제한 시간 내에 투척하면 폭발하여 주변 적들에게 피해를 입히고 Spider-Tracer를 부착합니다. 시간 내 던지지 못하면 폭발해 웹 클러스터를 재장전하고 추가 체력을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ペニー・パーカーがスパイダーマンに粘着ボムを提供する！制限時間内に投擲すると爆発して周囲の敵にダメージを与えSpider-Tracerを付着させる。投げ損ねると自爆してウェブクラスターを再装填し追加HPを獲得する。

skills.name: Thwip and Flip
skills.description: Perform a double jump

stats.Special Mechanic: Can only be cast again after landing

description_trans.ko: 공중에서 2단 점프를 수행합니다.
description_trans.ja: 空中二段ジャンプを行う。

skills.name: Wall Crawl
skills.description: Press Space to wall crawl, and while crawling, left-click to sprint

description_trans.ko: Space를 눌러 벽을 기어오르며, 벽 이동 중 좌클릭으로 질주할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: Spaceで壁を登り、壁移動中に左クリックでダッシュする。

skills.name: Spider-Sense
skills.description: Give a warning of enemies that have been around

description_trans.ko: 주변에 접근하는 적들을 스파이더 센스로 미리 감지해 경고를 표시합니다.
description_trans.ja: 周囲に接近した敵をスパイダーセンスで感知し警告を表示する。

teamups.name: SYMBIOTE BOND
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Venom shares a part of his symbiote with Spider-Man, activating their symbiote abilities. Spider-Man can convert the symbiotes into explosive spikes that inflict harm on nearby enemies and relentlessly drive them back.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, this triggers additional Touch of Klyntar tendrils that continuously tether and damage enemies on top of the base effect.

description_trans.ko: 베놈이 심비오트의 일부를 스파이더맨에게 공유하여 심비오트 능력을 활성화합니다. 스파이더맨은 심비오트를 폭발적인 가시로 변환하여 주변 적들에게 피해를 입히고 가차 없이 밀쳐냅니다.
description_trans.ja: ヴェノムがシンビオートの一部をスパイダーマンと共有し、シンビオート能力を解放する。シンビオートを爆発的なトゲに変形させ、周囲の敵にダメージを与えて容赦なく突き放す。

teamups.name: SYMBIOTE BOND
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Venom shares a part of his symbiote with Spider-Man, activating their symbiote abilities. Spider-Man can convert the symbiotes into explosive spikes that inflict harm on nearby enemies and relentlessly drive them back.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, this triggers additional Touch of Klyntar tendrils that continuously tether and damage enemies on top of the base effect.

description_trans.ko: 베놈과 함께 플레이 시, 기본 효과에 더해 클린타르의 손길(Touch of Klyntar) 덩굴이 추가 발동하여 적들을 지속적으로 연결하고 피해를 줍니다.
description_trans.ja: ヴェノムとチームアップ時、基本効果に加えてクリンターの触手が追加発動し、敵を繋ぎ止めて継続ダメージを与える。

teamups.name: PARKER POWER-UP
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Spider-Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging all Web-Cluster shots.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Spider-Tracers applied by Web-Cluster are upgraded. Detonating these upgraded marks generates <Buff>Bonus Health for Spider-Man.

description_trans.ko: 페니 파커가 스파이더맨을 위해 점착 스파이더 폭탄을 제작합니다! 폭탄을 작동시킨 뒤 타이머가 끝나기 전에 던지면 폭발하여 주변 적에게 피해를 입히고 스파이더 트레이서(Spider-Tracer)를 부착합니다. 시간 내에 던지지 못하면 스파이더맨 본인에게 폭발하며 모든 거미줄 군집(Web-Cluster) 탄환을 즉시 재충전합니다.
description_trans.ja: ペニ・パーカーがスパイダーマンに粘着スパイダーボムを提供！起動後タイマー終了前に投げると爆破し、周囲の敵にダメージを与えスパイダートレーサーを付与する。時間内に投げないと自身で爆発し、ウェブクラスターの全弾を即座に再充填する。

teamups.name: PARKER POWER-UP
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Spider-Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging all Web-Cluster shots.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Spider-Tracers applied by Web-Cluster are upgraded. Detonating these upgraded marks generates <Buff>Bonus Health for Spider-Man.

description_trans.ko: 페니 파커와 함께 플레이 시, 거미줄 군집으로 부여된 스파이더 트레이서 표식이 업그레이드됩니다. 이 업그레이드된 표식을 터뜨리면 스파이더맨이 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: ペニ・パーカーとチームアップ時、ウェブクラスターで付与されるスパイダートレーサーが強化される。強化標印を起爆させるとスパイダーマンが追加体力を獲得する。

skills.name: Burst Acorn
skills.description: Shoot bouncing Burst Acorns

stats.Casting: Arced projectile that generates a spell field upon impact
stats.Damage Falloff: 70% falloff at 3m

description_trans.ko: 지형에 튕기는 도탄 폭발 도토리를 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 地形に跳ね返る炸裂ドングリを発射する。

skills.name: Squirrel Blockade
skills.description: Launch an acorn to unleash Squirrel Guards, Imprisoning the first hit enemy

stats.Casting: Charged projectile with an arced trajectory
stats.Projectile Speed: 20 - 60 m/s (Maximum speed is achieved after 0.7s of charging)

description_trans.ko: 도토리를 던져 다람쥐 경비대를 소환하여 적중한 적을 감금(Imprison)합니다.
description_trans.ja: ドングリを投擲してリス警備隊を召喚し、命中した敵を拘束(監禁)する。

skills.name: Unbeatable Squirrel Tsunami
skills.description: Summon a horde of squirrels to charge forward, dealing damage while bouncing against structures

stats.Special Mechanic: The squirrels will rush towards the nearest enemy after bouncing instead of bouncing randomly

description_trans.ko: 거대한 다람쥐 군단 쓰나미를 소환하여 지형에 튕기며 전방의 모든 적을 휩쓸어 버립니다.
description_trans.ja: 巨大なリス軍団の津波を召喚し、壁に跳ね返りながら前方の全敵を呑み込む。

skills.name: Tail Bounce
skills.description: Rocket upwards with a bounce of her tail

description_trans.ko: 풍성한 꼬리로 바닥을 박차고 공중으로 힘차게 솟구쳐 오릅니다.
description_trans.ja: ふさふさの尻尾で地面を蹴り、上空へ勢いよく飛び上がる。

skills.name: Mammal Bond
skills.description: Reload Burst Acorns and can use an ability without cooldown once in a short duration

description_trans.ko: 도토리를 즉시 재장전하고 짧은 시간 동안 쿨다운 없이 스킬을 1회 재사용합니다.
description_trans.ja: ドングリを即座にリロードし、短時間アビリティをクールダウンなしで1回再使用可能にする。

skills.name: Squirrel Missile
skills.description: When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 4m, decreasing to 50% at 8m
stats.Special Effect: Automatically track enemies within a horizontal angle of 60°, a vertical angle of 60°, and a maximum distance of 60m

description_trans.ko: 울트론의 광선이 모든 영웅을 관통하며 적에게 피해를 주고 아군을 치유하는 나노 레이로 진화합니다.
description_trans.ja: ウルトロンのビームが全キャラクターを貫通し、敵にダメージを与え味方を回復するナノ・レイへと進化する。

teamups.name: SQUIRREL MISSILE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, using Squirrel Blockade simultaneously fires a Squirrel Missile.

description_trans.ko: 다람쥐 미사일 능력을 얻습니다. 다람쥐 한 마리를 아이언맨의 나노기술 건틀릿에 태워 유도 미사일로 발사합니다. 적중 시 다람쥐는 화염 폭발 직전에 탈출합니다.
description_trans.ja: リスミサイル能力を獲得する。アイアンマンのナノテクグローブにリスを乗せ、誘導ミサイルとして発射する。命中時、激しい爆発の直前にリスは安全に脱出する。

teamups.name: SQUIRREL MISSILE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, using Squirrel Blockade simultaneously fires a Squirrel Missile.

stats.Special Effect: When Squirrel Girl uses Squirrel Blockade, she simultaneously launches Squirrel Missiles

description_trans.ko: 아이언맨과 함께 플레이 시, 다람쥐 바리케이드(Squirrel Blockade) 사용 시 다람쥐 미사일이 동시에 발사됩니다.
description_trans.ja: アイアンマンとチームアップ時、リスのバリケード発動時にリスミサイルが同時に発射される。

teamups.name: ESU ALUMNUS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Spider-Man gives Squirrel Girl a web bomb. She can launch it to unleash an explosion upon contact with the environment or an enemy, briefly Slowing and damaging enemies caught in the blast.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, Squirrel Girl receives more Web Fluid. After throwing Webbed Acorn, viscous web fluid coats the ground alongside the explosion, leaving behind a sticky Web Area. Enemies within suffer a continuous Slow that scales into a Stun if they linger too long.

description_trans.ko: 스파이더맨이 스쿼럴 걸에게 거미줄 폭탄을 건네줍니다. 폭탄을 투척하면 지형이나 적에 닿는 즉시 폭발하여 폭발에 휘말린 적들에게 피해를 입히고 잠시 둔화(Slow)시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: スパイダーマンがスクイレル・ガールにウェブボムを渡す。投擲すると地形や敵に接触して爆発し、巻き込まれた敵にダメージと一時的な減速(Slow)を与える。

teamups.name: ESU ALUMNUS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Spider-Man gives Squirrel Girl a web bomb. She can launch it to unleash an explosion upon contact with the environment or an enemy, briefly Slowing and damaging enemies caught in the blast.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, Squirrel Girl receives more Web Fluid. After throwing Webbed Acorn, viscous web fluid coats the ground alongside the explosion, leaving behind a sticky Web Area. Enemies within suffer a continuous Slow that scales into a Stun if they linger too long.

stats.Special Effect: Stunned after remaining in the web zone for 2s

description_trans.ko: 스파이더맨과 함께 플레이 시, 더 많은 거미줄 용액을 공급받습니다. 거미줄 도토리를 던진 후 폭발과 함께 지면에 끈적이는 거미줄 지대가 형성됩니다. 지대 내부의 적은 지속적인 둔화를 받으며, 오래 머무를 경우 기절(Stun) 상태에 빠집니다.
description_trans.ja: スパイダーマンとチームアップ時、より多くのウェブフルードを獲得。ドングリ投擲後、爆発とともに地面に粘着ネットエリアが形成される。内部の敵は継続減速を受け、長時間留まるとスタン(Stun)する。

skills.name: Element Guns
skills.description: Shoot enemies with dual Element Guns

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 60% at 25m
stats.Crosshair Spread Radius (at 10m): After 2 consecutive shots, the spread increases to 0.15m; after 5 consecutive shots, the spread expands to 0.24m

description_trans.ko: 쌍권총 Element Gun으로 적들을 사격합니다.
description_trans.ja: 2丁のElement Gunで敵を射撃する。

skills.name: Stellar Shift
skills.description: Dodge in the direction of movement and swiftly reload

description_trans.ko: 이동 방향으로 회피하며 즉시 탄환을 재장전합니다.
description_trans.ja: 移動方向へローリング回避し、即座にリロードする。

skills.name: Galactic Legend
skills.description: Engage in free-flight and lock onto enemies in sight

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 25m, decreasing to 75% at 40m
stats.Special Mechanic: During this period, Star-Lord's Reload Speed increases significantly

description_trans.ko: 자유 비행에 돌입하여 시야 내의 적들을 자동으로 조준 사격합니다.
description_trans.ja: 自由飛行状態に入り、視界内の敵を自動ロックオンして一斉掃射する。

skills.name: Rocket Propulsion
skills.description: Consume energy to gain a Movement Boost and soar forward

description_trans.ko: 에너지를 소모하여 비행 속도를 가속하고 전방으로 날아갑니다.
description_trans.ja: エネルギーを消費して飛行速度を加速させ、前方へ高速飛行する。

skills.name: Blaster Barrage
skills.description: Fire a frenzy of shots, causing damage to enemies within range.

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 4m, decreasing to 80% at 8m

description_trans.ko: 난사를 퍼부어 범위 내의 적들에게 지속적인 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 弾幕を乱射し、範囲内の敵に激しいダメージを与える。

skills.name: Astral Jump
skills.description: Star-Lord gets a teleport to its deployment point from anywhere on the map

stats.Cooldown: Teleport Cooldown 30s; jump device deployment Cooldown 5s.

description_trans.ko: 맵 어느 곳에서든 설치된 비콘 위치로 즉시 순간이동합니다.
description_trans.ja: マップ上のどこからでも設置ポイントへと即座に瞬間移動する。

teamups.name: FLORA MUNITIONS
teamups.description:
Gain a new ability to toss Twisted Thorn Seeds forward. Upon landing, they rapidly Sprout and take root, generating Thorn Snares around the area. Enemies stepping on a snare take damage and suffer a Root effect.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, the number of Thorn Snares deployed increases, and the damage dealt when an enemy steps on them is boosted.

description_trans.ko: 뒤틀린 가시 씨앗을 전방에 투척하는 새 능력을 얻습니다. 씨앗은 착탄 시 빠르게 싹을 틔우고 뿌리를 내려 주변에 가시 덫들을 생성합니다. 덫을 밟은 적은 피해를 입고 속박(Root)됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ねじれた茨の種を前方へ投擲する新アビリティを獲得する。着弾時に急速発芽して根を張り、周囲に茨の罠を展開する。罠を踏んだ敵はダメージを受け移動不能(拘束)になる。

teamups.name: FLORA MUNITIONS

description_trans.ja: グルートとチームアップ時、展開される茨の罠の数が増加し、罠を踏んだ敵に与えるダメージが大幅に強化される。

teamups.name: STAR-SOUL
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to place a Telekinetic Beacon. You can teleport back to the location where the beacon is deployed from anywhere on the map. Upon defeat, Star-Lord will cocoon and respawn at the Telekinetic Beacon's coordinates.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, every time Star-Lord participates in a KO, Telekinetic Beaconcooldown is reduced.

partner_name.ja: アダム・ウォーロック

description_trans.ko: 염동력 비컨을 설치하는 새 능력을 얻습니다. 맵 어디에서든 비컨이 설치된 위치로 순간이동해 복귀할 수 있습니다. 사망 시 스타로드는 고치를 형성하여 해당 비컨의 좌표에서 부활합니다.
description_trans.ja: 念動ビーコンを設置する新アビリティを獲得する。マップのどこからでもビーコンの設置位置へテレポート帰還できる。倒された際、スター・ロードは繭を形成してビーコンの座標で復活する。

partner_name.ja: アダム・ウォーロック

description_trans.ko: 아담 워록과 함께 플레이 시, 스타로드가 처치(KO)에 기여할 때마다 염동력 비컨의 재사용 대기시간이 감소합니다.
description_trans.ja: アダム・ウォーロックとチームアップ時、スター・ロードがキル(KO)に関与するたびに念動ビーコンのクールダウンが短縮される。

skills.name: Wind Blade

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 15m, decreasing to 60% at 30m

description_trans.ko: 날씨를 전환하여 아군을 강화합니다. 토네이도는 이동 속도를 증가시키고, 천둥은 공격력을 증가시킵니다.

skills.name: Goddess Boost

description_trans.ja: ソーとチームアップ時、ボルトラッシュが連鎖雷撃(チェインライトニング)となり、敵から敵へと跳弾連鎖するようになる。

description_trans.ja: 豪雨を降らせて自身と味方チーム全員を持続的に回復する。

teamups.description:
Base Effect: Unleash a torrential downpour that continuously heals both herself and her teammates.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, casting Omega Hurricane allows Jeff to swim inside the cyclone, generating a localized Jeff-nado.

partner_name.ja: ジェフ・ザ・ランド・シャーク

description_trans.ko: 제프 더 랜드 샤크와 함께 플레이 시, 오메가 허리케인을 시전하면 제프가 회오리바람 안에서 헤엄치며 국지적인 제프-네이도(Jeff-nado)를 발생시킬 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: ジェフ・ザ・ランドシャークとチームアップ時、オメガハリケーン発動時にジェフが竜巻の内部を泳ぎ回り、局所的なジェフネード(Jeff-nado)を巻き起こすことができる。

skills.name: Adjudication
skills.description: Fire at enemies with Adjudication, his Automatic Rifle

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 85% at 40m

description_trans.ko: 돌격소총 Adjudication으로 적들을 연사 사격합니다.
description_trans.ja: アサルトライフルAdjudicationで敵をフルオート射撃する。

skills.name: Deliverance
skills.description: Fire at enemies with Deliverance, his Shotgun

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 8m, decreasing to 40% at 15m

description_trans.ko: 산탄총 Deliverance로 적들을 사격합니다.
description_trans.ja: ショットガンDeliveranceで敵を射撃する。

skills.name: Scourge Grenade
skills.description: Throw a smoke grenade forward to obscure enemy vision and leap backward

stats.Special Effect: Create a temporary smokescreen that obstructs vision

description_trans.ko: 전방에 연막탄을 투척해 적의 시야를 가리고 후방으로 도약합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方にスモークグレネードを投げて敵の視界を遮断し、後方へ跳躍する。

skills.name: Final Judgement
skills.description: Unleash two Gatling guns and missiles to attack enemies

stats.Casting: Rapid-fire projectiles that hit instantly and have a tracking trajectory
stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 70% at 40m
stats.Crosshair Spread Radius (at 10m): Start with a spread radius of 0.6m, which reduces to 0.3m after 50 shots, and further decreases to 0.15m after 100 shots

description_trans.ko: 쌍열 개틀링 건과 미사일을 일제 발사하여 적들을 초토화합니다.
description_trans.ja: 2丁のガトリングガンとミサイルを一斉連射して敵を殲滅する。

skills.name: Vantage Connection
skills.description: Launch a hook to generate a cable that enables the Punisher to move rapidly by pressing F

description_trans.ko: 갈고리를 발사해 케이블을 설치하고 F를 눌러 신속하게 와이어 이동합니다.
description_trans.ja: フックを発射してケーブルを設置し、Fキーで高速ジップライン移動を行う。

skills.name: Culling Turret
skills.description: Deploy a Culling Turret that grounds Punisher and blocks damage from the front while dealing massive damage

stats.Casting: Rapid-fire projectiles that create a spell field upon impact
stats.Crosshair Spread Radius (at 10m): Start with a spread radius of 0.2m, which reduces to 0.1m after 10 shots, and further decreases to 0.05m after 20 shots

description_trans.ko: Culling Turret을 거치하여 전방 공격을 방어하면서 막강한 화력으로 적들을 분쇄합니다.
description_trans.ja: Culling Turretを設置して位置を固定し、前方からの攻撃を防ぎながら猛烈な火力を放つ。

skills.name: JUSTICE SENSE
skills.description: Daredevil shares the location of his Sonic Pursuit target with The Punisher. At the same time, The Punisher can launch a devil-infused shock grenade to damage and blind enemies

description_trans.ko: 데어데블이 추적 대상 위치를 퍼니셔에게 공유하며, 퍼니셔는 악마 충격 수류탄을 투척해 적을 실명시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: デアデビルが追撃標的の位置をパニッシャーに共有し、パニッシャーは電撃グレネードで敵にダメージとブラインドを与える。

skills.name: Ancient Judgement
skills.description: The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher

description_trans.ko: 퍼니셔가 데빌 다이노소어에 탑승하여 화력을 퍼붓습니다. 탑승 중 공룡이 퍼니셔가 받는 피해의 일부를 대신 흡수합니다.
description_trans.ja: パニッシャーがデビル・ダイナソーに騎乗して射撃を行う。騎乗中、恐竜がパニッシャーの被ダメージの一部を肩代わりする。

skills.name: Warrior's Gaze
skills.description: Retain vision of enemies that disappear from view for a short duration

stats.Special Effect: Retain vision of enemies that disappear from view for a short duration

description_trans.ko: 시야에서 벗어난 적의 실루엣을 잠시 동안 계속 추적하여 포착합니다.
description_trans.ja: 視界から外れた敵のシルエットを短時間透視・追跡し続ける。

skills.name: CUTTING-EDGE TECH
skills.description: The Punisher upgrades Black Widow's arsenal, adding a Pulse Mode to her Red Room Rifle. While the ability is active, using Straight Shooter fires a pulse beam that deals piercing damage

description_trans.ko: 퍼니셔가 블랙 위도우의 무기를 개조하여 Red Room Rifle에 펄스 모드를 추가합니다. 활성화 중 Straight Shooter 사용 시 관통 펄스 빔을 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: パニッシャーがブラック・ウィドウの兵装をアップグレードし、Red Room Rifleにパルスモードを追加する。発動中にStraight Shooterを使用すると貫通パルスビームを放つ。

teamups.name: BESTIAL HUNT
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Shoot piercing bullets that carry a Damage Boost effect.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Daredevil, the bullets break enemy summoned walls and shields more quickly.

description_trans.ko: 공격력 증가(Damage Boost) 효과가 적용된 관통 탄환을 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 与ダメージ上昇効果を帯びた貫通弾を発射する。

teamups.name: BESTIAL HUNT
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Shoot piercing bullets that carry a Damage Boost effect.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Daredevil, the bullets break enemy summoned walls and shields more quickly.

description_trans.ko: 데어데블과 함께 플레이 시, 탄환이 적의 소환된 벽과 방어막을 훨씬 더 빠르게 파괴합니다.
description_trans.ja: デアデビルとチームアップ時、弾丸が敵の召喚した壁やシールドをより素早く破壊する。

teamups.name: AMMO OVERLOAD
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Throw an Ammo Overload Device in the target direction. Upon entering the device's range, receive Faster Firing.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the device grants Infinite Ammo.

description_trans.ko: 목표 방향으로 탄약 과부하 장치를 투척합니다. 장치의 범위 내에 들어가면 연사 속도가 빨라집니다.
description_trans.ja: 目標方向へ弾薬過負荷装置を投擲する。装置の範囲内に入ると連射速度が上昇する。

teamups.name: AMMO OVERLOAD
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Throw an Ammo Overload Device in the target direction. Upon entering the device's range, receive Faster Firing.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the device grants Infinite Ammo.

stats.Special Effect: Adds unlimited ammo on top of the base effect

description_trans.ko: 로켓 라쿤과 함께 플레이 시, 해당 장치가 무제한 탄약(Infinite Ammo) 효과를 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ロケット・ラクーンとチームアップ時、装置が無制限の弾薬(無限弾)効果を付与する。

skills.name: Rocky Jab
skills.description: Rapidly punch forward

stats.Attack Interval: Double strike 0.33s between attacks, 1s between sets.

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 바위 주먹을 빠르게 연속으로 내지릅니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ岩の拳で素早い連続パンチを繰り出す。

skills.name: Stone Haymaker
skills.description: Deliver a devastating Heavy Blow. Can Knock Down flying enemies.

stats.Damage: 55+8% of enemies' max Health per hit
stats.Special Effect: Move forward 3 meters while punching; gain Bonus Health equal to damage dealt (up to 150); once hit, this ability can knock down flying enemies to the ground

description_trans.ko: 파괴적인 헤비 블로우를 내질러 적을 강타합니다. 비행 중인 적을 지면으로 격추(Knock Down)시킬 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: 壊滅的なヘビーブローを放つ。飛行中の敵を地面へ叩き落とす(ノックダウン)ことができる。

skills.name: Clobberin' Time
skills.description: Use immense power to launch up all enemies in front of the Thing into the air

stats.Range: Step spell field: 3m high, 10m wide, advancing 2m every 0.1 seconds, up to a maximum of 18m
stats.Special Effect: Stun duration 2.5s

description_trans.ko: 엄청난 완력으로 지면을 내리쳐 씽 전방의 모든 적을 공중 높이 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 絶大な怪力で地面を粉砕し、前方の全敵を上空へ高く打ち上げる。

skills.name: Yancy Street Charge
skills.description: Continuously charge forward, launching up enemies and leaving behind a zone at the final position that prevents the use of mobility abilities

stats.Damage: Charge: 30; ground slam: 20; immobilization zone: 15 per/s
stats.Spell Field Range: Ground slam: 8m radius, 2.5m high cylindrical spell field. Immobilization zone: 8m radius, 4m high cylindrical spell field
stats.Special Effect: Gain 200 Bonus Health during skill activation

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 거침없이 돌진하며 부딪힌 적들을 띄우고, 돌진 종착지에 이동기 사용을 차단하는 억제 구역을 생성합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ猛進して敵を打ち上げ、突進終了地点に移動アビリティ使用不可エリアを生成する。

skills.name: Embattled Leap
skills.description: Jump toward an ally and apply damage reduction to yourself and allies within the landing area

stats.Cooldown: Basic Cooldown 3s, with a charge of 10s per use
stats.Special Effect: Apply a 20% damage reduction effect to self and 20% damage reduction to all allies within 5m of his landing point for 3s

description_trans.ko: 아군을 향해 도약하며, 착지 구역 내의 자신과 아군에게 받는 피해 감소 효과를 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 味方へ向けて跳躍し、着地点の自身と味方に被ダメージ軽減効果を付与する。

skills.name: Battle Blitz
skills.description: Jump toward an enemy and apply Vulnerability to enemies within the landing area

stats.COOLDOWN: Basic Cooldown 3s, with a charge of 10s per use, shares the same Cooldown with the E Key ability
stats.SPECIAL EFFECT: Apply a 20% Vulnerability to all enemies within 5m of his landing point for 3s

description_trans.ko: 적을 향해 도약하여 착지 구역 내의 적들에게 취약(Vulnerability, 받는 피해 증가) 효과를 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 敵へ向けて跳躍し、着地点の敵に脆弱(被ダメージ増加)効果を付与する。

skills.name: GAMMA CHARGE
skills.description: Hulk charges Black Panther and The Thing with gamma radiation. When Black Panther's health is low, he gains a gamma shield, becoming Unstoppable and blocking attacks. The Thing gains Gamma Gauntlets, boosting Damage and range of his Rocky Jab and Stone Haymaker. Dealing damage with these attacks grants Bonus Health, and maximum Bonus Health cap is increased

description_trans.ko: 헐크가 블랙 팬서와 씽에게 감마 방사선을 주입합니다. 블랙 팬서는 체력이 낮아지면 감마 실드를 얻어 저지 불가 상태가 됩니다. 씽은 감마 건틀릿을 얻어 Rocky Jab과 Stone Haymaker의 피해량 및 사거리가 증가하며, 공격 적중 시 추가 체력을 얻고 최대 추가 체력 상한이 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: ハルクがブラック・パンサーとザ・シングにガンマ放射線を注入する。ブラック・パンサーは瀕死時にガンマシールドを得て阻止不能となる。ザ・シングはガンマ・ガントレットを獲得してパンチの威力と射程が上昇し、攻撃時に追加空力を得て上限値が拡張される。

skills.name: Flying Thing
skills.description: Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage, launching enemies, and creating a zone that disables mobility abilities

stats.Damage: Launch-up spell field causes 30 damage; mobility abilities disabling spell field causes 15 damage per second
stats.Launch Up Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 8m and a height of 1m
stats.Mobility Abilities Disabling Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 8m and a height of 8m

description_trans.ko: 휴먼 토치가 씽을 공중으로 들어 올려 지면으로 내리찍어 범위 피해와 띄우기, 이동기 차단 구역을 형성합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヒューマン・トーチがザ・シングを空中に持ち上げて叩きつけ、範囲ダメージと打ち上げ、移動アビリティ使用不可エリアを展開する。

skills.name: Cosmic Fastball
skills.description: Wolverine and The Thing can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, The Thing can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forward

description_trans.ko: 울버린과 씽이 특수 상호작용을 활성화합니다. 양측이 확인하면 씽이 울버린을 들어 올려 전방으로 강력하게 던집니다 (Cosmic Fastball).
description_trans.ja: ウルヴァリンとザ・シングが相互作用を行う。双方が承認すると、ザ・シングがウルヴァリンを持ち上げて前方へ勢いよく投擲する。

skills.name: Unyielding Will
skills.description: Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects

stats.Special Effect: Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects

description_trans.ko: 공중 띄우기, 밀쳐냄(Knockback) 등 모든 강제 이동 및 넉백 효과에 완전히 면역이 됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 打ち上げ、ノックバック、その他あらゆる強制移動効果を完全に無効化する。

teamups.name: TWO IN ONE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Enter an enhanced state upon activation. For the duration, The Thing's fists are violently engulfed in flames. Every Rocky Jab deals splash damage, and every Stone Haymaker creates an explosion, dealing damage in a frontal cone.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage and Stun to enemies. The Thing then automatically enters his flaming enhanced state upon landing.

stats.Special Effect: Increases the cast speed of Rock Jab and Stone Haymaker

description_trans.ko: 스킬 활성화 시 강화 상태에 진입합니다. 지속 시간 동안 더 씽의 주먹이 거센 불길에 휩싸입니다. 모든 바위 잽이 스플래시 피해를 입히며, 모든 돌 헤이메이커가 폭발을 일으켜 전방 부채꼴 범위에 피해를 줍니다.
description_trans.ja: 発動時に強化状態に入る。持続時間中、ザ・シングの拳が激しい業火に包まれる。すべてのロッキージャブが周囲に飛散ダメージを与え、ストーン・ヘイメイカーが爆発を起こして前方扇形にダメージを与える。

teamups.name: TWO IN ONE
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Enter an enhanced state upon activation. For the duration, The Thing's fists are violently engulfed in flames. Every Rocky Jab deals splash damage, and every Stone Haymaker creates an explosion, dealing damage in a frontal cone.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage and Stun to enemies. The Thing then automatically enters his flaming enhanced state upon landing.

description_trans.ko: 휴먼 토치와 함께 플레이 시, 휴먼 토치가 더 씽을 공중으로 들어 올린 후 지면으로 강하게 내리꽂아 적들에게 피해와 기절(Stun)을 입힙니다. 더 씽은 착지 시 자동으로 불타는 강화 상태에 진입합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヒューマン・トーチとチームアップ時、トーチがシングを空中へ抱え上げて地面へ叩きつけ、敵にダメージとスタンを与える。シングは着地時に自動で燃え盛る強化状態へ移行する。

teamups.name: UNBREAKABLE FORCES
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Generate a layer of Psionic Armor upon activation, granting Bonus Health scaling off currently missing Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up Invisible Woman, the Psionic Armor is fortified. While active, every time The Thing takes a set amount of damage, the armor pulses out a wave of area healing for allies. Furthermore, the conversion ratio for missing Health into Bonus Health is increased.

partner_name.ja: インビジブル・ウーマン

stats.Special Effect: When Health reaches 50%, Bonus Health generation frequency increases by 100%

description_trans.ko: 스킬 활성화 시 사이오닉 아머를 형성하여 현재 잃은 체력에 비례한 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: 発動時にサイオニックアーマーを生成し、現在失われている体力に応じた追加体力を獲得する。

teamups.name: UNBREAKABLE FORCES
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Generate a layer of Psionic Armor upon activation, granting Bonus Health scaling off currently missing Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up Invisible Woman, the Psionic Armor is fortified. While active, every time The Thing takes a set amount of damage, the armor pulses out a wave of area healing for allies. Furthermore, the conversion ratio for missing Health into Bonus Health is increased.

partner_name.ja: インビジブル・ウーマン

description_trans.ko: 인비저블 우먼과 함께 플레이 시, 사이오닉 아머가 강화됩니다. 활성화된 동안 더 씽이 일정량의 피해를 받을 때마다 방어구가 치유 파동을 방출하여 주변 아군을 치유합니다. 또한 잃은 체력의 추가 체력 전환 비율이 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: インビジブル・ウーマンとチームアップ時、アーマーが強化される。持続中に一定量のダメージを受けるたび、鎧が回復の波動を放って周囲の味方を回復する。さらに失った体力の追加体力への変換率が上昇する。

skills.name: Mjolnir Bash
skills.description: Wield Mjolnir to strike enemies. When Awakened, Thor can launch lightning arc waves to deal damage

description_trans.ko: Mjolnir를 휘둘러 적을 공격합니다. Awakened 상태에서는 번개 아크 파동을 방출해 피해를 줍니다.
description_trans.ja: Mjolnirを振るって敵を攻撃する。Awakened状態では雷電アーク波を放ちダメージを与える。

skills.name: Hammer Throw
skills.description: Throw Mjolnir forward which then returns

stats.Casting: Launch a single-target projectile that returns after a delayed hit
stats.Projectile Speed: The projectile travels outward at a speed of 60m per second and returns at a speed of 80m per second
stats.Damage: Outward Projectile Damage: 50; Returning Projectile Damage: 25
stats.Special Effect: Hits grant 75 Bonus Health (only triggers once per throw, even if hitting multiple enemies)

description_trans.ko: Mjolnir를 전방으로 투척한 후 다시 손으로 회수합니다.
description_trans.ja: Mjolnirを前方へ投擲し、手元へ呼び戻す。

skills.name: God of Thunder
skills.description: Soar upwards and smite the ground after charging for a duration, inflicting damage on enemies within range

stats.Casting: A persistent spell field that generates a one-time spell field upon expiration
stats.Range: The sustained spell field is cylindrical, measuring 8m in radius and 20m in height, whereas the one-time spell field has an 8m spherical radius
stats.Damage: The sustained spell field lasts for 0.5s, dealing 40 damage, while the one-time spell field deals 220 damage
stats.Special Effect: After Ultimate Ability lands, Stun surrounding enemies for 1s

description_trans.ko: 상공으로 도약해 에너지를 충전한 후 지면을 강타하여 범위 내 적들에게 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 上空へ飛び上がりチャージ後に地面を叩きつけ、範囲内の敵にダメージを与える。

skills.name: Storm Surge
skills.description: Hold to spin Mjolnir before dashing forward and knocking back enemies

stats.Dash Distance: No charge: 10m; Full charge: 20m. When carrying an enemy, the ranges are 6m with no charge and 13m with full
stats.Damage: No Charge Damage: 40; Full Charge Damage: 60

description_trans.ko: 길게 눌러 Mjolnir를 회전시킨 뒤 전방으로 돌진하여 적들을 밀쳐냅니다.
description_trans.ja: 長押しでMjolnirを回転させてから前方へ突進し、敵をノックバックさせる。

skills.name: Lightning Realm
skills.description: Summon lightning that restores Thorforce based on the number of hit enemies

stats.Damage: Deal 40 damage when enemies cross the boundaries
stats.Special Effect: For each enemy within the spell area, 1 point of Thorforce is restored. Enemies that cross the boundary will be Slowed by 30%, Enemies that cross the boundary will receive an additional debuff that restricts aerial abilities for 2s.

description_trans.ko: 낙뢰를 소환하여 적중한 적의 수에 비례해 Thorforce를 회복합니다.
description_trans.ja: 落雷を召喚し、命中した敵の数に応じてThorforceを回復する。

skills.name: Awakening Rune
skills.description: Consume Thorforce to enter the Awakened state, granting Bonus Health and enhancing Mjolnir Bash

stats.Attack Interval: The first three stages last for 0.4s each, while the fourth stage lasts for 0.8s
stats.Damage: Projectile Damage: 70, Spell Field Damage: 15 per second
stats.Special Effect: Inflict damage over time on nearby enemies; After casting Awakening Rune, you can manually cancel the Awakened state after a brief delay. At the end of the Awakened state, Thor restores 1 point of Thunderforce.

description_trans.ko: Thorforce를 소모하여 Awakened 상태에 진입하며, 추가 체력을 얻고 Mjolnir Bash를 대폭 강화합니다.
description_trans.ja: Thorforceを消費してAwakened状態に入り、追加HPを獲得してMjolnir Bashを大幅に強化する。

skills.name: THUNDERSTRIKE PIKE
skills.description: Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range

description_trans.ko: 안젤라가 토르에게 이코르 파편을 공유하여, 적중한 적마다 토르포스를 회복하는 번개의 창을 투척할 수 있게 합니다. 이후 토르는 창의 폭발 지점으로 도약하여 범위 내 모든 적에게 2차 피해를 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: アンジェラがソーにイコルの破片を分け与え、命中した敵ごとにソーフォースを回復する雷の槍を投擲できるようにする。その後、ソーは槍の爆発地点へ跳躍し、範囲内の全敵へ2次ダメージを与える。

skills.name: Thorforce
skills.description: Consume Thorforce to gain Bonus Health. Landing Mjolnir Bash on an enemy instantly recharges Thorforce

stats.Bonus Health Per Thorforce: Each point of Thorforce consumed grants 50 Bonus Health, while abilities that consume 3 points of Thorforce grant 150 Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: Thorforce를 소모하여 추가 체력을 얻습니다. Mjolnir Bash 적중 시 Thorforce가 즉시 재충전됩니다.
description_trans.ja: Thorforceを消費して追加HPを獲得する。Mjolnir Bash命中時にThorforceが即座に再充填される。

teamups.name: RAGNAROK REBIRTH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Receiving fatal damage prevents immediate defeat, Thor gains a decaying pool of Bonus Health. If he participates in a KO during this time, he resurrects and recovers a small amount of Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, if either of them participates in a KO, Thor instantly revives, restoring Health equal to his remaining Bonus Health and gaining a Continuous Healing effect.

description_trans.ko: 치명적인 피해를 받아도 즉시 쓰러지지 않고, 점차 감소하는 추가 체력을 얻습니다. 이 시간 동안 처치(KO)에 기여하면 부활하여 소량의 체력을 회복합니다.
description_trans.ja: 致命傷を受けても即座に倒れず、徐々に減少する追加体力を獲得する。この時間内にキル(KO)に関与すると、復活して少量の体力を回復する。

teamups.name: RAGNAROK REBIRTH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Receiving fatal damage prevents immediate defeat, Thor gains a decaying pool of Bonus Health. If he participates in a KO during this time, he resurrects and recovers a small amount of Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, if either of them participates in a KO, Thor instantly revives, restoring Health equal to his remaining Bonus Health and gaining a Continuous Healing effect.

description_trans.ko: 헬라와 함께 플레이 시, 둘 중 한 명이라도 처치(KO)에 기여하면 토르가 남은 추가 체력만큼의 체력을 회복하며 즉시 부활하고 지속 치유 효과를 얻습니다.
description_trans.ja: ヘラとチームアップ時、どちらか一方がキルに関与した時点で、トールが残存追加体力分の体力を回復して即座に蘇生し、持続回復効果を獲得する。

teamups.name: DIVINE ARMORY
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor canleap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Angela, leaping to the Thunder Spear grants Bonus Health.

description_trans.ko: 적중한 적마다 토르포스(Thorforce)를 회복시키는 천둥 창을 투척합니다. 이후 창의 폭발 지점으로 도약하여 범위 내 모든 적에게 2차 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: 命中した敵ごとにトールフォースを回復する雷神の槍を投擲する。その後、槍の爆発地点へ跳躍して範囲内の全敵へ2次ダメージを与えることができる。

teamups.name: DIVINE ARMORY
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor canleap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Angela, leaping to the Thunder Spear grants Bonus Health.

description_trans.ko: 안젤라와 함께 플레이 시, 천둥 창으로 도약하면 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: アンジェラとチームアップ時、雷神の槍へ跳躍した際に追加体力を獲得する。

skills.name: Accursed Pistols
skills.description: Shoot forward dual-wielded pistols. Gain increased Attack Speed when Demonic Energy exceeds 50%

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 8m, decreasing to 55% at 20m

description_trans.ko: 쌍권총을 전방으로 사격합니다. 악마 에너지가 50%를 초과하면 공격 속도가 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 二丁拳銃を前方へ射撃する。悪魔エネルギーが50%を超えると攻撃速度が上昇する。

skills.name: Leaded Transformation
skills.description: Enter Half-Demon State, transforming your arms into demonic rifles to unleash a rain of lead. These rifles have increased Attack Speed and Infinite Ammo. Every bullet that strikes an enemy triggers Lifesteal

stats.Bullet Spread Radius: Spread radius reaches 0.5m after 10 consecutive shots (calculated at 10m distance)
stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 8m, decreasing to 80% at 20m

description_trans.ko: Half-Demon State에 돌입하여 팔을 악마의 소총으로 변형시켜 탄환을 퍼붓습니다. 공격 속도가 증가하고 무한 탄창이 되며 적중 시마다 생명력을 흡수합니다.
description_trans.ja: Half-Demon Stateに入り、両腕を悪魔のライフルへと変化させて弾丸の雨を降らせる。攻撃速度が上昇し弾薬無限となり、弾丸命中ごとにライフスティールが発動する。

skills.name: Mantle of Oblivion
skills.description: Spread your cloak to form a spherical barrier, blocking incoming enemy attacks. When Demonic Energy exceeds 50%, the radius of the sphere expands further.

description_trans.ko: 망토를 펼쳐 적의 공격을 막아내는 구형 방벽을 형성합니다. 악마 에너지가 50%를 넘으면 방벽 반경이 더욱 확장됩니다.
description_trans.ja: マントを広げて球状バリアを展開し敵弾を防ぐ。悪魔エネルギーが50%を超えるとバリア半径がさらに拡大する。

skills.name: Demon of the End
skills.description: Enter Full Demon State. Fire up to 6 high-powered shots that pierce through enemies and barriers, with the final shot being the most powerful. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health to yourself and nearby allies

description_trans.ko: 완전한 악마 상태(Full Demon State)에 돌입합니다. 적과 방벽을 관통하는 고화력 탄환을 최대 6발 발사하며, 마지막 발이 가장 강력합니다. 적 적중 시 자신과 주변 아군에게 추가 체력을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 完全な悪魔形態(Full Demon State)に突入する。敵とバリアを貫通する強力な弾丸を最大6発発射し、最終弾が最も強力な威力を発揮する。敵に命中時、自身と周囲の味方に追加空力を付与する。

skills.name: Void Walk
skills.description: Enter the Void for free-flight. Upon reappearing, gain a decaying Movement Boost and damage surrounding enemies

stats.Movement Boost: 40% during the Ability, decaying to 0% over 2s after it ends

description_trans.ko: 공허 속으로 뛰어들어 자유롭게 비행합니다. 재출현 시 점차 감소하는 이동 속도 증가를 얻고 주변 적에게 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: 虚無の世界へ潜り込んで自由飛行する。再出現時に周囲へダメージを与え、徐々に減衰する加速を得る。

skills.name: Abyssal Veil
skills.description: Throw a dark magic sphere that generates a Veil upon landing. Accursed Pistols shots passing through it generate more Demonic Energy and bullets from Leaded Transformation gain increased Lifesteal. Enemy projectiles passing through suffer reduced damage and healing output. Enemies who pass through the Veil take damage and are Blinded

description_trans.ko: 암흑 장막을 펼쳐 통과하는 아군의 탄환에 흡혈과 에너지 충전을 더하고, 적의 투사체 위력을 약화시키며 통과하는 적에게 피해와 실명을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 深淵の帳を展開し、通過する味方弾を強化・吸血付与し、敵弾を弱体化、通過した敵にダメージとブラインドを与える。

skills.name: Ruinous Pact
skills.description: Accumulate Demonic Energy by dealing damage via Accursed Pistols, blocking attacks with Mantle of Oblivion, or by using Void Walk. Reaching full energy automatically triggers the Half-Demon State

description_trans.ko: 피해를 주거나 공격을 방어하여 악마 에너지를 축적하며, 게이지가 가득 차면 자동으로 반악마 상태가 발동됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 攻撃や防御で悪魔エネルギーを蓄積し、最大値に達すると自動で半悪魔形態へと移行する。

teamups.name: Chaos Collision
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a New Ability. Create an arcane zone that continuously damages enemies and applies stacking Damage and Healing Reduction. Reactivate to teleport to the zone's center.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Scarlet Witch, after teleporting, unleash a magical shockwave, dealing one-time damage to nearby enemies while launching them towards The Hood

partner_name.ja: スカーレット・ウィッチ

description_trans.ko: 새 능력을 얻습니다. 적에게 지속적인 피해를 입히고 중첩되는 공격력 및 치유 감소 효과를 부여하는 마법 지대를 생성합니다. 재시전 시 지대의 중심으로 순간이동합니다.
description_trans.ja: 新アビリティを獲得する。敵に継続ダメージを与え、累積する攻撃力低下および回復阻害を付与する魔術ゾーンを生成する。再発動でゾーンの中心へテレポートする。

teamups.name: Chaos Collision
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Gain a New Ability. Create an arcane zone that continuously damages enemies and applies stacking Damage and Healing Reduction. Reactivate to teleport to the zone's center.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Scarlet Witch, after teleporting, unleash a magical shockwave, dealing one-time damage to nearby enemies while launching them towards The Hood

partner_name.ja: スカーレット・ウィッチ

description_trans.ko: 스칼렛 위치와 함께 플레이 시, 순간이동 직후 마법 충격파를 방출하여 주변 적들에게 1회성 피해를 입히고 더 후드 쪽으로 끌어당겨 띄웁니다(Launch).
description_trans.ja: スカーレット・ウィッチとチームアップ時、テレポート直後に魔術衝撃波を放ち、周囲の敵にダメージを与えつつザ・フッドの方へ引き寄せて打ち上げる(Launch)。

teamups.name: New Moon's Shadow
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Enhances Abyssal Veil into a Lunar Barrier that blocks projectiles. Upon breaking, it detonates, damaging enemies and applying Damage and Healing Reduction. Enemies passing through take damage and are briefly Blinded.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Moon Knight, the Lunar Barrier has greater shield value, and The Hood's attacks that pass through it gain a bounce effect

description_trans.ko: 심연의 장막(Abyssal Veil)이 투사체를 막아내는 달의 결계(Lunar Barrier)로 강화됩니다. 결계가 파괴되면 폭발하여 적들에게 피해와 함께 공격력 및 치유 감소 효과를 부여합니다. 결계를 통과하는 적은 피해를 입고 잠시 실명(Blinded)됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 深淵のヴェールが投擲物を遮断するルナ・バリアへと強化される。破壊時に爆裂し、敵にダメージと攻撃力・回復低下を付与する。結界を通過した敵はダメージを受け短時間視界を奪われる(盲目)。

teamups.name: New Moon's Shadow
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Enhances Abyssal Veil into a Lunar Barrier that blocks projectiles. Upon breaking, it detonates, damaging enemies and applying Damage and Healing Reduction. Enemies passing through take damage and are briefly Blinded.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Moon Knight, the Lunar Barrier has greater shield value, and The Hood's attacks that pass through it gain a bounce effect

description_trans.ko: 문나이트와 함께 플레이 시, 달의 결계의 방어막 수치가 증가하며 더 후드가 결계를 통과해 발사하는 공격에 도탄(bounce) 효과가 적용됩니다.
description_trans.ja: ムーンナイトとチームアップ時、ルナ・バリアのシールド値が強化され、ザ・フッドが結界越しに放つ攻撃に跳弾効果が付与される。

role_name.ja: ストラテジスト (サポート)

skills.name: ENCEPHALO-RAY

stats.Special Effect: Grant bonus health to Ultron and Allies within range, centered around Ultron and the drones; the selected ally gains a 20% Movement Speed and 10% Damage boost

description_trans.ko: 표식된 아군에게 드론을 파견해 이동 속도와 공격력을 높이고, 자신과 대상 주변 아군에게 추가 체력을 부여합니다.

stats.Special Effect: Within the ultimate duration, Ultron grants an Unstoppable effect; Deals 125% damage to Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 울트론 센트리 드론 군단을 소환하여 적에게는 뇌파 광선 공격을, 아군에게는 치유 광선을 일제 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: ウルトロンドローン軍団を召喚し、敵にはビーム攻撃を、味方には回復ビームを一斉照射する。

stats.Dash Direction: Reticle direction combined with key input

description_trans.ja: 移動方向へ高速飛行し、その後に加速状態に入る。

skills.name: IMPERATIVE: PATCH
skills.description: Command up to 2 giant drones to follow 2 allies, constantly healing allies within its radius, with more healing for the designated allies.

stats.Special Effect: Imperative: Patch can deploy up to 2 drones, allowing support for two allies at once

description_trans.ko: 최대 2대의 거대 드론을 아군에게 호위시켜 반경 내 아군을 지속 치유하며 호위 대상에게 더 큰 치유를 제공합니다.
description_trans.ja: 最大2機の巨大ドローンを味方に追従させ、範囲内の味方を持続回復し護衛対象にさらに強力な回復を与える。

skills.name: NANO RAY
skills.description: When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!

stats.Range: 2.5m radius, infinite length cylindrical spell field
stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 75% at 30m

description_trans.ko: 울트론의 광선이 모든 영웅을 관통하며 적에게 피해를 주고 아군을 치유하는 나노 레이로 진화합니다.
description_trans.ja: ウルトロンのビームが全キャラクターを貫通し、敵にダメージを与え味方を回復するナノ・レイへと進化する。

teamups.name: STARK PROTOCOL

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 75% at 30m

description_trans.ko: 뇌파 광선(Encephalo-Ray)이 나노 광선(Nano-Ray)으로 업그레이드되어 전방으로 다수의 피해 나노 투사체를 발사합니다.
description_trans.ja: 脳波光線がナノ光線へと強化され、前方へ多数のダメージナノ投擲物を斉射する。

description_trans.ko: 아이언맨과 함께 플레이 시, 명령: 방화벽(Imperative: Firewall)이 사거리 내의 적들에게 강력한 유도 미사일을 발사하여 범위 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: アイアンマンとチームアップ時、指令：ファイアウォールが射程内の敵へ強力な追尾ミサイルを発射し、範囲ダメージを与える。

description_trans.ko: 명령: 패치(Imperative: Patch)가 모든 아군에게 적용됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 指令：パッチがすべての味方に適用される。

teamups.name: SP//DR SYNC
