description_trans.ja: 前方に触手を伸ばして敵を攻撃する。

skills.name: Cellular Corrosion
skills.description: Unleash tentacles to Slow enemies within reach. Enemies unable to break free in time will suffer damage

stats.Casting: Spell field that surrounds the caster
stats.Damage: The spell field deals 5 damage, increasing to 80 damage if the target remains in the area for a duration
stats.Special Effect: Tendrils apply a 25% Slow on the target and take 3s to inflict damage. If the distance from Venom exceeds 11m, the tendrils will detach

description_trans.ko: 범위 내의 적들에게 촉수를 뻗어 감속시킵니다. 제시간에 벗어나지 못한 적은 피해를 받습니다.
description_trans.ja: 射程内の敵に触手を伸ばして鈍足を付与する。時間内に脱出できなかった敵はダメージを受ける。

skills.name: Feast of the Abyss
skills.description: Burrow underground for free movement. After a duration or by left-clicking, devour enemies above to deal damage based on the enemy's current health and generate equivalent Bonus Health. Devoured enemies suffer Reduced Healing

stats.Casting: Single-cast spell field that surrounds the caster
stats.Damage: Inflict damage equal to 50% of the target's health, followed by an additional 50 damage
stats.Special Effect: 130% of damage dealt is converted into Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 지하로 잠입하여 자유롭게 이동합니다. 일정 시간 후 또는 좌클릭 시 지상의 적을 삼켜 적 현재 체력에 비례한 피해를 입히고 동일한 추가 체력을 얻습니다. 삼켜진 적은 받는 치유량이 감소합니다.
description_trans.ja: 地中に潜行して自由に移動する。一定時間後または左クリックで地上の敵を捕食し、敵の現在HPに応じたダメージを与え同等の追加HPを獲得する。捕食された敵は被回復効果が低下する。

skills.name: Venom Swing
skills.description: Launch webbing forward, allowing for a singular swing in the desired direction

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 거미줄을 발사하여 원하는 방향으로 1회 스윙 이동합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へウェブを発射し、指定方向へ1回スイング移動を行う。

skills.name: Symbiotic Resilience
skills.description: Generate Bonus Health against damage. The lower Venom's Health, the greater the Bonus Health generated

stats.Special Effect: Grant 100 Bonus Health and convert 110% of lost Health into Bonus Health

description_trans.ko: 피해를 막아주는 추가 체력을 생성합니다. 베놈의 체력이 낮을수록 더 많은 추가 체력을 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: ダメージを防ぐ追加HPを生成する。ヴェノムの残りHPが低いほど、生成される追加HPが多くなる。

skills.name: Frenzied Arrival
skills.description: Dash to the target location from a certain height. Upon landing, damage nearby enemies, launching them up toward the landing point

stats.Damage: 65 damage, with damage falloff starting at 2m from the center of the spell field and decreasing to 40% at 6m
stats.Special Effect: Knocks enemies inward, with an inward knockback angle of 75°

description_trans.ko: 일정 높이에서 목표 위치로 급강하 돌진합니다. 착지 시 주변 적들에게 피해를 입히고 착지점으로 끌어당겨 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 一定の高度から目標地点へ急降下突進する。着地時に周囲の敵にダメージを与え、着地点へ引き寄せて打ち上げる。

skills.name: Alien Biology
skills.description: Press Space to wall crawl, and while crawling, left-click to sprint

description_trans.ko: Space를 눌러 벽을 기어오르며, 벽 이동 중 좌클릭으로 질주할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: Spaceで壁を登り、壁移動中に左クリックでダッシュする。

skills.name: HEALING TENDRILS
skills.description: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela. Jeff's Guardian of the Deep links with nearby allies, providing continuous healing. When the effect ends, it releases a powerful healing burst, converting any excess into Bonus Health. Hela's Hel Tendrils unleash a symbiotic Hel Sphere. Upon hit, it pulls nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, slowing enemies that try to escape.

description_trans.ko: 베놈이 제프와 헬라에게 심비오트를 공유합니다. 제프의 Guardian of the Deep은 주변 아군을 연결해 지속 치유하며 초과 치유를 추가 체력으로 전환합니다. 헬라의 Hel Tendrils는 심비오트 구체를 발사해 주변 적들을 끌어당기고 감속시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: ヴェノムがジェフとヘラにシンビオートを分配する。ジェフのGuardian of the Deepは周囲の味方をリンクして持続回復を行い超過分を追加HPに変換する。ヘラのHel Tendrilsはシンビオート球を放ち、周囲の敵を引き寄せて鈍足を付与する。

teamups.name: BLOOD LEECH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Cellular Corrosion new effect: while tethered to enemies, continuously siphon health from every linked target, restoring Venom's Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, Venom gains a burst of one-time healing when using certain specific abilities.

description_trans.ko: 세포 부식(Cellular Corrosion)의 새로운 효과: 적과 연결되어 있는 동안 연결된 모든 대상으로부터 지속적으로 생명력을 흡수하여 베놈의 체력을 회복합니다.
description_trans.ja: 細胞腐食の新効果：敵と繋がれている間、連結されたすべての対象から持続的に生命力を吸い上げ、ヴェノムの体力を回復する。

teamups.name: BLOOD LEECH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Cellular Corrosion new effect: while tethered to enemies, continuously siphon health from every linked target, restoring Venom's Health.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, Venom gains a burst of one-time healing when using certain specific abilities.

description_trans.ko: 블레이드와 함께 플레이 시, 특정 스킬 사용 시 베놈이 1회성 폭발 치유를 즉시 획득합니다.
description_trans.ja: ブレイドとチームアップ時、特定のスキル使用時にヴェノムが瞬間回復を獲得する。

teamups.name: ABYSSAL FLAMES
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Ignites the symbiote with Phoenix Flames for a duration, replacing Dark Predation with a sweeping Phoenix Touch frontal slash.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Venom's Phoenix Force is enhanced: every Phoenix Touch applies Sparks. Upon reaching three stacks, the Sparks detonate.

description_trans.ko: 일정 시간 동안 심비오트를 피닉스의 불꽃으로 점화시켜, 어둠의 포식(Dark Predation)을 전방을 휩쓰는 피닉스 터치(Phoenix Touch) 베기 공격으로 교체합니다.
description_trans.ja: 一定時間シンビオートをフェニックスの炎で点火し、ダーク・プレデーションを前方薙ぎ払いのフェニックス・タッチへと変化させる。

teamups.name: ABYSSAL FLAMES
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Ignites the symbiote with Phoenix Flames for a duration, replacing Dark Predation with a sweeping Phoenix Touch frontal slash.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Venom's Phoenix Force is enhanced: every Phoenix Touch applies Sparks. Upon reaching three stacks, the Sparks detonate.

description_trans.ko: 피닉스와 함께 플레이 시, 베놈의 피닉스 포스가 강화되어 피닉스 터치 적중 시마다 불꽃(Sparks)을 부여합니다. 불꽃이 3중첩에 도달하면 폭발합니다.
description_trans.ja: フェニックスとチームアップ時、フェニックスフォースが強化され、フェニックス・タッチ命中ごとにスパークを付与する。3スタック到達時に起爆する。

names.ja: ウィンター・ソルジャー

skills.name: Roterstern
skills.description: Fire explosive rounds with his blaster, Roterstern, damaging the target hit and enemies behind them.

stats.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact
stats.Range: Cone-shaped spell field with a 5m radius and an apex angle of 90°
stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 70% at 40m
stats.Special Mechanic: Enemies that take damage from the projectile will no longer receive damage from the spell field

description_trans.ko: 로터슈테른 블래스터로 폭발 탄환을 발사하여 목표와 배후의 적들에게 폭발 피해를 입힙니다.
description_trans.ja: ローテルシュテルン銃から炸裂弾を撃ち出し、標的と背後の敵に爆発ダメージを与える。

skills.name: Bionic Hook
skills.description: Charge up and launch a hook with his bionic arm, reeling in the first target hit and enemies lurking behind

stats.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact
stats.Range: Cone-shaped spell field with a 4.5m radius and an apex angle of 80°

description_trans.ko: 생체공학 팔로 와이어 갈고리를 발사하여 적중한 적과 그 뒤의 적들을 한 번에 끌어당깁니다.
description_trans.ja: 機械の腕からフックを射出し、命中した敵と背後の敵を一気に引き寄せる。

skills.name: Kraken Impact
skills.description: Leap high, then dash forward and slam down with the bionic arm, dealing damage to enemies in range, marking them for Culling. Marked enemies will perish instantly if their health falls below a certain threshold, recharging the bionic arm for another Kraken Impact within a short period

description_trans.ko: 높이 도약한 뒤 기계 팔로 지면을 강타하여 범위 피해를 주고 처형(Culling) 표식을 남깁니다. 표식 대상의 체력이 일정 이하로 떨어지면 즉사하며, Kraken Impact가 즉시 재충전됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 高く跳躍して機械の腕で地面を叩きつけ、範囲ダメージと処刑標識を与える。標識の敵の体力が一定以下になると即死し、Kraken Impactが即時リチャージされる。

skills.name: Trooper's Fist
skills.description: Dash forward, seizing enemies along the path and launching up enemies at the end of the dash

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 돌진하여 경로 상의 적들을 쓸어 담고 돌진 끝에서 공중으로 높이 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ突進して軌道上の敵を巻き込み、突進終了時に高く打ち上げる。

skills.name: Tainted Voltage
skills.description: Charge up and launch a powerful electrical punch with the bionic arm in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies within range and Slowing them. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes

stats.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory
stats.Special Mechanic: Projectiles pierce through enemies

description_trans.ko: 기계 팔에 고압 전류를 충전하여 전방으로 강력한 전격 펀치를 날립니다. 적을 감속시키며 비행 중인 영웅을 지면으로 격추합니다.
description_trans.ja: 高圧電流を帯びた機械の拳で電撃パンチを放つ。範囲内の敵を減速させ、飛行中のヒーローを撃墜する。

skills.name: Stellar Impact
skills.description: Inspired by Captain America's resolve, Winter Soldier can leap to the aid of a designated ally, slamming the ground with his mechanical arm to damage nearby foes and grant Bonus Health to allies within range. Captain America and Winter Soldier can interact with each other once both parties confirm. The duo then collides and unleashes a shockwave that damages and slows enemies

stats.Special Effect: Stellar Impact also triggers the Ceaseless Charge passive effect

description_trans.ko: 윈터 솔져가 아군에게 도약해 지면을 강타하여 주변 적에게 피해를 주고 아군에게 추가 체력을 부여합니다. 캡틴 아메리카와 상호작용하여 충돌 시 적들을 감속시키는 충격파를 발산합니다.
description_trans.ja: 指定の味方へ跳躍し、機械の腕で地面を叩きつけて敵にダメージを与え味方に追加空力を付与する。キャプテン・アメリカと連携して強力な衝撃波を放つ。

skills.name: Ceaseless Charge
skills.description: Roterstern reloads automatically while the bionic arm is in action, granting Bonus Health to the Winter Soldier

stats.Bonus Health (Self): 40 (Bionic Hook & Tainted Voltage), 50 (Trooper's Fist, Kraken Impact)

description_trans.ko: 기계 팔 스킬을 시전하는 동안 로터슈테른이 자동으로 재장전되며 윈터 솔져에게 추가 체력을 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 機械の腕のアビリティ発動中に銃が自動リロードされ、ウィンター・ソルジャーに追加空力を付与する。

teamups.name: TIMELESS VETERANS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Unlocks the Burst Spike ability. Using the bionic arm emits forward electricity, dealing damage and Knocking Back enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the electric burst applies a Grounded effect and Knocks Back enemies even further.

description_trans.ko: 폭발 스파이크(Burst Spike) 능력을 해금합니다. 생체공학 의수로 전방에 전기를 방출하여 피해를 입히고 적들을 밀쳐냅니다(Knock Back).
description_trans.ja: バーストスパイク能力を解放する。生体工学義手から前方へ電撃を放ち、ダメージを与えて敵をノックバックする。

teamups.name: TIMELESS VETERANS
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Unlocks the Burst Spike ability. Using the bionic arm emits forward electricity, dealing damage and Knocking Back enemies.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the electric burst applies a Grounded effect and Knocks Back enemies even further.

stats.Special Effect: Burst Spike applies a Grounded effect and knocks back enemies even further

description_trans.ko: 더 퍼니셔와 함께 플레이 시, 전기 폭발이 착지(Grounded) 효과를 부여하고 적들을 훨씬 더 멀리 밀쳐냅니다.
description_trans.ja: パニッシャーとチームアップ時、電撃爆発が接地(飛行不可)効果を付与し、敵をさらに遠くまでノックバックする。

teamups.name: EXPERT INSTINCT
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Securing or participating in a KO grants a stack of Culling Instinct. Each stack reduces the cooldowns of Winter Soldier's other abilities. All stacks are lost upon defeat.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, the Bonus Health generated by Ceaseless Charge is increased.

partner_name.ja: エルサ・ブラッドストーン

description_trans.ko: 처치(KO)를 달성하거나 기여할 때마다 도태 본능(Culling Instinct) 중첩을 획득합니다. 각 중첩마다 윈터 솔져의 다른 스킬 재사용 대기시간이 감소합니다. 사망 시 모든 중첩을 잃습니다.
description_trans.ja: キル(KO)を達成または関与するたび、カリング・インスティンクトのスタックを獲得する。1スタックごとに他のスキルのクールダウンが短縮される。死亡時に全スタックを失う。

teamups.name: EXPERT INSTINCT
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Securing or participating in a KO grants a stack of Culling Instinct. Each stack reduces the cooldowns of Winter Soldier's other abilities. All stacks are lost upon defeat.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, the Bonus Health generated by Ceaseless Charge is increased.

partner_name.ja: エルサ・ブラッドストーン

description_trans.ko: 엘사 블러드스톤과 함께 플레이 시, 끈질긴 돌진(Ceaseless Charge)으로 생성되는 추가 체력 수치가 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: エルサ・ブラッドストーンとチームアップ時、エンドレスチャージで生成される追加体力が増加する。

names.ja: ホワイト・フォックス

role_name.ja: ストラテジスト (サポート)

skills.name: YEOWOO GUSEUL
skills.description: Fire a Fox Marble forward that bounces off terrain or heroes, then homes in on nearby heroes. It damages enemies, heals allies, and restores Spirit Tail energy

stats.Healing Amount: Direct hit: 55 per round; bounce hit: 40 per round
stats.Damage: Direct hit: 40 per round; bounce hit: 25 per round

description_trans.ko: 여우구슬을 던져 지형과 영웅 사이를 도탄시키며, 적에게 피해를 주고 아군을 치유하며 여우꼬리 에너지를 회복합니다.
description_trans.ja: 狐玉を投擲して跳弾させ、敵にダメージを与え味方を回復し、狐の尾のエネルギーを回復する。

skills.name: CLAW STRIKE
skills.description: While Awakened, slash forward with a flurry of attacks

description_trans.ko: 각성 상태에서 전방으로 날카로운 발톱 연타를 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 覚醒中、前方へ鋭い爪撃の連打を繰り出す。

skills.name: SPECTRAL SURGE
skills.description: Consume one Spirit Tail to send a spectral fox forward. It heals and grants invulnerability to allies it passes through, damages and Charms enemies, forcing foes to move toward White Fox

description_trans.ko: 여우꼬리 하나를 소모하여 영혼 여우를 발사합니다. 아군에게 무적과 치유를 주고 적에게 매혹(Charm)을 걸어 끌어당깁니다.
description_trans.ja: 狐の尾を消費して霊狐を放つ。味方に無敵と回復を、敵にダメージと魅了(チャーム)を与えて引き寄せる。

skills.name: TAIL SWEEP
skills.description: While Awakened, sweep forward tails to launch up hit enemies

description_trans.ko: 각성 상태에서 꼬리를 크게 휘둘러 적들을 공중으로 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 覚醒中、尾を大きく薙ぎ払って敵を打ち上げる。

skills.name: KUMIHO UNLEASHED
skills.description: Manifest the full Nine-Tailed Fox form and continuously heal nearby allies. Cannot receive healing effects from others while in this form

stats.Special Effect: After casting, automatically apply the Blessed by the Nine effect to all allies within a 10m radius for 3s.

description_trans.ko: 완전한 구미호의 본신을 해방하여 주변 아군을 지속 치유합니다. 시전 중에는 다른 치유를 받을 수 없습니다.
description_trans.ja: 九尾の狐の完全な姿を解放し、周囲の味方を持続回復する。この間、他者からの回復効果は受けられない。

skills.name: SPIRIT SANCTUARY
skills.description: Teleport to a chosen ally, instantly healing allies in the area while generating a shield

stats.Special Effect: While the shield is active, it provides 20/s Healing Over Time to allies (including White Fox) within the shield's range

description_trans.ko: 지정한 아군에게 순간이동하여 착지 영역 내 아군을 즉시 치유하고 보호막을 형성합니다.
description_trans.ja: 指定した味方へテレポートし、周囲の味方を即時回復しながらシールドを展開する。

skills.name: Predatory Pounce
skills.description: While Awakened, dash forward. Hit an enemy to slow them, enabling a second dash that knocks back enemies

description_trans.ko: 각성 상태에서 전방으로 돌진하여 적을 감속시키고, 적중 시 적을 밀쳐내는 2차 돌진을 활성화합니다.
description_trans.ja: 覚醒中、前方へ突進して敵をスロウにし、命中時に敵をノックバックする2段目突進が可能になる。

skills.name: FOX FORM AWAKENING
skills.description: Enter Awakened state, transforming Spirit Tails into physical tails. While active, continuously drain Spirit Tail energy and heal nearby allies. Striking enemies provides additional area healing

description_trans.ko: 각성 상태에 돌입하여 꼬리를 활성화합니다. 에너지를 소모하며 주변 아군을 지속 치유하고, 적 타격 시 추가 광역 치유를 발동합니다.
description_trans.ja: 覚醒状態に入り尾を実体化させる。エネルギーを消費しながら周囲の味方を持続回復し、敵攻撃時に追加の範囲回復を行う。

skills.name: NINE-TAILED AURA
skills.description: Black Cat shares her luck with her allies. When White Fox embraces her newfound fortune, she unleashestracking Spirit Tails to grant Healing and Speed to allies, while damaging and Slowing foes. When Captain America enjoys his luck, his shield's block radius expands and allows him to aim deflectedProjectiles directly toward his target

description_trans.ko: 블랙 캣의 행운을 받아 유도 여우꼬리를 날려 아군에게 치유와 가속을 주고 적에게 피해와 감속을 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: ブラック・キャットの幸運を得て追尾する霊狐の尾を放ち、味方に回復と加速を、敵にダメージとスロウを与える。

skills.name: SPIRIT FOX WARD
skills.description: White Fox grants Luna Snow a spirit fox for protection. Luna can activate it for a burst of speed and fire it forward, healing allies in its path while applying Charm to enemies

description_trans.ko: 화이트 폭스가 루나 스노우에게 수호 여우를 부여하여 순간 가속과 함께 투척 시 아군 치유 및 적 매혹을 유발합니다.
description_trans.ja: ホワイト・フォックスがルナ・スノーに霊狐を授け、瞬間加速とともに投擲時に味方回復と敵への魅了を発動させる。

teamups.name: LUCKY LOAN
teamups.description:
Base Effect: White Fox receives an Orb of Life from Black Cat. Upon use, it recovers Spirit Tail energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Aura that shoots out in all directions. This automatically tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting Speed and Healing to allies while damaging and Slowing enemies.
			nhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Cat, using the Orb triggers a state where Spirit Tail Energy is no longer consumed for a duration, allowing free use of Spectral Surge and Fox Form Awakening.

description_trans.ko: 블랙 캣으로부터 생명의 보옥을 받아 사용 시 영혼 꼬리 에너지를 회복하고 전방위로 구미호의 오라를 방출합니다. 오라는 주변 아군과 적을 자동으로 추적하여 아군에게는 이동 속도와 치유를, 적에게는 피해와 둔화(Slow)를 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: ブラックキャットから生命のオーブを受け取り、使用時に尾の霊力を回復して全方位へ九尾のオーラを放つ。オーラは周囲の味方と敵を自動追尾し、味方には移動速度と回復を、敵にはダメージと減速(Slow)を与える。

teamups.name: LUCKY LOAN
teamups.description:
Base Effect: White Fox receives an Orb of Life from Black Cat. Upon use, it recovers Spirit Tail energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Aura that shoots out in all directions. This automatically tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting Speed and Healing to allies while damaging and Slowing enemies.
			nhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Cat, using the Orb triggers a state where Spirit Tail Energy is no longer consumed for a duration, allowing free use of Spectral Surge and Fox Form Awakening.

description_trans.ko: 블랙 캣과 함께 플레이 시, 보옥 사용 시 일정 시간 영혼 꼬리 에너지가 소모되지 않아 유령 쇄도(Spectral Surge)와 여우 형태 각성(Fox Form Awakening)을 자유롭게 사용할 수 있습니다.
description_trans.ja: ブラックキャットとチームアップ時、オーブ使用後一定時間霊力が消費されなくなり、幽体突進および狐形態覚醒を自由に使用できるようになる。

teamups.name: PSIONIC FOX
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activating Fox Form Awakening no longer consumes Spirit Tail energy, and grants the maximum possible duration immediately upon use.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the cooldown for Fox Form Awakening is drastically reduced.

description_trans.ko: 여우 형태 각성(Fox Form Awakening) 활성화 시 영혼 꼬리 에너지를 소모하지 않으며, 사용 즉시 최대 지속 시간을 부여받습니다.
description_trans.ja: 狐形態覚醒の発動時に尾の霊力を消費しなくなり、発動直後に最大持続時間を獲得する。

teamups.name: PSIONIC FOX
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activating Fox Form Awakening no longer consumes Spirit Tail energy, and grants the maximum possible duration immediately upon use.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the cooldown for Fox Form Awakening is drastically reduced.

description_trans.ko: 사일록과 함께 플레이 시, 여우 형태 각성의 재사용 대기시간이 대폭 감소합니다.
description_trans.ja: サイロックとチームアップ時、狐形態覚醒のクールダウンが大幅に短縮される。

skills.name: YEOWOO GUSEUL
skills.description: Fire a Fox Marble forward that bounces off terrain or heroes, then homes in on nearby heroes. It damages enemies, heals allies, and restores Spirit Tail energy

stats.Healing Amount: Direct hit: 55 per round; bounce hit: 40 per round
stats.Damage: Direct hit: 40 per round; bounce hit: 25 per round

description_trans.ko: 여우구슬을 던져 지형과 영웅 사이를 도탄시키며, 적에게 피해를 주고 아군을 치유하며 여우꼬리 에너지를 회복합니다.
description_trans.ja: 狐玉を投擲して跳弾させ、敵にダメージを与え味方を回復し、狐の尾のエネルギーを回復する。

skills.name: CLAW STRIKE
skills.description: While Awakened, slash forward with a flurry of attacks

description_trans.ko: 각성 상태에서 전방으로 날카로운 발톱 연타를 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 覚醒中、前方へ鋭い爪撃の連打を繰り出す。

skills.name: SPECTRAL SURGE
skills.description: Consume one Spirit Tail to send a spectral fox forward. It heals and grants invulnerability to allies it passes through, damages and Charms enemies, forcing foes to move toward White Fox

description_trans.ko: 여우꼬리 하나를 소모하여 영혼 여우를 발사합니다. 아군에게 무적과 치유를 주고 적에게 매혹(Charm)을 걸어 끌어당깁니다.
description_trans.ja: 狐の尾を消費して霊狐を放つ。味方に無敵と回復を、敵にダメージと魅了(チャーム)を与えて引き寄せる。

skills.name: TAIL SWEEP
skills.description: While Awakened, sweep forward tails to launch up hit enemies

description_trans.ko: 각성 상태에서 꼬리를 크게 휘둘러 적들을 공중으로 띄웁니다.
description_trans.ja: 覚醒中、尾を大きく薙ぎ払って敵を打ち上げる。

skills.name: KUMIHO UNLEASHED
skills.description: Manifest the full Nine-Tailed Fox form and continuously heal nearby allies. Cannot receive healing effects from others while in this form

stats.Special Effect: After casting, automatically apply the Blessed by the Nine effect to all allies within a 10m radius for 3s.

description_trans.ko: 완전한 구미호의 본신을 해방하여 주변 아군을 지속 치유합니다. 시전 중에는 다른 치유를 받을 수 없습니다.
description_trans.ja: 九尾の狐の完全な姿を解放し、周囲の味方を持続回復する。この間、他者からの回復効果は受けられない。

skills.name: SPIRIT SANCTUARY
skills.description: Teleport to a chosen ally, instantly healing allies in the area while generating a shield

stats.Special Effect: While the shield is active, it provides 20/s Healing Over Time to allies (including White Fox) within the shield's range

description_trans.ko: 지정한 아군에게 순간이동하여 착지 영역 내 아군을 즉시 치유하고 보호막을 형성합니다.
description_trans.ja: 指定した味方へテレポートし、周囲の味方を即時回復しながらシールドを展開する。

skills.name: Predatory Pounce
skills.description: While Awakened, dash forward. Hit an enemy to slow them, enabling a second dash that knocks back enemies

description_trans.ko: 각성 상태에서 전방으로 돌진하여 적을 감속시키고, 적중 시 적을 밀쳐내는 2차 돌진을 활성화합니다.
description_trans.ja: 覚醒中、前方へ突進して敵をスロウにし、命中時に敵をノックバックする2段目突進が可能になる。

skills.name: FOX FORM AWAKENING
skills.description: Enter Awakened state, transforming Spirit Tails into physical tails. While active, continuously drain Spirit Tail energy and heal nearby allies. Striking enemies provides additional area healing

description_trans.ko: 각성 상태에 돌입하여 꼬리를 활성화합니다. 에너지를 소모하며 주변 아군을 지속 치유하고, 적 타격 시 추가 광역 치유를 발동합니다.
description_trans.ja: 覚醒状態に入り尾を実体化させる。エネルギーを消費しながら周囲の味方を持続回復し、敵攻撃時に追加の範囲回復を行う。

skills.name: NINE-TAILED AURA
skills.description: Black Cat shares her luck with her allies. When White Fox embraces her newfound fortune, she unleashestracking Spirit Tails to grant Healing and Speed to allies, while damaging and Slowing foes. When Captain America enjoys his luck, his shield's block radius expands and allows him to aim deflectedProjectiles directly toward his target

description_trans.ko: 블랙 캣의 행운을 받아 유도 여우꼬리를 날려 아군에게 치유와 가속을 주고 적에게 피해와 감속을 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: ブラック・キャットの幸運を得て追尾する霊狐の尾を放ち、味方に回復と加速を、敵にダメージとスロウを与える。

skills.name: SPIRIT FOX WARD
skills.description: White Fox grants Luna Snow a spirit fox for protection. Luna can activate it for a burst of speed and fire it forward, healing allies in its path while applying Charm to enemies

description_trans.ko: 화이트 폭스가 루나 스노우에게 수호 여우를 부여하여 순간 가속과 함께 투척 시 아군 치유 및 적 매혹을 유발합니다.
description_trans.ja: ホワイト・フォックスがルナ・スノーに霊狐を授け、瞬間加速とともに投擲時に味方回復と敵への魅了を発動させる。

skills.name: NINEFOLD SLAM
skills.description: In Kumiho Form, slam the ground, causing an explosive shockwave. Hitting enemies or summons grants One-Time Healing to self and nearby allies

description_trans.ko: 구미호 폼에서 지면을 내리쳐 충격파를 일으키며, 적 타격 시 자신과 주변 아군에게 즉발 치유를 제공합니다.
description_trans.ja: 九尾形態で地面を叩きつけて衝撃波を放ち、敵命中時に自身と周囲の味方に即時回復を与える。

skills.name: BLESSED BY THE NINE
skills.description: In Kumiho Form, select an ally to grant Continuous Healing, Unstoppable, and Life-Steal for a short time

description_trans.ko: 구미호 폼에서 아군을 지정하여 지속 치유, 저지 불가(Unstoppable), 흡혈 능력을 일시적으로 부여합니다.
description_trans.ja: 九尾形態で味方を指定し、持続回復、阻止不能、吸血能力を一時的に付与する。

skills.name: Savage Claw
skills.description: Slash with Adamantium claws for a Claw Strike. Unleashing Feral Leap will enhance it to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period

stats.Percentage Damage: Deal damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max Health, with an extra 0.062% damage for each point of Rage
stats.Attack Interval: The first three strikes have an interval of 0.27s between them, while the fourth strike has a 0.84s interval from the third strike

description_trans.ko: 아다만티움 발톱으로 전방을 베어냅니다. Feral Leap 시전 후 잠시 동안 광폭 공격으로 강화됩니다.
description_trans.ja: アダマンチウムの爪で切り裂く。Feral Leap発動後、短時間バーサーク攻撃へと強化される。

skills.name: Vicious Rampage
skills.description: Dash forward and unleash a Claw Strike

stats.Percentage Damage: Deal damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max Health, with an extra 0.057% damage for each point of Rage

description_trans.ko: 전방으로 맹렬히 돌진하며 발톱 일격을 가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方へ猛烈に突進して爪撃を叩き込む。

skills.name: Last Stand
skills.description: Knock enemies ahead airborne and spiral through the air, sweeping up enemies along the path and delivering a devastating impact at the landing point

stats.Impact Percentage Damage: Deal damage equal to 10% of the target's Max Health, with an extra 0.3% damage for each point of Rage

description_trans.ko: 전방의 적들을 공중으로 쳐올린 뒤 공중 나선 회전으로 적들을 휩쓸며 착지 지점에 파괴적인 강타를 내리꽂습니다.
description_trans.ja: 前方の敵を打ち上げ、空中スパイラル回転で敵を巻き込みながら着地点に壊滅的な一撃を叩き落とす。

skills.name: Feral Leap
skills.description: Leap like an animal to snatch the first enemy upon impact and Smash them to the ground. Unleashing this ability will enhance his normal attack to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period

stats.Berserk Claw Strike Percentage Damage: Deal damage equal to 1% of the target's Max Health, with an extra 0.035% damage for each point of Rage

description_trans.ko: 야수처럼 도약하여 적을 낚아채 지면에 강하게 내리찍습니다. 시전 후 기본 공격이 광폭 공격으로 강화됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 獣のように跳躍して敵を捕らえ、地面へ叩きつける。発動後、通常攻撃が短時間バーサーク攻撃へ強化される。

skills.name: Phoenix Warrior
skills.description: Wolverine and Hulk can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, Hulk can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forwardJean Grey imbues Wolverine with the awe-inspiring Phoenix Force. With this power, Wolverine's Feral Leap transforms into Phoenix Warrior. While active, he is enveloped in Phoenix flames that continuously scorch him and nearby enemies, dealing Percentage Damage. In this state, Wolverine's abilities gain Lifesteal when inflicting damage

stats.Spell Field Damage: Deal damage equals to target's 1% Maximum Health per second
stats.Berserk Claw Strike Percentage Damage: Deal damage equal to 1% of the target's Max Health, with an extra 0.035% damage for each point of Rage.

description_trans.ko: 진 그레이가 울버린에게 피닉스 포스를 주입하여 Feral Leap를 피닉스 워리어로 진화시킵니다. 피닉스 화염을 두르고 주변 적에게 최대 체력 비례 피해를 주며 모든 스킬에 흡혈 능력을 얻습니다.
description_trans.ja: ジーン・グレイがウルヴァリンにフェニックスフォースを授け、Feral Leapをフェニックス・ウォーリアーへと変形させる。周囲の敵に割合ダメージを与え、全攻撃に吸血効果を得る。

skills.name: Undying Animal
skills.description: Unleash a fierce howl to briefly reduce incoming damage

description_trans.ko: 야성의 포효를 내질러 잠시 동안 자신이 받는 모든 피해를 대폭 감소시킵니다.
description_trans.ja: 野生の咆哮を放ち、短時間受ける被ダメージを大幅に軽減する。

skills.name: Kinetic Claws
skills.description: Cyclops supercharges Wolverine's claws, extending his attack range. While active, Wolverine's Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting him a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around him

description_trans.ko: 사이클롭스가 울버린의 아다만티움 발톱을 충전하여 사거리를 늘리고 주변 난무 스킬을 활성화합니다.
description_trans.ja: サイクロプスがウルヴァリンの爪を強化し射程を延長、周囲への乱舞スキルを付与する。

skills.name: Regenerative Healing Factor
skills.description: Begin to heal and rise with a hefty Bonus Health, shaking off all debuffs. After a brief moment, any remaining Bonus Health morphs into a one-off heal, zeroing out his Rage. Assists in KOs reduce this cooldown

description_trans.ko: 힐링 팩터가 발동하여 모든 약화 효과를 해제하고 대량의 추가 체력을 얻으며 부활합니다. 적 처치 관여 시 쿨다운이 감소합니다.
description_trans.ja: ヒーリングファクターが発動して全デバフを解除し、大量の追加空力を得て回復する。キル関与でクールダウンが短縮する。

skills.name: Berserker Rage
skills.description: Rage builds when Wolverine attacks or takes hits, boosting the damage of his Claw Strikes and the Bonus Health from his regenerative healing factor

description_trans.ko: 공격하거나 피해를 입을 때 분노가 차오르며, 발톱 공격력과 힐링 팩터의 추가 체력이 대폭 증가합니다.
description_trans.ja: 攻撃または被弾時に怒りが蓄積し、爪撃の威力とヒーリングファクターによる追加空力が上昇する。

teamups.name: BLAST SLASH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activation extends the attack range of Savage Claw and Berserk Claw Strike. Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cyclops, Blast Slash is permanently active.

stats.Kinetic Claws Damage: 5 + 0.012% of Max Health as damage per Rage point

description_trans.ko: 스킬 활성화 시 야수 갈퀴(Savage Claw)와 광전사 할퀴기(Berserk Claw Strike)의 공격 사거리가 확장됩니다. 잔혹한 난동(Vicious Rampage)이 키네틱 클로(Kinetic Claws)로 교체되어 전방으로 짧게 돌진하며 주변에 폭풍 같은 연속 베기를 퍼붓습니다.
description_trans.ja: 発動時に野獣の鉤爪および狂戦士の爪撃の攻撃射程が拡大する。凶暴なる暴走がキネティック・クローに置き換わり、前方に短距離突進して周囲に怒涛の連続斬撃を繰り出す。

teamups.name: BLAST SLASH
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Activation extends the attack range of Savage Claw and Berserk Claw Strike. Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cyclops, Blast Slash is permanently active.

stats.Special Effect: Blast Slash is permanently active.

description_trans.ko: 사이클롭스와 함께 플레이 시, 블래스트 슬래시(Blast Slash) 효과가 상시 영구적으로 활성화됩니다.
description_trans.ja: サイクロップスとチームアップ時、ブラストスラッシュの効果が常時永続的に発動する。

teamups.name: PAIR OF THREES
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Upon activation, Wolverine receives Kinetic Enhancement, gaining increased Movement Speed and a Jump Boost. Attacking enemies applies Kinetic Particles that detonate after a short delay for bonus damage. The effect lasts for duration.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Wolverine receives Continuous Healing for the entire duration of the ability.

description_trans.ko: 스킬 활성화 시 울버린이 키네틱 강화를 받아 이동 속도와 점프력이 증가합니다. 적을 공격하면 짧은 지연 후 폭발하여 추가 피해를 주는 키네틱 입자를 부착합니다. 효과는 지속 시간 동안 유지됩니다.
description_trans.ja: 発動時にウルヴァリンがキネティック強化を受け、移動速度とジャンプ力が上昇する。敵を攻撃すると短時間後に爆発して追加ダメージを与えるキネティック粒子を付与する。効果は持続中維持される。

teamups.name: PAIR OF THREES
teamups.description:
Base Effect: Upon activation, Wolverine receives Kinetic Enhancement, gaining increased Movement Speed and a Jump Boost. Attacking enemies applies Kinetic Particles that detonate after a short delay for bonus damage. The effect lasts for duration.
			Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Wolverine receives Continuous Healing for the entire duration of the ability.

description_trans.ko: 갬빗과 함께 플레이 시, 스킬이 지속되는 동안 울버린이 지속 치유(Continuous Healing)를 받습니다.
description_trans.ja: ガンビットとチームアップ時、アビリティ持続中ウルヴァリンが持続回復(Continuous Healing)を受け続ける。
